# Nama ERP Documentation

> User and support documentation for Nama ERP. Every page listed here has an Arabic mirror at
> the same path under /ar - https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/accounts.html is
> https://docs.namasoft.com/ar/modules/accounting/accounts.html in Arabic. "(ar: ...)" after a
> link is the title of that Arabic mirror. A title shared by several pages, or too generic to
> stand alone, carries its parent sections in brackets. "licence:" lists the licence codes a
> page's feature needs. The database schema (tables, columns, enums) is a separate site:
> https://dm.namasoft.com

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/) (ar: بدء الاستخدام): New to Nama ERP?
- [What is Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/what-is-nama-erp.html) (ar: ما هو نظام نما؟): If you have just been handed a login and told to support Nama ERP, the honest first problem is not that the system is complicated — it is that nobody tells you the handful of ideas the whole thing is built on.
- [Glossary of Nama ERP Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/nama-erp-glossary.html) (ar: معجم مصطلحات نظام نما): Nama ERP is used in Arabic and in English, often by the same team on the same call.
- [System Minimum Requirements](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/system-minimum-requirements.html) (ar: الحد الأدنى لمتطلبات تشغيل النظام): Nama ERP is a web-based application, It can be hosted on-premise or on-cloud
- [Nama ERP Installation Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/installation-guide.html) (ar: دليل تثبيت Nama ERP): Nama ERP is a Java-based web application that runs on Apache Tomcat and uses Microsoft SQL Server as its database engine.
- [nama.properties](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/nama-properties.html) (ar: ملف nama.properties): nama.properties is the one file that tells an installation what it is: which database to open, what to call itself, where its files live, and which of the system's safety valves are open.
- [Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/two-factor-authentication.html) (ar: دليل المصادقة الثنائية (2FA)): Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to the Nama ERP login process by requiring users to provide a second form of verification beyond their username and password. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Licensing, and Why a Screen or Field Is Missing](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/licensing.html) (ar: الترخيص، ولماذا تغيب شاشة أو حقل): Most "I can't see it" tickets have the same handful of causes: a customer who bought a module but cannot find its screens, a field that was added but never appears, a morning when nobody can log in, a user refused while colleagues work normally.

## Architecture

- [Architecture](https://docs.namasoft.com/architecture/) (ar: البنية المعمارية): Sooner or later someone in your IT department will ask the question that no feature list answers: what is this thing, exactly, and what will it do to our servers?
- [Application Architecture](https://docs.namasoft.com/architecture/application-architecture.html) (ar: البنية المعمارية للتطبيق): Nama ERP is a single Java web application.
- [Infrastructure Architecture](https://docs.namasoft.com/architecture/infrastructure-architecture.html) (ar: بنية البنية التحتية): This page answers the question a systems administrator actually needs answered: what has to be built, opened, backed up and watched in order to run Nama ERP.
- [Security Architecture](https://docs.namasoft.com/architecture/security-architecture.html) (ar: البنية الأمنية): Security questions arrive in a predictable order.

## Platform Features

- [Platform Features](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/) (ar: الخصائص العامة للنظام): Every Nama ERP module — accounting, supply chain, HR — is built on the same platform.

### Everyday Tools

- [Everyday Tools](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/) (ar: أدوات يومية): The small things every user touches daily, whichever module they work in: the buttons every screen shares, keyboard shortcuts, the search box in the top bar, help text on fields, themes, notes and agenda items on records...
- [Buttons on Every Screen](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/screen-buttons.html) (ar: الأزرار الموجودة في كل شاشة): Nama has hundreds of screens, and almost none of them have their own buttons.
- [Remarks, Agenda and Work Tasks](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/remarks-and-agenda.html) (ar: الملحوظات والأجندة ومهام العمل): Sooner or later somebody needs to write something down against a record. - entities: Remark, DetailedRemark, MeetingRemark, WorkTask, EmployeeAgenda, RemarkType
- [Default Values Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/default-values-templates.html) (ar: قوالب القيم الافتراضية): Most data entry is repetition. - entities: DefaultValuesTemplate - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Default Values Template
- [Preventing a Record From Being Used](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/prevent-usage.html) (ar: منع استعمال سجل): An item is withdrawn from the catalogue.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/shortcuts.html) (ar: اختصارات لوحة المفاتيح): Every keyboard shortcut in Nama, grouped by where it works: support and debug keys, grids, the find bar, reference and date fields, the criteria editor, menus and search, chat, login, the business functions on edit and list screens, and the POS.
- [Searching From the Top Bar](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/global-search.html) (ar: البحث من الشريط العلوي): Nama has two search boxes that are always within reach.
- [Field Help and Tooltips](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/field-help-and-tooltips.html) (ar: مساعدة الحقول والمساعدات السريعة): A new storekeeper stares at a box called Check Overdraft By Date and has no idea whether to tick it. - entities: EntityHelp, TooltipDefinition
- [Themes](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/ui-themes.html) (ar: الثيمات (Themes)): A theme decides how the modern interface looks, and since people spend the whole working day in front of it, that is not cosmetic. - entities: GUITheme - menu: Administration → Display Customization → New GUI Theme

### Documents and Records

- [Documents and Records](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/) (ar: المستندات والسجلات): Every screen in Nama ERP saves one of two things: a document — something that happens on a date, such as an invoice or a voucher — or a master file that documents point at, such as a customer or an item.
- [The Life of a Document: Draft, Commit, Approval, Revise, Cancel](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/document-lifecycle.html) (ar: حياة المستند: المسودة والاعتماد والموافقة والمراجعة والإلغاء): Every screen in Nama has a Save button and a Draft button, and every document in the system moves through the same short life: it is started as a draft, committed into a real document, possibly routed for approval, possibly signed off by a reviewer... - entities: DocumentFile
- [Document Books](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/document-books.html) (ar: دفاتر المستندات (Document Books)): Every document in Nama — every sales invoice, stock issue, receipt voucher, journal entry — has to belong to a document book. - entities: DocumentBook - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Book
- [Document Cancel Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/document-cancel-document.html) (ar: مستند إلغاء مستند (Document Cancel Document)): Sooner or later somebody commits a document they should not have. - entities: DocumentCancelDocument - menu: Basic → Documents → Document Cancel Document
- [Recovering and Finding Records](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/recovering-and-finding-records.html) (ar: استعادة السجلات والبحث عنها): Sooner or later a customer calls to say that an invoice, an item or a whole entity flow has vanished. - entities: EntityVersion, EntitySystemEntry
- [Why a Record Will Not Save or Delete](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/why-a-record-will-not-save-or-delete.html) (ar: لماذا يرفض النظام حفظ سجل أو حذفه): "Why can't I delete this?" - entities: DocumentFile, MasterFile
- [Messages and Refusals](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/messages-and-refusals.html) (ar: الرسائل وحالات الرفض): A customer pastes a sentence into a ticket — "You do not have the authority Delete on entity SalesInvoice" — and asks what to do about it. - entities: EntityHelp - menu: Administration → Other → Entity Help
- [Master Groups](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/master-groups.html) (ar: المجموعات (Master Groups)): Document books number documents. - entities: MasterGroup - menu: Basic → Settings → Group
- [Attachments](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/attachments.html) (ar: المرفقات (Attachments)): Paperwork follows business documents around.
- [Form Documents — the Escape Hatch](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/form-documents.html) (ar: النماذج — باب الخروج الآمن): Every so often a customer asks for a document that exists nowhere else in the world. - entities: FormDoc1, FormDoc2, FormDoc3 - menu: Basic → Remarks → Form Document 1
- [Spare Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/spare-master-files.html) (ar: الملفات الرئيسية الاحتياطية): Form documents solve the problem of a customer needing a document nobody else needs. - entities: Subsidiary1, SubsidiaryClass, DetailedRemark, MeetingRemark, Remark, RemarkType - menu: Basic → Remarks → Subsidiary 1

### Shared Master Files

- [Shared Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/shared-master-files/) (ar: الملفات الرئيسية المشتركة): A handful of master files belong to no single module — every module reads them.
- [Dimensions and Composite Dimensions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/shared-master-files/dimensions-and-composite-dimensions.html) (ar: المحددات والمحددات المركبة): Ask any question about a figure in Nama and the second half of the question is always the same: sales — of which company? - entities: LegalEntity, Sector, Branch, Department, AnalysisSet - menu: Basic → Dimensions → Legal Entity
- [Customers, Suppliers and Other Parties](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/shared-master-files/customers-suppliers-and-parties.html) (ar: العملاء والموردون وجهات الصلة): Almost every document in the system points at somebody. - entities: Customer, Supplier, Contact, ThirdParty, UpdateCustomerInfo, ModifyCustomerInfoReq - menu: Sales → Master Files → Customer
- [Currencies and Exchange Rates](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/shared-master-files/currencies-and-exchange-rates.html) (ar: العملات وأسعار الصرف): "Where do I enter today's dollar rate?" - entities: Currency, ExchangeRate - menu: Basic → Documents → Exchange Rate
- [Accounting Side Config](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/shared-master-files/accounting-side-config.html) (ar: جانب محاسبي (Accounting Side Config)): Every document that reaches the general ledger describes its lines the same way: which account to hit, whose subsidiary (portfolio) account to use, which cost-centre dimensions to carry, and what narration to write. - entities: AccountingSideConfig - menu: Basic → Settings → Accounting Side Config

### Payments and Card Terminals

- [Payments and Card Terminals](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/payments/) (ar: المدفوعات وأجهزة البطاقات): How money that changes hands on a payment line is recorded: the payment methods that decide which account each kind of payment lands in, the PGW program that connects a card machine to the cashier's screen...
- [Payment Methods and Payment Terminals](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/payments/payment-methods-and-terminals.html) (ar: طرق الدفع وأجهزة الدفع (Payment Terminals)): Cash, mada, Visa, a bank transfer, a store voucher: from the customer's side these are all just ways to pay. - entities: PaymentMethod, PaymentTerminal, PGWMethodGroup - menu: Basic → Master Files → Payment Method
- [PGW: Installing and Setting Up the Card Terminal Program](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/payments/pgw-card-terminal-app.html) (ar: برنامج PGW: تثبيت برنامج جهاز البطاقات وإعداده): A card machine on the counter cannot talk to a web page.
- [How a Card Payment Travels Through PGW](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/payments/pgw-card-payment-flow.html) (ar: رحلة الدفع بالبطاقة عبر PGW): When the cashier presses Pay Invoice, four parties take part: the Nama screen in the browser, the PGW program on the same PC, the card machine, and the Nama server. - entities: PaymentTerminal, PGWMethodGroup
- [PGW: Card Refusal Codes](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/payments/pgw-card-refusal-codes.html) (ar: برنامج PGW: رموز رفض البطاقات): When a card payment through PGW fails, the cashier needs to know one thing quickly: is this a card the customer can try again, or a card that will never go through?
- [Receipt Books and Receipt Papers](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/payments/receipt-books.html) (ar: دفاتر الإيصالات والإيصالات): A collector who goes out to customers usually carries a pad of pre-printed, numbered receipts. - entities: ReceiptBook, ReceiptPaper - menu: Basic → Master Files → Receipt Book

### Controls and Governance

- [Controls and Governance](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/) (ar: الرقابة والحوكمة): The controls that keep finished work trustworthy: signing records off level by level, closing accounting periods and freezing everything before a date, rules that block or warn on documents that break them, fields that must be filled in...
- [Revise and Unrevise](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/revise-and-unrevise.html) (ar: المراجعة وإلغاء المراجعة): Every business has records that someone other than the person who entered them is supposed to look at. - entities: RevisionDoc, DetailedRevisionConfig
- [Fiscal Period Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/fiscal-period-control-guide.html) (ar: التحكم في إقفال الفترات المحاسبية (Fiscal Period Control)): In many organizations, simply marking an accounting period as "open" or "closed" for everyone is not enough. - entities: FiscalYearStatusUpdate, FiscalYear - menu: Basic → Master Files → Fiscal Year Status Update
- [Freezing the Past and Overriding Document Dates](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/freeze-processing-and-dates-overrider.html) (ar: تجميد الماضي وتغيير تواريخ المستندات): Two small screens decide which dates a document may carry. - entities: FreezeProcessingDoc, DatesOverrider
- [Criteria Based Validation](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/criteria-based-validation.html) (ar: التحقق المبني على المعايير (Criteria Based Validation)): Every business has rules that the standard screens know nothing about. - entities: CriteriaBasedValidator - menu: Basic → Settings → Criteria Based Validator
- [Required Fields](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/required-fields.html) (ar: الحقول المطلوبة): Every screen in the system already knows which of its fields it cannot live without. - entities: RequiredFields - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Required Fields
- [Audit Trail and Version History](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/audit-trail.html) (ar: سجل التعديل وتاريخ النسخ (Audit Trail and Version History)): Sooner or later somebody asks the question every ERP has to answer: who changed this, and what did it say before?

### Global Configuration

- [Global Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/) (ar: الإعدادات العامة): Almost every other configuration file in Nama belongs to one module — supply chain settings shape inventory, HR settings shape payroll.
- [General (Platform Features › Global Configuration)](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-general.html) (ar: عام): The General tab holds the settings that don't belong to any one business area but shape how numbers, dates and text look everywhere: what the second interface language is, how many decimal places a rate carries, how a Hijri date is written... - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Dimensions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-dimensions.html) (ar: المحددات): Dimensions are how Nama answers "which part of the business does this record belong to?". - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Documents and Books](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-documents.html) (ar: المستندات والدفاتر): Every document in Nama gets its number from a book and its behaviour from a document term. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Taxes and e-Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-taxes.html) (ar: الضرائب والفاتورة الإلكترونية): Nama carries four independent taxes on every document line. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Discounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-discounts.html) (ar: الخصومات): A document line in Nama can carry up to eight separate discounts plus one discount at the document header. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Accounting and Finance](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-accounting.html) (ar: المحاسبة والمالية): This tab collects the settings that decide when a difference is small enough to ignore, how many account slots a customer or supplier carries, how credit limits and debt ages are tracked, and how payments, budgets and cost behave. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Customers and Sales](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-sales.html) (ar: العملاء والمبيعات): A short tab with three unrelated jobs: deciding who counts as the salesman on a document, how customer codes are formed, and how this installation talks to Nama CRM. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Approvals and Revise](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-approvals.html) (ar: الموافقات والمراجعة): Nama has two separate ways of putting a human check between "someone entered this" and "the system acted on it". - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Security and Login](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-security.html) (ar: الأمان وتسجيل الدخول): Everything about getting into the system and what you can see once you are in: login attempts and sessions, password rules, two-factor authentication, LDAP, record-level visibility, and the public user-registration page. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Performance and Search](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-performance.html) (ar: الأداء والبحث): Two related concerns live on this tab. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Appearance](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-appearance.html) (ar: المظهر): How the system looks and how users move around it: what opens at startup, what the login page shows, which fonts and colours are used, and how popups and tooltips behave. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Entities Screens](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-entity-screens.html) (ar: شاشات الكيانات): This tab is unusual: nothing on it changes how the system behaves. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Notifications and Messaging](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-notifications.html) (ar: الإشعارات والمراسلات): Everything the system needs in order to tell someone something: in-app notifications and their sounds, and the email and SMS accounts it sends through. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Reports and Printing](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-reports.html) (ar: التقارير والطباعة): Everything about producing output: the format a report opens in, what appears on the printed page, how dimension parameters are filled, what is logged, how values are formatted, and how Excel exports are built. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Attachments and Storage](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-attachments.html) (ar: المرفقات والتخزين): Where attached files live, how their disk space is watched, and the two external tools the system uses to scan paper and convert documents. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Replication](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-replication.html): Replication keeps several Nama sites in step — a head office and its branches, or servers in different countries. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Currencies Tafqeet](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-currencies.html) (ar: تفقيط العملات): Tafqeet is writing an amount in words — the line on a cheque or an invoice that reads "One thousand two hundred Egyptian Pounds and fifty Piasters only". - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings

### Screen Modifier

- [Screen Modifier](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/screen-modifier/) (ar: تعديل الشاشات)
- [Screen Modifier — Overview & Concepts](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/screen-modifier/screen-modifier-overview.html) (ar: تعديل الشاشات — نظرة عامة والمفاهيم): Every screen in Nama ERP — the edit screen of an invoice, the list view of customers, the pop-up you use to pick an item — ships with a default design. - entities: ScreenModifier - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Screen Modifier
- [Screen Modifier — Edit-Screen Modifications](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/screen-modifier/screen-modifier-edit-screen.html) (ar: تعديل الشاشات — تعديلات شاشة التعديل): This page covers everything you can change about an edit screen — the screen a user opens to view or enter a single record. - entities: ScreenModifier - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Screen Modifier
- [Adding Buttons to a Screen](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/screen-modifier/screen-modifier-action-buttons.html) (ar: إضافة أزرار إلى الشاشة): Nama's screens ship with the buttons the system needs, and no more. - entities: ScreenModifier - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Screen Modifier
- [Screen Modifier — List View & Selector Pop-up](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/screen-modifier/screen-modifier-list-and-search.html) (ar: تعديل الشاشات — قائمة العرض ونافذة الاختيار): Besides edit screens, a Screen Modifier can reshape the two places where records are listed: - entities: ScreenModifier - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Screen Modifier
- [Screen Modifier — Visual Layout Editor](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/screen-modifier/screen-modifier-visual-editor.html) (ar: تعديل الشاشات — المحرر المرئي للتخطيط): Filling in dozens of collections by hand is precise, but slow. - entities: ScreenModifier - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Screen Modifier

### The Menu

- [The Menu](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/menus/) (ar: القوائم): The tree down the side of the screen is not fixed.
- [How the Menu Is Put Together](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/menus/menu-structure.html) (ar: كيف تُبنى القائمة): The menu down the side of the screen looks like a tree, so people expect to edit it like one — drag a folder here, drop an entry there. - entities: MenuDefinition - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Menu Definition
- [Changing the Menu](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/menus/menu-update.html) (ar: تغيير القائمة): Sooner or later somebody asks for the menu to be rearranged. - entities: MenuModifier, MenuDefinition - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Menu Update
- [Who Sees Which Menu](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/menus/menu-visibility.html) (ar: من يرى أي قائمة): Two people sign in to the same system and see different menus. - entities: MenuDefinition

### Fields and Entities Settings

- [Fields and Entities Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/) (ar: أعدادات الحقول و الشاشات): Every organisation wants the system to behave slightly differently.
- [Fields and Entities Settings — How It Works](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-overview.html) (ar: أعدادات الحقول و الشاشات — كيف تعمل): A company goes live and asks for three things in the first week. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Field Appearance and Input Widgets](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-field-appearance.html) (ar: مظهر الحقول وأدوات الإدخال): A number is a number and a piece of text is a piece of text — but 1250000 and 1,250,000 are very different things to read at a glance, and a mobile number you can tap to dial saves a user from copying digits by hand. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Icons and Colours](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-field-icons.html) (ar: الأيقونات والألوان): Nama already ships an icon and a colour for most entity types and for the status values people meet every day, so a user recognises a Sales Invoice, a Customer or an "Approved" status at a glance without reading the label. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Input Rules and Limits](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-input-validation.html) (ar: قواعد الإدخال والحدود): Every organisation ends up with rules about what may go into a field. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Reference Fields and Lookups](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-reference-lookups.html) (ar: حقول المراجع والبحث فيها): A reference field is any field that points at another record: the customer on a Sales Invoice, the item on an invoice line, the warehouse on a Stock Issue. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Calculated Fields and Row Colouring](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-calculated-fields.html) (ar: الحقول المحسوبة وتلوين الصفوف): Sometimes the information a user needs is not stored on the record in front of them. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Automatic Coding of Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-auto-coding.html) (ar: الترقيم التلقائي للملفات): Master files need codes. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Lifting Built-in Restrictions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-relaxing-restrictions.html) (ar: رفع القيود المدمجة): Almost everything on the Fields and Entities Settings screen adds a rule: a mask that formats a number, a validation that refuses bad input, a formula that fills a field in for you. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Record Behaviour and Screen Blocks](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-record-behaviour.html) (ar: سلوك السجلات وكتل الشاشة): Most of the Fields and Entities Settings screen is about a single field — how it is drawn, what may be typed into it, where its list of choices comes from. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings
- [Integrators and Public Links](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/fields-and-entities-settings/fields-settings-integrations.html) (ar: التكامل مع الأنظمة الخارجية والروابط العامة): Almost everything on this screen changes how Nama behaves for people who are already signed in. - entities: GenericReferenceOverrider - menu: Basic → Settings → Fields and Entities Settings

### List Views

- [List Views](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/list-views/) (ar: قوائم العرض): List views are the screens where you browse and search your records — and where you act on them in numbers.
- [Quick Filters in List Views](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/list-views/quick-filters.html) (ar: الفلاتر السريعة في قوائم المستندات (Quick Filters in List Views)): Quick Filters are interactive tools that appear at the top of list views, allowing users to filter data quickly based on the most common or important values in fields. - entities: ScreenModifier, QuickFilterCriteria
- [Limit User To Year](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/list-views/limit-user-to-year.html) (ar: قصر المستخدم على سنة مالية (Limit User To Year)): This feature lets you restrict users' access to specific fiscal years and accounting periods, preventing them from viewing or creating documents in fiscal years they are not authorized to work with. - entities: LimitUserToYear - menu: Administration → Security → Limit User To Year
- [Acting on Several Records at Once](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/list-views/mass-operations.html) (ar: التعامل مع عدة سجلات دفعة واحدة): A list screen does more than show you records.
- [Bulk Edit](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/list-views/bulk-edit.html) (ar: التحرير المتعدد): Someone has to move four hundred customers onto a new salesman. - entities: BulkEditConfig, ScreenModifier - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Bulk Edit Config
- [Custom List Views](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/list-views/custom-list-views.html) (ar: عرض قائمة مخصصة (Custom List View)): A record rarely stands alone. - entities: CustomListView - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Custom List View

### Approvals

- [Approvals](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/approvals/) (ar: الموافقات): Some documents shouldn't go through without a sign-off — a large purchase order, a stock transfer, a discount above a threshold.
- [Approvals System - Approval Definition Full Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/approvals/approvals-system.html) (ar: نظام الموافقات - الدليل الشامل لتعريف الموافقة): An approval definition holds a record of a chosen type until the people it names have approved it. - entities: ApprovalDefinition - menu: Basic → Settings → Approval Definition
- [Sample Approval Email Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/approvals/sample-approval-email-templates.html) (ar: نماذج بريد إلكتروني جاهزة لطلبات الموافقة (Sample Approval Email Templates)): When a document enters an approval workflow, NAMA can send the responsible person an email asking them to approve, reject, or return it. - entities: ApprovalDefinition - menu: Basic → Settings → Approval Definition
- [Responsibilities, Special Responsibles and Delegation](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/approvals/responsibilities-and-delegation.html) (ar: المسئوليات والمسئول المخصص والتفويض): An approval step that names one employee breaks the day that employee leaves, changes job or goes on holiday. - entities: Responsibility, SpecialResponsible, Delegation - menu: Administration → Security → Responsibility

### Security & Permissions

- [Security & Permissions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/) (ar: الصلاحيات والأمان): Every ERP deployment runs into the same questions sooner or later: who can log in, who can see customer balances, and why does a Jeddah rep see Riyadh invoices?
- [Security System Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/security-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على نظام الصلاحيات): Every ERP deployment faces the same questions sooner or later: who is allowed to view customer balances? - entities: SecurityProfile, User
- [Security Profile](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/security-profiles.html) (ar: ملف الصلاحيات (Security Profile)): The Security Profile is where most of your permission settings live. - entities: SecurityProfile - menu: Administration → Security → Security Profile
- [Field, Page, and List View Security](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/field-page-listview-security.html) (ar: صلاحيات الحقول والصفحات والقوائم): Basic permissions answer the question "what can the user do with a type?" - entities: SecurityProfile, User
- [Record-Level Security (Dimensions and Filters)](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/record-level-security.html) (ar: الصلاحيات على مستوى السجلات (المحددات والفلاتر)): Granting a user list view access to sales invoices answers the question "can they browse invoices?" - entities: User, SecurityProfile
- [Users and Login](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/users-and-login.html) (ar: المستخدمون وتسجيل الدخول): The User record is where identity, authentication, and personal permission overrides converge. - entities: User - menu: Administration → Security → User
- [Temporary Additional Permissions (Delegation)](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/security/security-delegation.html) (ar: الصلاحيات الإضافية المؤقتة (التفويض)): The purchasing manager is on two weeks' leave, and purchase order approvals must keep flowing. - entities: SecurityProfileTransfer - menu: Administration → Security → Security Profile Transfer

### Importing & Exporting Records

- [Importing & Exporting Records](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/import-export/) (ar: استيراد السجلات وتصديرها): Almost every implementation starts the same way: the customer has years of data sitting in spreadsheets, and it needs to end up in the system.
- [Exporting Records](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/import-export/exporting-records.html) (ar: تصدير السجلات): Every list screen in Nama can hand you its records as a file.
- [Importing Records](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/import-export/importing-records.html) (ar: استيراد السجلات): Importing is the mirror image of exporting: you hand the system a workbook, and it creates or updates records from it.
- [Anatomy of the Export File](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/import-export/export-file-format.html) (ar: تشريح ملف التصدير): The first time you open an exported workbook you will wonder what happened to it.
- [Files Export / Import Menu](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/import-export/files-export-import-menu.html) (ar: قائمة تصدير / استيراد ملفات): The export dialog is fine for a one-off. - entities: FilesExportMenu - menu: Basic → Settings → Files Export / Import Menu
- [Advanced Record Import](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/import-export/advanced-record-import.html) (ar: الاستيراد المتقدم للسجلات): The ordinary Import Records command has one requirement that quietly rules out half of real-world data loading: the file must be in Nama's own layout. - entities: RecordImportConfig, RecordImportList, RecordImportDoc

### Document Management

- [Document Management](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/) (ar: إدارة المستندات): Every business keeps paper it cannot throw away: signed contracts, commercial registrations, title deeds, copies of national IDs.
- [Document Management Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/dms-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على إدارة المستندات): Most of what an ERP stores is data you typed.
- [Archives, Folders and Topics](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/dms-filing-structure.html) (ar: الأرشيفات والمجلدات والمواضيع): Three master files describe where paperwork lives and what it is about. - entities: DMSLocation, DMSFolder, DMSTopic
- [Archived Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/dms-documents.html) (ar: المستندات الأرشيفية): The DMS Document is the record everything else in this section exists to support. - entities: DMSDocument - menu: Basic → Document Management System → DMS Document
- [Checking Documents In and Out](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/dms-movements.html) (ar: إخراج المستندات وإعادتها): Paper leaves the archive. - entities: DMSDocMovement, DMSFolderMovement - menu: Basic → Document Management System → Document Movement
- [Loading an Archive from a ZIP File](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/dms-bulk-import.html) (ar: تحميل أرشيف من ملف مضغوط): Registering documents one at a time is fine for the trickle of new paperwork. - entities: DMSCompressedFileToDocs - menu: Basic → Document Management System → Compressed File To DMS Document
- [Settings and Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/dms/dms-configuration.html) (ar: الإعدادات والتكامل): Document Management has only three settings of its own. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings

### Automation and Rules

- [Automation and Rules](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/automation-and-rules/) (ar: الأتمتة والقواعد): Let the system do the repetitive work, and define once the conditions the rest of the system reuses.
- [GUI Post Actions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/automation-and-rules/gui-post-actions.html) (ar: الإجراءات بعد الإدخال (GUI Post Actions)): Every screen in Nama already reacts while the user types: pick a customer and the payment terms fill in, change a quantity and the price is recalculated. - entities: GUIPostActions - menu: Basic → Settings → GUI Post Actions
- [Scheduled Tasks (Task Scheduler)](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/automation-and-rules/scheduled-tasks.html) (ar: المهام المجدولة (Task Scheduler)): Task Scheduler lets you automate recurring operations in Nama ERP. - entities: TaskSchedule - menu: Basic → Settings → Task Schedule
- [Recurring Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/automation-and-rules/recurring-documents.html) (ar: المستندات الدورية): Some documents come back on a rhythm. - entities: RecuringDocument - menu: Basic → Documents → Recuring Document
- [Virtual Entities — Reusable SQL Building Blocks for Reports & Dashboards](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/automation-and-rules/virtual-entity-guide.html) (ar: الكيانات الافتراضية (Virtual Entities) — وحدات SQL قابلة لإعادة الاستخدام في التقارير ولوحات المعلومات): You've probably been here before: the same complex SQL query keeps showing up in five different report-wizard records and three dashboard widgets. - entities: VirtualEntity - menu: Administration → Reports → Virtual Entity
- [Criteria Definitions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/automation-and-rules/criteria-definitions.html) (ar: تعريف المعايير (Criteria Definition)): A dozen pages on this site tell you to "pick a criteria": the approval that should only run for credit sales, the lookup that must offer non-service items, the field that becomes mandatory only in one branch... - entities: CriteriaDefinition - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Criteria Definition
- [Entity Type Lists](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/automation-and-rules/entity-type-lists.html) (ar: قوائم الأنواع (Entity Type List)): Settings in Nama ERP are usually written against one screen. - entities: EntityTypeList - menu: Administration → Display Customization → EntityType List
- [Criteria from Text Parser (Text Criteria Guide)](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/automation-and-rules/text-criteria-guide.html) (ar: معايير من المحلل النصي (دليل معايير النص)): Nama ERP provides a flexible text-based filtering mechanism that allows users to define filter criteria using a simple, structured format. - entities: CriteriaDefinition

### Entity Flows

- [Entity Flows](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/) (ar: مسارات الكيان): Entity Flows let you automate the system's reaction to everyday actions — saving, editing, revising a record — without writing any code.
- [Introduction to Entity Flows](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/introduction-to-entity-flows.html) (ar: مقدمة عن مسارات الكيان): Entity Flows are one of the most powerful features in Nama ERP. - entities: EntityFlow - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Entity Flow
- [Importing Data from Excel or Queries](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/excel-and-sql-import-by-entity-flow.html) (ar: استيراد البيانات من Excel أو الاستعلامات): Nama ERP allows you to import data directly from Excel sheets. - entities: EntityFlow
- [Entity Flow Examples](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/entity-flow-examples.html) (ar: أمثلة لمسارات كيان): Create an Entity Flow with the action "Manual" of type EAFieldsValuesCalculator and place it in the edit screen. - entities: EntityFlow - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Entity Flow
- [Entity Flow FAQ](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/entity-flow-faq.html) (ar: أسئلة شائعة عن مسارات الكيان): I set the required type in Fields and Entities Settings, but the value is not saved. - entities: EntityFlow - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Entity Flow
- [Why an Entity Flow Did Not Run](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/entity-flow-troubleshooting.html) (ar: لماذا لم يعمل مسار الكيان): "I built the flow, I saved the invoice, and nothing happened." - entities: EntityFlow - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Entity Flow

### Reports and Printed Forms

- [Reports and Printed Forms](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/) (ar: التقارير والنماذج المطبوعة): Reports are how you get your data back out of Nama ERP, and printed forms are how a single document reaches paper.
- [Jasper Reports Complete Guide for Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/reports-guide.html) (ar: دليل Jasper Reports الشامل لنظام Nama ERP): Every report and every printed form that Nama ERP produces is a JasperReports design: a layout file with a SQL query behind it and a set of prompts in front of it. - entities: ReportDefinition - menu: Administration → Reports → Report Definition
- [Report and Form Wizards](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/report-and-form-wizards.html) (ar: أداتا إنشاء التقارير ونماذج الطباعة): Nama has two wizards. - entities: ReportWizard, PrintingFormWizard
- [Report Wizard Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/report-wizard-guide.html) (ar: دليل أداة إنشاء التقارير (Report Wizard)): Nama ERP provides an easy and effective way to create professional reports quickly using the Report Wizard tool. - entities: ReportWizard - menu: Administration → Reports → Report Wizard
- [Data Sources](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/report-data-sources.html) (ar: مصادر البيانات (Data Source)): Sooner or later a report needs a number that does not hang off its main table. - entities: DataSource - menu: Administration → Reports → Data Source
- [Printing Form Wizard](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/printing-form-wizard-guide.html) (ar: أداة إنشاء نماذج الطباعة (Printing Form Wizard)): Every business eventually needs its own invoice. - entities: PrintingFormWizard - menu: Administration → Reports → Printing Form Wizard
- [Which Printed Form Comes Out](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/printed-form-selection.html) (ar: أي نموذج طباعة سيخرج): Press Print on a sales invoice and nothing is asked of you. - entities: ReportDefinition - menu: Administration → Reports → Report Definition
- [Report Styles](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/report-styles.html) (ar: تنسيقات التقارير (Report Styles)): Building a report or a printed form with a wizard means placing dozens of fields, and every one of them needs a colour, a font, an alignment and a border. - entities: ReportStyle - menu: Administration → Reports → Report Style
- [Custom Report Menu](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/custom-report-menu.html) (ar: قائمة تقارير مخصصة (Custom Report Menu)): A user is looking at a sales invoice on screen. - entities: CustomReportMenu - menu: Administration → Reports → Custom Report Menu
- [NamaRep Expression Reference](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/reports-namarep-reference.html) (ar: مرجع تعبيرات NamaRep): Inside a report, anywhere JasperReports accepts an expression — a text field, a variable, a parameter default, a print-when condition — you can call NamaRep. - entities: ReportDefinition

### Business Intelligence

- [Business Intelligence](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/) (ar: ذكاء الأعمال (BI)): The BI module turns your live ERP data into interactive dashboards — charts, gauges, tables, and cards that talk to each other through cross-filters, drill-downs, and direct links.
- [BI Module — Dashboards & Analytics](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-module-guide.html) (ar: وحدة BI — لوحات المعلومات والتحليلات (BI Module — Dashboards & Analytics)): Nama ERP's BI module lets you build interactive dashboards that turn your live ERP data into charts, gauges, tables, and more. - entities: DashBoardWidget, DashBoard, DashBoardGroup, BICrossFilter, DashBoardWidgetWizard, BIPeriodComparisonConfig
- [Nama ERP BI Module — Technical Reference](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-module-technical-reference.html) (ar: وحدة BI في Nama ERP — المرجع التقني): This document is the authoritative technical reference for the Nama ERP BI (Business Intelligence) module's JSON structures. - entities: DashBoardWidget, BICrossFilter, DashBoard, DashBoardWidgetWizard
- [BI Reference — EnhancedMetricsCard (and legacy MetricsCards)](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-reference-enhanced-metrics-card.html) (ar: مرجع BI — EnhancedMetricsCard (وwidget المقاييس القديم MetricsCards)): Companion to bi-module-technical-reference.md. - entities: DashBoardWidget - menu: Administration → DashBoards → DashBoard Widget
- [BI Reference — EnhancedTable](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-reference-enhanced-table.html) (ar: مرجع BI — EnhancedTable): Companion to bi-module-technical-reference.md. - entities: DashBoardWidget - menu: Administration → DashBoards → DashBoard Widget
- [BI Reference — Wizard Mode](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-reference-wizard-mode.html) (ar: مرجع BI — وضع المعالج (Wizard Mode)): Companion to bi-module-technical-reference.md. - entities: DashBoardWidgetWizard, DashBoardWidget

### Notifications

- [Notifications](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/) (ar: التنبيهات): When something important happens in the system — a new invoice, an approval request, a processing error — the right person should hear about it without anyone remembering to tell them.
- [Notification Definitions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/notifications-system.html) (ar: تعريفات التنبيهات): A Notification Definition is one record that answers four questions about one message: what happens, on which records, who hears about it, and what they read. - entities: NotificationDefinition - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Notification Definition
- [SMS and WhatsApp Configuration in Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/sms-and-whatsapp.html) (ar: إعداد الرسائل القصيرة (SMS) و WhatsApp في نظام نما ERP): Nama ERP supports sending messages via SMS and WhatsApp to users, customers, suppliers, and other entities. - entities: WhatsAppMessageConfiguration, WhatsAppMessage
- [Telegram Notifications in Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/telegram.html) (ar: التنبيهات عبر تليجرام (Telegram) في نظام نما): Nama can send invoices, approval requests, order confirmations and any other notification straight into a customer's or employee's Telegram chat, right beside the SMS and WhatsApp channels you already know. - entities: TelegramBotConfiguration, TelegramMessage, TelegramBotInfo
- [Frequently Asked Questions: Notifications and Messages](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/notification-fq.html) (ar: أسئلة شائعة عن التنبيهات والرسائل): When posting a receipt that contains multiple lines for multiple customers, you may notice that the notification is sent only to the first customer and not to the remaining customers in the other lines. - entities: NotificationDefinition - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Notification Definition
- [General Announcements](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/general-announcements.html) (ar: الإعلانات العامة (General Announcements)): A notification is personal: it tells one user that their invoice was approved or their task is late. - entities: GeneralAnnouncement - menu: Administration → Other → General Announcement
- [Bulk Messages, WhatsApp Messages and Internal Chat](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/bulk-messages-whatsapp-and-chat.html) (ar: الرسائل المجمعة ورسائل واتساب والمحادثات الداخلية): Most messages in Nama are sent by a Notification Definition: something happens to a record, and the definition decides who hears about it and through which channel. - entities: BulkMessage, WhatsAppMessage, WhatsAppMessageConfiguration, ErrorMessage

### Field Filtering

- [Field Filtering](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/field-filtering/) (ar: فلترة الحقول): When a reference field offers the wrong records — too many, too few, or the wrong branch's — one of three tools is behind it, and they are easy to confuse because two of them sit next to each other in the menu with almost the same name.
- [Field Filtering by Dimension](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/field-filtering/field-filtering-by-dimension.html) (ar: فلترة الحقول بالمحددات (Field Filtering)): A storekeeper logged into the Riyadh branch opens a stock transfer, clicks the warehouse lookup, and finds only Riyadh's warehouses. - entities: FieldFiltering - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Field Filtering
- [Field Filter with Criteria](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/field-filtering/field-filter-with-criteria.html) (ar: فلتر الحقل بالمعايير (Field Filter with Criteria)): You can use the Field Filter with Criteria screen to apply custom filters when searching within specific fields on any Nama ERP screen. - entities: UserFieldFilter - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Field Filter With Criteria
- [Modifying Translations](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/translations.html) (ar: تعديل الترجمات): Every label in the system — a field, a screen name, a page title, a group heading, an action button — comes with an Arabic and an English text. - entities: TranslationOverRider - menu: Basic → Settings → Translation OverRider

### Background Processing

- [Background Processing](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/) (ar: المعالجة في الخلفية): Nama does a great deal of work behind you.
- [Business Requests](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/business-requests.html) (ar: طلبات الأعمال (Business Requests)): When you save an invoice, the accounting entry behind it is not written while you wait. - menu: Administration → Settings → Business Requests
- [Pending Tasks](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/pending-tasks.html) (ar: المهام المعلقة (Pending Tasks)): Despite the general-sounding name, this screen is one specific thing: the outbox. - menu: Administration → Settings → Pending Tasks
- [System Actions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/system-actions.html) (ar: إجراءات النظام (System Actions)): Two screens sit next to each other in the menu with almost the same name, and they have nothing to do with one another.
- [Report Monitoring](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/report-monitoring.html) (ar: متابعة التقارير (Reports Monitoring)): A report that takes thirty seconds and a report that has hung look identical from the outside — a spinner, and a user asking whether to keep waiting. - menu: Reports → Reports Monitoring
- [Task Queues](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/task-queues.html) (ar: طوابير المهام (Task Queues)): Nama has always done its slow work behind you rather than while you wait. - entities: TaskQueue, EntityFlow, TaskSchedule - menu: Basic → Settings → Task Queue

## Modules

- [Modules](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/) (ar: الوحدات)

### Invoicing, Taxes & Discounts

- [Invoicing, Taxes & Discounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/) (ar: الفواتير والضرائب والخصومات): Invoicing is where a sale turns into money owed — and into a tax-compliant document that both your customer and your government will accept.
- [Customer Reward Points (Loyalty Points)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/reward-points.html) (ar: نقاط مكافآت العملاء (Customer Reward Points / Loyalty Points)): When integrating with STC Qitaf loyalty program, STC will request a CSR (Certificate Signing Request) file. - entities: RewardPointsConfig - menu: Basic → Documents → Reward Points Configuration
- [Invoice Discounts and Tax Calculation System - Comprehensive Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/invoice-discounts-and-tax-calculation-guide.html) (ar: دليل نظام الخصومات وحساب الضرائب على الفواتير - دليل شامل): Nama ERP provides a sophisticated invoice discount and tax calculation system that supports complex business requirements. - entities: TaxPlan, TaxDiscountEffectsConfig - menu: Basic → Master Files → Tax Plan
- [Pricing and Offers Management Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/pricing-and-offers-guide.html) (ar: دليل إدارة الأسعار والعروض (Pricing and Offers Management Guide)): This comprehensive guide covers the pricing system in Nama ERP, including price lists, sales offers, and automated pricing mechanisms that help maintain accurate and competitive pricing throughout your sales processes. - entities: SalesPriceList, SalesOffers - menu: Sales → Prices And Offers → Price List
- [Salesman Discount Limits](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/salesman-discount-limits.html) (ar: حدود خصم البائع): A shop usually wants a sliding scale of discount authority: a salesperson may knock up to 10% off, the branch manager up to 15%, and anything beyond that needs head office. - entities: Employee
- [Payment Schedules User Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/payment-schedules-user-guide.html) (ar: دليل المستخدم لجداول الدفع (Payment Schedules)): The Payment Schedules feature in Nama ERP allows you to define flexible payment terms and installment plans for sales documents. - entities: PaymentScheduleTemplate, ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher - menu: Purchases → Master Files → Payment Schedule Template
- [Linking Payment Vouchers to Invoices](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/payment-entries.html) (ar: ربط سندات الدفع بالفواتير): Nama ERP supports linking invoices to payment vouchers flexibly across multiple scenarios. - entities: ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher
- [Online Payments Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/online-payments.html) (ar: تكامل المدفوعات الإلكترونية (Online Payments Integration)): Nama ERP's online payment module lets you accept payments directly from your customers through secure payment gateways. - entities: OnlinePaymentConfig, PaymentLinksCreationDoc - menu: Basic → Documents → Online Payment Configuration
- [Electronic Invoicing in Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/e-invoices-guide.html) (ar: الفاتورة الإلكترونية في نما ERP): Most tax authorities no longer accept a printed invoice as the record of a sale. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [Integration with ZATCA (Saudi Arabia – Fatoora)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/zatca-guide.html) (ar: الربط مع هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك بالسعودية (ZATCA – فاتورة)): The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) requires every VAT-registered business in Saudi Arabia to issue its invoices electronically through the Fatoora platform. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [Integration with JoFotara (Jordan)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/jofotara-jordan-guide.html) (ar: التكامل مع «فوترة» الأردنية (JoFotara)): Jordan's Income and Sales Tax Department runs the national e-invoicing portal JoFotara. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [Egyptian e-Invoice and e-Receipt](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/egypt-einvoice-guide.html) (ar: الفاتورة الإلكترونية والإيصال الإلكتروني في مصر): The Egyptian Tax Authority runs two electronic systems side by side. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc, DocumentCancelDocument, Bank, BankAccount, DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [UAE E-Invoicing Integration via Orchida osTax](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/uae-orchida-einvoice-guide.html) (ar: الربط مع الفاتورة الإلكترونية في الإمارات عبر Orchida osTax): NamaERP supports sending electronic invoices to the UAE Federal Tax Authority (FTA) through the Orchida osTax service provider. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [Standard Terms and Conditions Feature Documentation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/standard-terms-feature-documentation.html) (ar: توثيق خاصية الشروط والأحكام القياسية (Standard Terms and Conditions Feature Documentation)): The Standard Terms feature in Nama ERP provides a comprehensive mechanism for tracking terms and conditions in sales documents (invoices, quotations, etc.) and monitoring whether these terms have been fulfilled. - entities: SalesStandardTerm, StandardTermFulfillment, StandardTermExtension - menu: Basic → Master Files → Sales Standard Term
- [Barcode Field Feature for Sequential Scanning](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/barcode-field-feature.html) (ar: ميزة حقل الباركود للمسح المتتالي): A new feature has been developed in Nama ERP to solve the problem of losing focus when scanning item barcodes in browsers.

### Accounting & Banks

- [Accounting & Banks](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/) (ar: الحسابات والبنوك): The NaMa Accounting System is the financial engine of the whole product: every document in Nama — a sales invoice, a stock issue, a payroll run, an asset depreciation — ultimately lands as an accounting effect in the general ledger.
- [Accounting Concepts & First-Time Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/accounting-concepts-and-setup.html) (ar: المفاهيم الأساسية والإعداد المبدئي للحسابات): Before you can record your first entry, the accounting system needs to "know" a few fixed facts about your organization: What is your main currency? - entities: Ledger, AccountChartType, AccountingCalendar, FiscalYear - menu: Accounting → Settings → Ledger - licence: accounting
- [Chart of Accounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/chart-of-accounts.html) (ar: شجرة الحسابات): The chart of accounts is the backbone of your accounting system: a hierarchical structure that classifies everything you own, owe, earn, and spend into logical, branching groups. - entities: AccountsChart, AccountCategory, AccountTaxCategory - menu: Accounting → Master Files → Accounts Chart - licence: accounting
- [Accounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/accounts.html) (ar: الحسابات): If the chart of accounts is the structure, the Account is the unit balances are actually recorded on. - entities: Account - menu: Accounting → Master Files → Account - licence: accounting
- [System Accounts & Transaction Exceptions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/system-accounts-and-exceptions.html) (ar: الحسابات النظامية واستثناءات الحركة عليها): Some accounts in the ledger are not meant to be touched by hand. - entities: SystemAccountTransException, Account - menu: Accounting → Master Files → System Accounts Transactions Exceptions - licence: accounting
- [Journal Entries & Adjustments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/journal-entries.html) (ar: سندات القيد والتسويات): Most entries in Nama are generated automatically from other documents (an invoice, a stock issue, a payroll run...), but there's always a need to record manual entries: an adjustment, a petty expense, an opening balance, clearing a suspense account. - entities: JournalEntry, CurrencyDiffJournal, ExchangeRateUpdate, InterCompanyTransfer - menu: Accounting → Documents → Journal Entry - licence: accounting, accounting-banks
- [Year-End Closing & Period Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/year-end-and-period-control.html) (ar: الإقفال السنوي والتحكم في الفترات): At the end of each fiscal year comes the moment of closing: carrying the year's profit/loss into equity, and closing the result accounts in preparation for a new year. - entities: ClosingEntry, PreventAccTransactions, LedgerReviseDoc, PurgeJournal - menu: Accounting → Documents → Closing Entry - licence: accounting
- [Receipt & Payment Vouchers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/receipts-and-payments.html) (ar: سندات القبض والصرف): Every bit of money that enters or leaves your safe or bank passes through this family of documents. - entities: ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher, ReceiptOrder, PaymentOrder, RVRequest, PVRequest, ConsolidatedRVRequest, ConsolidatedPVRequest - menu: Accounting → Documents → Receipt Voucher - licence: accounting
- [Credit & Debit Notes](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/credit-and-debit-notes.html) (ar: إشعارات الدائن والمدين): Sometimes you need to adjust a customer's or supplier's balance without any cash receipt or payment: a settlement discount for a customer, a sales return, or an extra charge on a supplier. - entities: CreditNote, DebitNote - menu: Accounting → Documents → CreditNote - licence: accounting
- [Aging Allocation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/aging-allocation.html) (ar: تسوية أعمار الديون (Aging Allocation)): A debt-age report answers one question: how old is this balance? - entities: AgingAllocation - menu: Banks → Master Files → Aging Allocation
- [Cashier Shifts (Cash Drawer)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/cashier-shifts.html) (ar: ورديات الكاشير (درج النقدية)): The general receipt and payment vouchers (see their page) are flexible but more detailed than a cashier needs when handling dozens of quick payments a day. - entities: CSHOpenShift, CSHCloseShift, CSHReceiptVoucher, CSHPaymentVoucher, ElectronicReceiptVoucher - menu: Accounting → Cashiers → Open Shift - licence: accounting-cashier, accounting-electronic-receipt
- [Banks, Bank Accounts & Transfers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/banks-and-bank-accounts.html) (ar: البنوك والحسابات البنكية والتحويلات): Managing the banking side starts by defining the banks you deal with, then the bank accounts opened with them. - entities: Bank, BankAccount, BankTransfer, BankAdjustment - menu: Banks → Master Files → Bank - licence: accounting-banks
- [Bank Reconciliation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/bank-reconciliation.html) (ar: المطابقة البنكية): Your bank balance in your books rarely matches the bank statement moment for moment: a cheque you deposited isn't yet collected, a fee the bank deducted you haven't recorded yet, a transfer in transit. - entities: BankReconciliation - menu: Banks → Cheques → Bank Reconciliation - licence: accounting-banks
- [Cheques & Financial Papers (Lifecycle)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/cheques-financial-papers.html) (ar: الشيكات والأوراق المالية (دورة الحياة)): A cheque isn't just an amount; it's a paper with a journey: it's received, deposited at the bank, collected or returned, and may be endorsed to another party or discounted before its due date. - entities: FinancialPaper, FPBook, BankPortfolio, BankNotice, OpenningFinancialPaper, FinancialPaperAgio, FinancialPaperCancel, FPTransfer - menu: Banks → Master Files → Commercial Paper - licence: accounting-banks
- [Bank Loans](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/bank-loans.html) (ar: القروض البنكية): A bank loan isn't just an amount that lands in your account and then gets repaid; it's a commitment that stretches over months or years, with a principal, interest, fees and an installment schedule... - entities: BankLoan, BankLoanRequest, LoanIssue, LoanInstallmentPayment, LoanInterestsCalculation, BankLoanScheduling, BankLoanChangingDoc, BankLoanType - menu: Banks → Bank Loans → Bank Loan - licence: accounting-loans
- [Fixed Deposits](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/fixed-deposits.html) (ar: الودائع الثابتة): A fixed deposit is the mirror image of a loan: instead of borrowing from the bank, you place an amount with it for a set term in return for interest. - entities: FixedDeposit, FixedDepositIssue, InterestPaymentDocument, FixedDepositChangingDoc - menu: Banks → Fixed Deposits → Fixed Deposit - licence: accounting-loans
- [Credit Facilities & Facility Limits](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/credit-facilities.html) (ar: التسهيلات الائتمانية وحدود التسهيلات): Two related but distinct ideas meet on this page: - entities: CreditFacility, FacilityLimit, FacilityLimitConfig, CreditFacilitySetting, CreditFacilityIssuance, CreditFacilityPayment, CreditFacilityTermination - menu: Banks → Credit Facilities → Credit Facility - licence: accounting-loans
- [Letters of Guarantee](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/letters-of-guarantee.html) (ar: خطابات الضمان): A letter of guarantee is an undertaking the bank issues on your behalf in favor of a third party (a government body, a project owner…) guaranteeing that you'll meet some obligation — like a tender-entry guarantee or a contract performance guarantee. - entities: LetterOfGuarantee, LGTIssue, LGTReceipt, LGTDelivery, LGTChanging, LGTClosing, LGTReq - menu: Banks → Letters Of Guarantee → Letter Of Guarantee - licence: accounting-lgt
- [Bank Letters of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/bank-letters-of-credit.html) (ar: الاعتمادات المستندية البنكية): A letter of credit (LC) is a tool an importer uses to reassure the supplier: the bank undertakes to pay the supplier the shipment's value once they present shipping documents matching the terms. - entities: BankLC, BLCOpeningDoc, BLCChanging, BLCClosingDoc, BLCReq - menu: Banks → Bank LC → Bank LC - licence: accounting-blc
- [Treasury Bills](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/treasury-bills.html) (ar: أذون الخزانة): A treasury bill is a short-term investment instrument the state issues: you buy it for less than its nominal value, and at maturity you collect its full value, so the difference is your return. - entities: TreasuryBill, TreasuryBillPurchaseDoc, TrasureyBillROIProofDoc, AggTreasuryBillProofDoc, TreasuryBillSalesDoc, TreasuryBillCloseDoc - menu: Banks → Treasury Bill → Treasury Bill - licence: accounting-investment-documents
- [Investment Portfolios](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/investment-portfolios.html) (ar: المحافظ الاستثمارية): When a company puts money into ventures — a stake in another business, a project, a managed fund — it needs to track each investment as an asset in its own right: how much capital went in, what it's worth now, what profit it threw off... - entities: IPInvestmentPortfolio, IPInvestmentStart, IPInvestmentEnd, IPInvestmentUpdate, IPInvestmentProfitDistribution, IPInvestmentIncreaseCapital, IPInvestmentOpportunity, Investor, InvestmentProject - menu: Accounting → Investment Portfolios → Investment Portfolio - licence: accounting-investment
- [Investment Documents & Fund Certificates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/investment-documents.html) (ar: مستندات الاستثمار وشهادات الصناديق): Beyond the portfolio system that tracks investment assets, Nama has a second investment world for the paper instruments a company buys and holds: bonds and fund certificates. - entities: InvestmentDoc, InvestmentDocumentFund, InvestmentDocPurchase, InvestmentDocROIProof, AggregatedInvestmentDocROIProof, InvestmentDocClaiming, InvestmentDocumentPurchase, InvestmentDocumentSale, InvestmentDocumentPriceUpdate, ProfitDistributationDoc - menu: Banks → Investment Documents → Investment Document - licence: accounting-investment-documents
- [Prepaid Expenses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/prepaid-expenses.html) (ar: المصروفات المقدمة): Some expenses are paid once but belong to many months: an annual rent paid up front, a yearly insurance premium, a maintenance contract. - entities: PrepaidExpenseContract, PrepaidExpenseItem, PrepaidExpenseLedger - menu: Accounting → Prepaid Expense Contracts → Prepaid Expense Contract - licence: accounting-prepaid-expenses
- [Financial Commitments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/financial-commitments.html) (ar: الالتزامات المالية): A company carries many recurring obligations that aren't invoices yet but are very real: a yearly rent paid in quarterly installments, an insurance policy, a financing agreement with a fixed repayment schedule. - entities: FinancialCommitment, FinancialCommitmentPayDoc, FinancialCommitmentReschedule, FinancialCommitmentCategory - menu: Accounting → Financial Commitment Management → Financial Commitment - licence: accounting-financial-commitments-regulation
- [Financial Budgets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/financial-budgets.html) (ar: الموازنات المالية): A budget is a plan with teeth: you decide up front how much each account may spend (or should earn) over a period, and then — if you want — the system holds your documents to that plan, warning or even blocking spending that would blow past it. - entities: FinancialBudget, BudgetScenario - menu: BUDGETS → Budgets → Financial Budget - licence: accounting-budget
- [Financial Statements](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/financial-statements.html) (ar: القوائم المالية): Every company needs an income statement and a balance sheet, but no two companies want them laid out exactly the same way — different line groupings, different subtotals, different comparison columns. - entities: FSSettingsFile, FSIssueFile, FSAccountGroup, FSEquation - menu: Accounting → Financial Statement → FS Settings File - licence: accounting
- [Consolidated Statements](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/consolidated-statements.html) (ar: القوائم المالية الموحدة): The consolidated statements give a group of companies one trial balance, one income statement and one balance sheet, in one reporting currency, with the business the companies did with each other taken out. - licence: accounting
- [Misc Purchasing & Machine Rent](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/misc-purchasing.html) (ar: المشتريات المتنوعة وتشغيل المعدات): Not every purchase flows through the inventory module. - entities: MiscPurchaseInvoice, MiscPurchaseReq, MiscPurchaseOrder, PurchaseElement, MachineRentInvoice - menu: Accounting → Documents → Miscellaneous Invoice - licence: accounting
- [Party Evaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/party-evaluation.html) (ar: تقييم الجهات): Numbers tell you what a supplier charged or what a customer paid, but not whether they're good to work with: Did the supplier deliver on time? - entities: PartyEvaluation, PartyEvaluationElement, PartyEvalElementGroup - menu: Accounting → Party Evaluations → Party Evaluation - licence: accounting
- [Subsidiary Reconciliation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/subsidiary-reconciliation.html) (ar: التسوية مع الذمم): A customer or supplier almost always keeps their own account of your dealings — and it rarely lines up with yours to the penny: an invoice they haven't booked, a payment in transit, a credit note one side recorded and the other didn't. - entities: SubsidiaryReconciliation - menu: Accounting → Reconciliations → Subsidiary Reconciliation - licence: accounting
- [Account Statements, Trial Balance & Analysis](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/reports-account-statements-and-trial-balance.html) (ar: كشوف الحسابات وميزان المراجعة والتحليل): Once transactions are recorded, the moment of questions arrives: What is this account's balance? - licence: accounting

#### Technical Reference

- [Technical Reference](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/) (ar: مرجع الدعم الفني)
- [When a Document Has No Accounting Effect](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-request-processing.html) (ar: حين لا يكون للمستند أثر محاسبي): Saving an accounting document does not write its journal entry there and then. - menu: Administration → Settings → Business Requests
- [Accounting Configuration (module option catalog)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات الحسابات (كتالوج خيارات الوحدة)): Many of the accounting module's behaviors aren't coded — they're configured from the accounting module's configuration screen (Module Configurations → Account Configurations). - menu: Module Configurations → Account Configurations
- [Document Terms (per-type processing rules)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-document-terms.html) (ar: توجيهات المستندات (قواعد المعالجة لكل نوع)): One question recurs throughout this module's guides: "where do the debit and credit accounts for this document come from?" - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Dimensions, Cost Centers & Distribution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-dimensions-and-distribution.html) (ar: المحدِّدات ومراكز التكلفة والتوزيع): An account answers "what" — cash, sales, salaries. - entities: AccDistribution - menu: Accounting → Settings → Account Distribution
- [Fiscal Periods, Period Locking & Multi-Currency](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-periods-and-currency.html) (ar: الفترات المالية وإقفال الفترات وتعدّد العملات): Two questions sit underneath a lot of support tickets: "why won't this document save into this date?" - entities: FiscalYear, FiscalYearStatusUpdate - menu: Basic → Master Files → Fiscal Year

#### Accounting Document Terms

- [Accounting Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الحسابات): Every accounting document that posts takes its accounts from its document term (توجيه) — so when a voucher lands on the wrong account, a cheque moves to an unexpected status, or a letter of guarantee posts nothing...
- [Receipt, Payment and Request Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-vouchers-and-requests.html) (ar: توجيهات سندات القبض والصرف والطلبات): Receipt and payment vouchers are the most configured documents in the accounting module, and their term is the longest in it — well over fifty options. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Journal, Closing and Other Accounting Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-journals-and-closing.html) (ar: توجيهات القيود والإقفال ومستندات الحسابات الأخرى): A journal entry's lines name their own accounts, so its term has no debit and credit sides to fill — it is about guard rails instead: which dimensions a user may change, and what to do when the entry does not balance. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Credit/Debit Note and Miscellaneous Invoice Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-notes-and-misc-invoices.html) (ar: توجيهات الإشعارات الدائنة والمدينة وفواتير المتنوعات): Credit and debit notes adjust what a customer or supplier owes without moving goods, and the miscellaneous invoices bill things that are not stock items — services, rent, utilities, machine hire. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Commercial Paper Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-commercial-papers.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الأوراق التجارية): A cheque moves through several hands and several accounts before it is finally cash: it is received from a customer, deposited in a bank portfolio, collected or bounced, sometimes discounted at the bank (agio), sometimes partly paid or cancelled. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Letter of Guarantee and Letter of Credit Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-guarantees-and-credits.html) (ar: توجيهات خطابات الضمان والاعتمادات البنكية): A letter of guarantee moves several different amounts at once: the face value the bank commits to, the cash cover the bank holds back from your account, the fees it charges, and the share of your credit facility the letter uses up. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Loan, Deposit and Credit Facility Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-loans-deposits-facilities.html) (ar: توجيهات القروض والودائع والتسهيلات الائتمانية): Borrowing from a bank and lending to one are mirror images, and their terms look alike: a pair of sides for the principal, a pair for the interest, and sometimes a pair for the fees. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Investment and Prepaid Expense Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-investments-and-prepaid.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الاستثمار والمصروفات المقدمة): Investments and prepaid expenses have one thing in common: the value on day one is not the value that ends up in profit and loss. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Supply Chain

- [Supply Chain](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/) (ar: سلسلة التوريد): Welcome to the Supply Chain Management module - the heart of how NaMa ERP helps you track, manage, and control the flow of goods through your organization.
- [Understanding Inventory Items](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/understanding-items.html) (ar: فهم أصناف المخزون (Understanding Inventory Items)): Let's talk about Items - the building blocks of the entire supply chain system. - entities: InvItem - menu: Inventory → Master Files → Item
- [Creating and Maintaining Items](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/item-maintenance.html) (ar: إنشاء الأصناف وصيانتها (Creating and Maintaining Items)): This page covers the screens that surround the item card — opening items in bulk, changing them after the fact, deciding who is allowed to buy them, and telling the warehouse where they belong. - entities: InvItemOpiningRequest, MultiItemCreator, ItemConfigurations, InvItemUpdate, ItemCustomerLink, ItemSupplierLink, ItemRelations, ItemStorageAllocation
- [Item Classification Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/item-classification-files.html) (ar: ملفات تصنيف الأصناف (Item Classification Files)): Ask two people to organise the same catalogue of five thousand items and you will get two different answers. - entities: ItemClass1, ItemCategory, ItemSection, ItemBrand, ItemColor, ItemSize, ItemColorClassification, ItemSizeClassification, ItemRevisionFile, ItemSizeColorCollection, ItemAssortment
