- [Units of Measure](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/units-of-measure.html) (ar: وحدات القياس (Units of Measure)): Nama holds every item's stock in one single unit and lets each document speak a different one, so a distributor can buy a product by the carton, sell it by the piece and report on it by the litre without anyone doing the arithmetic by hand. - entities: UOM, UOMGroup, UOMConversions, StandardMeasures, CalculationFormula, InvItem
- [Warehouses & Locators](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/warehouses-and-locators.html) (ar: المخازن والمواقع التخزينية (Warehouses & Locators)): You've defined your items - great. - entities: Warehouse, Locator, WarehouseUsagePolicy, PreventUsingBatch, WarehouseGroup, WareLocationClass, ItemWarehouseRelation - menu: Inventory → Master Files → Warehouse
- [The Anatomy of a Supply Chain Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/the-document-screen.html) (ar: تشريح مستند سلسلة التوريد (The Anatomy of a Supply Chain Document)): Every supply chain document — a sales invoice, a purchase invoice, an order, a stock receipt, an issue, a transfer — is built from the same handful of parts... - entities: SalesInvoice, PurchaseInvoice
- [Receiving Stock](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/receiving-stock.html) (ar: استلام المخزون في المستودع (Receiving Stock)): Inventory doesn't magically appear in your warehouse - it arrives through various means and for various reasons. - entities: StockReceipt, StockReceiptReq, InitialReceipt, PurgeStockReceipt, ReceiptInspection, StockReceiptCancellation, OpeningStockDocument - menu: Inventory → Receipt Documents → Stock Receipt
- [Issuing Stock](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/issuing-stock.html) (ar: إصدار المخزون من المستودع (Issuing Stock)): What goes in must come out! - entities: StockIssue, StockIssueReq, ItemCuttingDoc - menu: Inventory → Receipt Documents → Stock Issue
- [Moving Stock Between Warehouses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/moving-stock.html) (ar: تحريك المخزون بين المخازن (Moving Stock)): Sometimes items don't come in or go out - they just move from one place to another. - entities: StockTransfer, IssueStockTransfer, ReceiptStockTransfer, StockTransferReq, AggrStockTransferReq - menu: Inventory → Stock transfer Docs → Stock Transfer
- [Stock Taking](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/stock-taking.html) (ar: الجرد المخزني (Stock Taking)): No matter how accurate your system is, one fundamental question remains: does what's in the books actually match what's on the shelves? - entities: StartStockTaking, EndStockTaking, StockTakingDetails, StockTakingElectronic, ItemVotingDoc, ItemVotingFile
- [Inventory Costing & Revaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/inventory-costing.html) (ar: تكلفة المخزون وإعادة التقييم (Inventory Costing & Revaluation)): Inventory quantity is only half the truth; the other half is its value. - entities: ReceiptAdditionalCost, CostRevaluation, FinishedProductPricing, FrozenCostAccounts
- [The Purchasing Journey](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/purchasing-journey.html) (ar: رحلة الشراء (The Purchasing Journey)): Let's follow the complete story of how items get purchased - from "we need something" to "it's in our warehouse and we've paid for it." - entities: PurchaseOrder, PurchaseInvoice, ItemRequest, PurchaseQuotation, PurchaseQuotationRequest, PurchasePriceComparing, ConsolidatedPurchaseReq, PurchaseReturn, PurchaseReturnReq, ProformaPurchaseInvoice, PurchaseDocumentUpdate
- [How a Purchase Price Is Decided](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/purchase-pricing.html) (ar: كيف يُحدَّد سعر الشراء (How a Purchase Price Is Decided)): Every purchase order and purchase invoice line needs a unit price, and in most companies nobody types it by hand: the figure arrives from a Purchase Price List, gets cut down by a Vendor Discount agreement... - entities: PurchasePriceList, VendorDiscount, InvoiceClassification
- [Purchase Forecast](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/purchase-forecast.html) (ar: التنبؤ بالمشتريات (Purchase Forecast)): The best purchase is the one made before you run out, not after. - entities: NewPurchaseForecast, PurchaseForecastConfig, PFSalesSourceConfig, PFQuantitySource - menu: Purchases → New Purchase Forecast → New Purchase Forecast
- [The Sales Journey](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/sales-journey.html) (ar: رحلة المبيعات (The Sales Journey)): The sales journey is the mirror image of purchasing - instead of bringing items in, you're selling and delivering them to customers. - entities: SalesInvoice, SalesOrder, SalesQuotation, SalesQuotationRequest, ProformaSalesInvoice, SalesReturn, SalesReturnRequest, SalesReplacement, SalesForecast
- [Sales and Purchase Operations Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/sales-operations-documents.html) (ar: مستندات العمليات في المبيعات والمشتريات (Sales and Purchase Operations Documents)): Eight small screens sit around the trading cycle, each doing exactly one job: parking a shortage the salesman just hit, swapping goods under approval, releasing a reservation, moving a batch of customers to another salesman... - entities: CustomersReqsShortageDoc, SalesReplacementReq, ReservationCancellationDoc, SalesManUpdateDocument, PurchaseOrderStatusChange, LimitSalesQty, DiscountUpdate, DiscountsReCalcDocument
- [Pricing, Offers & Coupons](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/pricing-offers-and-coupons.html) (ar: التسعير والعروض والكوبونات (Pricing, Offers & Coupons)): The price a customer pays isn't a single number, but the result of several layers: a price list, a quantity discount, a promotional offer, and maybe a coupon. - entities: SalesPriceList, SalesOffers, DiscountCoupon, PostSalesOffer, PostSalesOfferConfig, PostSalesOfferClaim, PriceVotingDoc, PricingRange, AutoSalesPricing, SalesPriceInPoints, FreeItemGroup, PeriodicMonthlySalesOffer, DiscountCouponType, DiscountCouponBook, SalesCouponsCodingMethod, CouponsSalesOrder, CouponsSalesOrderReturn, PriceVotingFile, AutoSalesPricingSetting, Season, UpdateSeasonsDoc
- [Offer Apply Rules](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/offer-apply-rules.html) (ar: قواعد تطبيق العروض (Offer Apply Rules)): An Offer Apply Rule is a named, reusable filter that tells an invoice-level promotion which lines of a document it is actually about. - entities: OfferApplyRules - menu: Sales → Prices And Offers → Offer Apply Rules
- [Comprehensive Reservation System Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/reservation-system-guide.html) (ar: دليل نظام الحجوزات الشامل (Comprehensive Reservation System Guide)): This guide provides comprehensive documentation for the Reservation System in Nama ERP, intended for technical support staff and system administrators. - entities: ReservationDocument - menu: Inventory → Reservation Documents → Reservation Document
- [Delivery & Loading](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/delivery-and-loading.html) (ar: التسليم والتحميل (Delivery & Loading)): Between confirming the sales order and issuing the invoice lies the physical stage: preparing the goods, loading them, getting them to the customer, and obtaining proof of receipt. - entities: DeliveryDocument, LoadingDocument, DeliveryQueue, PickRules, DeliveryCancellationDoc, LoadingCancellationDoc, DeliveryQueueConfiguration, DeliveryDriverConfig, DeliveryOrganization

- [Multi-Level and Aggregated Assembly](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/assembly-and-packaging/multi-level-and-aggregated-assembly.html) (ar: التجميع متعدد المستويات والتعبئة المجمّعة (Multi-Level and Aggregated Assembly)): A single Assembly Document builds one product from its components. - entities: MultiAssemblyDoc, AggrAssemblyDocument
- [Processing Documents & Assembly Machines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/assembly-and-packaging/processing-documents-and-machines.html) (ar: سندات المعالجة وماكينات التجميع (Processing Documents & Assembly Machines)): Some work is better described by the machine than by the recipe. - entities: ProcessingDoc, AssemblyMachine - menu: Inventory → Assembly Documents → Processing Document
- [Quality Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/quality-control.html) (ar: ضبط الجودة (Quality Control)): Not everything that arrives meets your standards, and not everything you produce is ready for the customer. - entities: QualityControlDoc, QualityControlReq, QualityAssuranceDoc, QualityAssuranceReq, QualityCheckList, QuestionClassification
- [Import Letters of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/letters-of-credit.html) (ar: الاعتمادات المستندية للاستيراد (Letters of Credit)): When you import goods from a supplier abroad, both parties need a guarantee: the supplier wants assured payment, and you want assured conforming shipment. - entities: LetterOfCredit, LCShipment, LCOpeningDoc, LcExpenseDocument, LetterOfCreditRequest, LCOpeningRequest, LCCostDoc, LCAction, LCProformaInvoice, LCShipmentProformaInvoice - menu: LC → Master Files → Letter Of Credit
- [Weight Scale](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/weight-scale.html) (ar: موازين الوزن (Weight Scale)): In facilities that handle bulk materials sold or received by weight - grains, concrete, aggregates, metals - the scale becomes part of the workflow. - entities: WeightScaleConfig, WeightScalePreparationDoc, WeightScalePrepGenerator - menu: Inventory → Weight Scale → Weight Scale Configuration
- [Specialized Scenarios](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/specialized-scenarios.html) (ar: سيناريوهات متخصصة (Specialized Scenarios)): The previous pages cover the core supply chain paths. - entities: GlassJobOrder, GlassJobOrderReq, GlassOperationMap, ServiceItemBOM, OrderExecution, GlassJobOrderStatusUpdate, OrderDelivery, OrderFinished, OutsourceRequest, OutsourceIssue, OutsourceReceipt, OrderDamage, JOrderExpense, Tender, TenderCondition, SCDocRuleSet, SCExtraDocCreationRule, SCCopierExtraFields, OrderStatusQtyTrackConfig, DeliveryConfiguration, Resource, Activity, MaterialClassification
- [Ignoring Specific Warehouses/Locators in Reservation Quantity Check by Date](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/ignore-reservation-qty-check-by-date.html) (ar: تجاهل مخازن/مواقع معينة في التحقق من كمية الحجز بالتاريخ): This feature allows you to exclude specific warehouses or locators from the overdraft-by-date check calculation when performing Reservation operations only. - entities: Warehouse, Locator, ConfigEntry
- [Supply Chain and Sales Reports](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/supplychain-reports.html) (ar: تقارير سلسلة التوريد والمبيعات (Supply Chain and Sales Reports)): A document answers one question at a time: what is on this invoice, what did this receipt bring in.
