#### Development Request Notes

- [Development Request Notes](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/development-requests/) (ar: ملاحظات طلبات التطوير): Every now and then a client asks for something that changes how a core part of the Supply Chain module behaves — not a bug fix, but a deliberate new capability that touches inventory, costing, or document validation.
- [Allowing Items With Batch & Expiry to Hold Untagged Quantities](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/development-requests/allow-empty-item-dimensions-before-date.html) (ar: السماح للأصناف ذات الدفعات وتواريخ الصلاحية بحمل كميات غير موسومة (Allowing Items With Batch & Expiry to Hold Untagged Quantities)): Development Request: SRDRQ06261 (Dar Al-Emirate Trading Company) - entities: ItemConfigurations - menu: Inventory → Settings → Item Configurations
- [Stock Receipts for the Unsatisfied Part of a Purchase Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/development-requests/stock-receipt-for-unsatisfied-order-quantities.html) (ar: سند توريد مخزني للجزء غير المنفّذ من أمر الشراء (Stock Receipts for the Unsatisfied Part of a Purchase Order)): Development Request: SRDRQ06178 - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

#### Configuration

- [Configuration (Modules › Supply Chain)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/) (ar: إعدادات سلسلة التوريد): The Supply Chain module has a single, large configuration file that controls how inventory, purchasing, sales, costing, and stock documents behave across the whole system.
- [Costing Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/costing-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات التكلفة (Costing Configuration)): This page documents the Costing tab of the Supply Chain configuration. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Overdraft & Quantity Checking Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/overdraft-and-quantity-checking.html) (ar: إعدادات السحب على المكشوف والتأكد من الكميات): This page documents the Overdraft & Quantity Checking tab. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Quantity Suggestion Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/quantity-suggestion-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات اقتراح الكميات (Quantity Suggestion Configuration)): This page documents the Quantity Suggestion tab. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Item Properties Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/item-properties-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات خصائص الصنف): This page documents the Item Properties tab. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Items & Master Data Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/items-and-master-data-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات الأصناف والبيانات الرئيسية): This page documents the Items & Master Data tab — settings that affect the item master, item codes and coding, item search (including button/level browsers), the item–warehouse–locator relationships, and item links to customers and suppliers. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Purchasing Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/purchasing-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات المشتريات): This page documents the Purchasing tab — settings that affect purchase orders, purchase invoices, purchase returns, and the letter-of-credit / proforma workflow. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Sales & Offers Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/sales-and-offers-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات المبيعات والعروض): This page documents the Sales & Offers tab — settings for sales documents, offers and coupons, discounts, free items, and the price classifiers used in pricing. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Pricing & Price Lists Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/pricing-and-price-lists.html) (ar: إعدادات التسعير وقوائم الأسعار): This page documents the Pricing & Price Lists tab — how the system falls back to the last price an item was traded at, how price lists behave, and the default units for new items. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Documents & Details Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/documents-and-details-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات المستندات والتفاصيل): This page documents the Documents & Details tab — how stock document lines are laid out, which dimensions can be entered per line, the extra columns and grids you can add to documents, delivery handling, and warehouse/locator filtering. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Stock Taking Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/stock-taking-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات الجرد المخزني): This page documents the Stock Taking tab — settings that govern how physical counts (stock taking) are entered, validated, ended, and turned into adjustment documents. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Stock Ages Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/stock-ages-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات أعمار المخزون): This page documents the Stock Ages tab. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Item Barcode Specifications](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/item-barcode-specifications.html) (ar: مواصفات باركود الصنف): This page documents the Barcode Specifications tab — the rules that tell the system how to read a composite/structured barcode and turn it into an item plus its properties and quantity. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations

#### Document Terms

- [Document Terms (Modules › Supply Chain)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات المستندات): A Document Term (توجيه المستند) is the main mechanism for customizing how a Supply Chain document type behaves.
- [General Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-general.html) (ar: إعدادات عامة (General)): A Document Term (توجيه المستند) is the main mechanism for customizing how a document type behaves in Nama — one document type can have several terms, each shaping its validation, generation, pricing, accounting and more. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [From-Document Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-from-document.html) (ar: إعدادات النسخ من المستند (From-Document)): The from document (بناءً على) is the source document a new document is created from — for example a Sales Order that a Sales Invoice is built on. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Sub-Item Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-sub-item.html) (ar: إعدادات الصنف الفرعي (Sub-Item)): A sub-item (الصنف الفرعي) is a serialized/tracked sub-unit of an item that carries its own warehouse, locator, taxes, status and back-links to the documents that created or touched it. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Quantity Tracking Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-quantity-tracking.html) (ar: إعدادات متابعة الكميات (Quantity Tracking)): These settings control quantity tracking — the engine that links documents and records how much of a source document has been satisfied by the documents created from it (for example, how much of a Sales Order has been invoiced or delivered). - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Reservation & Delivery System](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-reservation-and-delivery.html) (ar: الحجز ونظام التسليم (Reservation & Delivery System)): These settings control how a document reserves stock for its lines and how it participates in the delivery system — the system table that tracks an order through reservation, loading, and final delivery. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Pricing, Taxes & Discounts Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-pricing-taxes-discounts.html) (ar: إعدادات الأسعار والضرائب والخصومات (Pricing, Taxes & Discounts)): This tab controls how unit prices, discounts, and taxes are calculated on documents created under the term — whether they are forced from price lists, recalculated on save, locked after a from-document, or excluded from item cost. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Accounting Effects Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-accounting-effects.html) (ar: إعدادات التأثيرات المحاسبية (Accounting Effects)): Supply Chain documents that carry accounting effects post to the general ledger through configurable debit and credit account sides. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Generation & Dimensions Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-generation-and-dimensions.html) (ar: إعدادات التوليد والمحددات (Generation & Dimensions)): This page covers two related areas of the supply-chain Document Term: how a document automatically generates downstream documents (on commit, or auto/async on save), and how the document's accounting dimensions (محددات: branch, sector, department... - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Document-Specific Options](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-document-specific.html) (ar: خيارات خاصة بأنواع المستندات (Document-Specific)): Most term-config options are shared across document types and are covered on the other pages (General, From-Document, Quantity Tracking, Reservation & Delivery, Pricing/Taxes/Discounts, Sub-Item). - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Freight Management

- [Freight Management](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/) (ar: إدارة الشحن): Welcome to the Freight Management module of Nama ERP — the module built specifically for shipping, forwarding, customs-clearance, postal, and logistics companies, where the "goods" you sell aren't items on a shelf but a service...
- [Freight Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-master-files.html) (ar: الملفات الأساسية لإدارة الشحن): Before you create your first operation order, you need to define the building blocks every shipment is made of: which services you offer, in which containers, on which vessels, and to and from which ports. - entities: FRMServiceItem, FRMContainer, FRMContainerType, FRMContainerSize, FRMOceanVessel, ShippingPort, FRMSailingSchedule, FRMCommodity, FRMBillOfLadingType, FRMUOM, FRMCountry, FRMLocation
- [Operation Orders](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/operation-orders.html) (ar: أوامر التشغيل (Operation Orders)): The operation order is the heart of the Freight Management module. - entities: FRMOperationOrder, FRMOOStatus, FRMOODelivery, FRMOOReceipt, FRMOOTransfer - menu: Freight Management System → Documents → FRM Operation Order
- [Bills of Lading](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/bills-of-lading.html) (ar: بوالص الشحن (Bills of Lading)): The bill of lading is the official shipping document that proves the carrier's receipt of the goods and the terms of their carriage and delivery. - entities: FRMBillOfLading - menu: Freight Management System → Documents → Bill of Lading
- [Price Lists & Markups](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-pricing.html) (ar: قوائم الأسعار والهوامش): A freight company profits from the difference between what it pays suppliers for a service and what it sells it to the customer for. - entities: FRMSalesPriceList, FRMPurchasePriceList, FRMEditPurchasePriceList
- [From Supplier Rates to Customer Quotations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-price-list-workflow.html) (ar: من أسعار الموردين إلى عروض أسعار العملاء): Price Lists & Markups explains what the two price lists hold. - entities: FRMPurchasePriceList, FRMPPriceListElement, FRMSalesPriceList, FRMSPriceListElement, FRMEditPurchasePriceList
- [Invoices & Returns](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-invoicing.html) (ar: الفواتير والمرتجعات): This is where operational work turns into financial effect: you sell services to the customer, buy them from suppliers, and track the difference between the two. - entities: FRMSalesInvoice, FRMPurchaseInvoice, FRMSalesOrder, FRMSalesReturn, FRMPurchaseReturn
- [Storage Locations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-storage-locations.html) (ar: مواقع التخزين (Storage Locations)): Some freight companies do more than book space on a ship: they hold the cargo themselves — in a yard, a bonded warehouse or a cold store — between the day it arrives and the day it leaves. - entities: FRMLocation, FRMLocationSection, FRMLocationClass, FRMLocationType, FRMOOReceipt, FRMOOTransfer, FRMOODelivery, FRMOOStatus
- [E-Invoicing in the Freight Module](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-einvoicing.html) (ar: التعامل مع الفاتورة الإلكترونية في وحدة الشحن): The freight module's invoices plug into Nama ERP's e-invoicing framework exactly like ordinary sales invoices — they are Tax Authority Documents sent to the relevant authority (ZATCA in Saudi Arabia, the Egyptian Tax Authority, the UAE system…). - entities: FRMSalesInvoice, FRMServiceItem
- [International Postal System (IPS) — Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-postal-intro.html) (ar: نظام البريد الدولي (IPS) — نظرة عامة): Alongside freight and logistics, the Freight Management module includes a complete system for running International Postal System (IPS) operations. - entities: IPSMailClass, IPSMailCategory, IPSMailSubclass, IPSMailCondition, IPSParcelStatus, IPSDeliveryAndReceiptArea, IPSMailRetentionReason, IPSNonDeliveryReason, IPSNonDeliveryMeasure, IPSEvent
- [Mail Items](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-mail-items.html) (ar: المواد البريدية): After the inbound receptacles are opened, the mail item becomes the focus of the work: it's recorded, transferred between offices, adjusted, stock-taken, and sorted for delivery. - entities: IPSMailItemManifest, IPSPostalParcelsSort, IPSMailItemTransfer, IPSMailItemAdjustment, IPSMailItemStockTaking, IPSMailRetentionDocument
- [Receptacles](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-receptacles.html) (ar: الأكياس البريدية (Receptacles)): A receptacle is the transport container that gathers several mail items for movement between offices — a sealed bag or box. - entities: IPSReceptaclesReceipt, IPSManifestForCustody, IPSTransferReceptacles
- [Delivery Service](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-delivery.html) (ar: خدمة التوصيل (Delivery)): The final stage in a mail item's journey: delivering it to the customer and collecting the service value and any customs fees. - entities: IPSDeliveryRequest, IPSDeliveryInvoice, IPSDeliveryServiceItem, IPSDeliveryServicePrice
- [IPS Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع نظام IPS (IPS Integration)): A postal operator does not track mail on its own. - entities: IPSEvent, IPSReceptaclesReceipt, IPSTransferReceptacles, IPSMailItemManifest, IPSManifestForCustody, IPSMailRetentionDocument, IPSMailItemTransfer, IPSMailItemStockTaking, IPSMailItemAdjustment, IPSPostalParcelsSort
- [Freight Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات وحدة الشحن (Freight Configuration)): The freight module keeps a short list of module-wide settings in one screen: which service item to fall back on when a price-list line carries none, how storage locations are suggested and checked... - menu: Freight Management System → Settings → Freight Management System Settings
- [Freight Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-document-terms.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الشحن (Freight Document Terms)): Every freight and postal document is saved under a document term, and the term is where the document's behaviour is decided: which accounts it books to, which status it stamps on the operation order, which postal event it reports... - entities: DocumentTerm, FRMSalesInvoice, FRMSalesReturn, FRMSalesOrder, FRMPurchaseInvoice, FRMPurchaseReturn, FRMOperationOrder, FRMOOReceipt, FRMOOTransfer, FRMOODelivery, IPSDeliveryRequest, IPSDeliveryInvoice, IPSMailItemManifest, IPSMailItemTransfer, IPSMailItemStockTaking, IPSMailItemAdjustment, IPSManifestForCustody, IPSMailRetentionDocument, IPSPostalParcelsSort, IPSReceptaclesReceipt, IPSTransferReceptacles - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Hospital Management System

- [Hospital Management System](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/) (ar: نظام إدارة المستشفيات): Welcome to the Hospital Management module of Nama ERP — the module that runs the full patient lifecycle: from the moment a patient is registered, through admission and a bed assignment, then consultations, lab tests, radiology and surgeries...
- [Hospital Management System Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات نظام إدارة المستشفيات): The hospital module has one settings record, and it is small: seventeen options on a single tab. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Hospital Management System → Settings → Hospital Management System Settings
- [Hospital Structure & Rooms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-facility.html) (ar: هيكل المستشفى والغرف): Before you admit your first patient, you need to map your building inside the system: which buildings you have, their floors and sections, which rooms and beds they hold, and which clinics operate. - entities: HMSRoom, HMSRoomClassification, HMSBed, HMSSection, HMSBuilding, HMSFloor, HMSClinic, HMSRoomDegree - menu: Hospital Management System → Hospital Structure → HMS Room
- [Medical Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-medical-master-files.html) (ar: الملفات الطبية الأساسية): Having mapped the building, we now define the staff and medical concepts that the documents work with every day: doctors, specialties, diseases, medical services, analyzers, feeding, and patient classes. - entities: HMSDoctor, HMSMedicalService, HMSMedicalSpecialty, HMSMedServiceCategory, HMSDisease, HMSAntibiotic, HMSMedicalDevice, HMSFeedingType, HMSPatientClass, HMSDocumentCategory, HMSProcedureType - menu: Hospital Management System → Master Files → Doctor
- [Medical Service Catalog](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-service-catalog.html) (ar: كتالوج الخدمات الطبية): Alongside general medical services, the hospital keeps specialized catalogs for each kind of clinical activity: lab tests, radiology, physiotherapy, and surgeries. - entities: HMSLabTestType, HMSRadiologyType, HMSSurgeryType, HMSPhysicalTherapyType, HMSSurgeryPackage, HMSPackageItem, HMSLabTestCategory, HMSRadiologyCategory, HMSPhyTherapyCategory, HMSSurgeryClassification, HMSTest, HMSTestTube, HMSTestTubeColor - menu: Hospital Management System → Laboratory Tests → Laboratory Test Type
- [Medical Insurance & Approvals](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-insurance.html) (ar: التأمين الطبي والموافقات): Insurance is what makes hospital billing different: the patient rarely pays the whole bill. - entities: InsuranceCompanyApproval, HMSInsuranceCompany, HMSInsuranceClass, HMSInsuranceCompanyClass - menu: Hospital Management System → Master Files → Insurance Company Approval
- [Pricing, Costing & Discounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-pricing.html) (ar: الأسعار والتكاليف والخصومات): Every hospital service has a selling price and a cost. - entities: HMSSalesPriceList, HMSCostList, HMSDiscount, HMSOverheadItem, HMSOverheadList, HMSActualOverheadCalculation, HMSChangePatientPricePlan - menu: Hospital Management System → Master Files → Medical Sales Price List
- [Patients & Admission](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-patients.html) (ar: المرضى والدخول): This is where the patient's journey really begins. - entities: HMSPatient, HMSPatientAdmission, HMSOutpatientReservation, HMSOutpatientSchedule, HMSPatientDiagnosis, HMSPatientHealthStatus, HMSQuestionnaireTemplate, HMSQuestion - menu: Hospital Management System → Master Files → Patient
- [Accommodation & Feeding](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-accommodation.html) (ar: التسكين والتغذية): Once admitted, a patient needs a bed and meals. - entities: HMSAccommodation, HMSAccommodationTransfer, HMSAccommodationExit, HMSFeedingIssue - menu: Hospital Management System → Documents → Accommodation
- [Clinical Orders & Results](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-clinical-orders.html) (ar: الطلبات والنتائج الإكلينيكية): During a patient's stay (or an outpatient visit), the doctor orders investigations and procedures: lab tests, radiology, surgeries. - entities: HMSLabTestRequest, HMSLabTestResult, HMSRadiologyReq, HMSRadiologyResult, HMSSurgeryReq, HMSSurgeryReservation, HMSSurgeryApproval, HMSBloodBank, HMSBloodBankReturn - menu: Hospital Management System → Laboratory Tests → Lab Test Request
- [The Surgery Lifecycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-surgery-lifecycle.html) (ar: دورة العملية الجراحية): An operation touches more screens than any other service in the hospital. - entities: HMSSurgeryReq, HMSSurgeryReservation, HMSSurgeryApproval, HMSSurgeryInvoice, HMSSurgeryPackage, HMSSurgeryPackageInvoice - menu: Hospital Management System → Surgeries → Surgery Request
- [Pharmacy, Supplies & Blood Bank](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-pharmacy-and-supplies.html) (ar: الصيدلية والمستلزمات وبنك الدم): Most hospital invoices sell something you cannot put on a shelf — a consultation, a night in a room, an X-ray. - entities: HMSPharmacyInvoice, HMSPharmacyReturn, HMSPharmacy, HMSSuppliesInvoice, HMSSupplyReturn, HMSServiceSupplyInvoice, HMSBloodBankInvoice, HMSBloodBankReturn, HMSBloodBank - menu: Hospital Management System → Pharmacies → Pharmacy Invoice
- [Invoicing & Billing](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-invoicing.html) (ar: الفواتير والمحاسبة): Billing is the hospital's financial backbone. - entities: HMSClosingInvoice, HMSSurgeryInvoice, HMSSurgeryPackageInvoice, HMSAccommodationInvoice, HMSPatientCheckInvoice, HMSLabTestInvoice, HMSRadiologyInvoice, HMSPhysicalTherapyInvoice, HMSSupervisionInvoice, HMSServicesInvoice, HMSAttendantInvoice, HMSPharmacyInvoice, HMSPharmacyReturn, HMSSuppliesInvoice, HMSSupplyReturn, HMSServiceSupplyInvoice, HMSBloodBankInvoice

#### Document Terms

- [Document Terms (Modules › Hospital Management System)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات المستندات)
- [Invoice Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/document-terms/hms-terms-invoices.html) (ar: توجيهات فواتير المستشفى): A hospital invoice posts nothing on its own. - entities: HMSPatientCheckInvoice, HMSAttendantInvoice, HMSLabTestInvoice, HMSRadiologyInvoice, HMSPhysicalTherapyInvoice, HMSServicesInvoice, HMSSupervisionInvoice, HMSAccommodationInvoice, HMSSurgeryInvoice, HMSPharmacyInvoice, HMSPharmacyReturn, HMSSuppliesInvoice, HMSSupplyReturn, HMSServiceSupplyInvoice, HMSBloodBankInvoice, HMSBloodBankReturn - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Stay and Operations Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/document-terms/hms-terms-stay-and-operations.html) (ar: توجيهات الإقامة والعمليات): An inpatient's stay is a chain of documents that create other documents: the admission creates the accommodation, the accommodation creates the accommodation invoices, the accommodation invoice creates the supervision invoice... - entities: HMSPatientAdmission, HMSAccommodation, HMSAccommodationTransfer, HMSAccommodationExit, HMSClosingInvoice, HMSSurgeryPackageInvoice, HMSSurgeryReservation, HMSFeedingIssue - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Manufacturing

- [Manufacturing](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/) (ar: التصنيع): Manufacturing is where raw materials become finished goods — and where Nama ERP helps you plan that transformation, record what actually happened on the shop floor, and put a real cost on every unit you produce.
- [Manufacturing Module Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/manufacturing-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على وحدة التصنيع (Manufacturing Module Overview)): Think about how products get made in the real world.
- [Manufacturing Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/manufacturing-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات التصنيع): Most of how a manufacturing document behaves is decided on its document term. - entities: ConfigEntry - licence: manufacturing, manufacturing-mrp
- [Bill of Materials: The Recipe for a Product](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/manufacturing-bom.html) (ar: مكونات المنتج (BOM): وصفة تصنيع المنتج): Nothing else in the manufacturing module works until the system knows what a product is made of. - entities: BOM - menu: Manufacturing → Master Files → BOM - licence: manufacturing
- [Routings: The Steps a Product Goes Through](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/manufacturing-routing.html) (ar: مسارات التشغيل: الخطوات التي يمر بها المنتج): A bill of materials tells you what a product is made of. - entities: Routing - menu: Manufacturing → Master Files → Routing - licence: manufacturing
- [Work Centers and Standard Operations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/manufacturing-work-centers.html) (ar: صالات الإنتاج والعمليات القياسية): A routing lists the steps a product goes through, but it doesn't want to carry every detail about each one. - entities: WorkCenter, StandardOperation - licence: manufacturing
- [Production Order Requests: Asking for Something to Be Made](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/production-order-request.html) (ar: طلبات أوامر الإنتاج: أن تطلب تصنيع شيء): In a small workshop the person who decides what to make is the person who makes it, and a production order raised directly is the whole story. - entities: ProductionOrderRequest - menu: Manufacturing → Documents → Production Order Request - licence: manufacturing
- [Production Orders: Planning What to Make](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/production-orders.html) (ar: أوامر الإنتاج (Production Orders): التخطيط لما سيتم تصنيعه): A Production Order (أمر إنتاج) is your formal instruction to the factory: "Make this product, in this quantity, by this date." - entities: ProductionOrder, AggregatedProductionOrder - menu: Manufacturing → Documents → Production Order - licence: manufacturing
- [Production Execution: Recording What Actually Happens](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/production-execution.html) (ar: تنفيذ الإنتاج (Production Execution): تسجيل ما يحدث فعلاً): You've created a production order - that's your plan. - entities: ProductionExecution - menu: Manufacturing → Documents → Production Execution - licence: manufacturing
- [Issuing and Returning Raw Materials](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/raw-material-issue.html) (ar: صرف المواد الخام وإرتجاعها): A production order plans what a job will consume. - entities: RawMaterialIssue, RawMaterialReturn, RawMaterialChangeDoc - menu: Manufacturing → Documents → Raw Materials Issue - licence: manufacturing
- [Resource Vouchers: Charging Machine and Labour Time](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/manufacturing-resource-voucher.html) (ar: سندات الموارد: تحميل زمن الماكينات والعمالة): Issue the copper, the insulation and the tape to a job and you have accounted for what the product is physically made of. - entities: ResourceVoucher - menu: Manufacturing → Documents → Resource Voucher - licence: manufacturing
- [Scrap Receipts: Booking Waste Back Into Stock](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/scrap-receipt.html) (ar: إستلام التالف: إدخال المخلفات إلى المخزون): Cut a 3-metre copper pipe into the lengths a job needs and you are left with offcuts. - entities: ScrapReceipt - menu: Manufacturing → Documents → Scrap Receipt - licence: manufacturing
- [Production Costing: Following the Money](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/production-costing.html) (ar: تكاليف الإنتاج: تتبع الأموال): Here's a question that keeps manufacturing managers up at night: How much did it actually cost to make that product? - entities: OrderCloseVoucher, OverheadType, ActualOverheadCalculator, ActualProductionOverhead - menu: Manufacturing → Documents → Order Close - licence: manufacturing
- [Material Requirements Planning: Working Out What to Buy and When](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/material-requirements-planning.html) (ar: تخطيط احتياجات المواد: ماذا تشتري ومتى): A customer orders 50 desks for delivery in six weeks. - entities: MRPDocument, Scenario, MRPAvailableQtySource - menu: Manufacturing → Material Resource Planning → planning raw materials Document - licence: manufacturing-mrp, manufacturing
- [Manufacturing Molds: Tooling That Wears Out](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/manufacturing-molds.html) (ar: قوالب التصنيع: عُدَدٌ تَبلى): A press die for an air-conditioner bracket costs 180,000. - entities: MFGMold, MFGMoldReceipt, MFGMoldVoucher, MFGMoldDisposal, MFGMoldLocation - menu: Manufacturing → Manufacturing Molds → Manufacturing Mold - licence: manufacturing-molds, manufacturing
- [Carton Manufacturing: Smart Material Planning for Corrugated Products](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/carton-manufacturing-overview.html) (ar: تصنيع الكرتون: تخطيط ذكي للمواد في منتجات الورق المموج): If you make corrugated cartons, you know the problem intimately: You buy paper rolls in standard widths - maybe 1800mm, 2000mm, 2200mm. - licence: manufacturing-crtn-pln, manufacturing
- [Carton Specifications: Defining Your Products](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/carton-specifications.html) (ar: مواصفات الكرتونة: تعريف منتجاتك): Think of a carton specification as the complete blueprint for a carton product. - entities: CRTNSpecification - menu: Manufacturing → Cartoon → CRTN Specification - licence: manufacturing-crtn-pln, manufacturing
- [Carton Orders: From Customer Request to Production Plan](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/carton-orders.html) (ar: طلبيات الكرتون (Carton Orders): من طلب العميل إلى خطة الإنتاج): A carton order is your sales document - it's how customers purchase cartons from you. - entities: CRTNOrder - menu: Manufacturing → Cartoon → Carton Order - licence: manufacturing-crtn-pln, manufacturing
- [Carton Material Planning: The Optimization Engine](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/carton-material-planning.html) (ar: تخطيط خامات الكرتون: محرك التحسين): This is where Nama ERP earns its keep in carton manufacturing. - entities: CRTNMaterialPlanning, CRTNPlanningConfiguration - menu: Manufacturing → Cartoon → CRTN Material Planning - licence: manufacturing-crtn-pln, manufacturing
- [Carton Material Issues: From Store to Shop Floor](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/carton-material-issue.html) (ar: صرف خامات الكرتون: من المخزن إلى صالة الإنتاج): You have a material planning document. - entities: CRTNMaterialIssue - menu: Manufacturing → Cartoon → Carton Material Issue - licence: manufacturing-crtn-pln, manufacturing

#### Document Terms

- [Document Terms (Modules › Manufacturing)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات المستندات)
- [Production Order and Planning Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/document-terms/mfg-terms-production-orders.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات أوامر الإنتاج والتخطيط): Every manufacturing document has a document term (توجيه المستند) behind it, and the term is where most of the module's rules live: whether an order may be saved without a BOM, which book a generated delivery is written into... - entities: ProductionOrder, ProductionOrderRequest, AggregatedProductionOrder, AggregatedProductDelivery, AggregatedProductionOrderClosing, MRPDocument - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term - licence: manufacturing, manufacturing-mrp
- [Execution and Delivery Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/document-terms/mfg-terms-execution-and-delivery.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات التنفيذ والتسليم): The documents on this page record what happened on the shop floor and what came off it: the production execution, the product delivery and return, the scrap receipt and the production sample. - entities: ProductionExecution, ProductDelivery, ProductReturn, ScrapReceipt, ProductionSampleDoc - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term - licence: manufacturing, manufacturing-molds
- [Raw Material Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/document-terms/mfg-terms-materials.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات المواد الخام): Raw materials leave the store on a Raw Materials Issue, come back on a Raw Materials Return, may be asked for first on a request, and are trued up against a count on a Manufacturing Stock Taking. - entities: RawMaterialIssue, RawMaterialReturn, RawMaterialIssueReq, RawMaterialReturnReq, ManufacturingStockTaking - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term - licence: manufacturing
- [Costing, Resource and Mold Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/document-terms/mfg-terms-costing.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات التكاليف والموارد والقوالب): Most manufacturing documents move quantities and leave the money to the stock documents they generate. - entities: OrderCloseVoucher, ResourceVoucher, ManufacturingStandardPrice, MFGMoldReceipt, MFGMoldVoucher, MFGMoldDisposal - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term - licence: manufacturing, manufacturing-molds
- [Carton Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/document-terms/mfg-terms-carton.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الكرتون): The carton chain is a relay: a Carton Order hands over to a Carton Material Planning document, the planning document creates production orders, and a Carton Material Issue creates the raw materials issue that takes the paper out of the store. - entities: CRTNOrder, CRTNMaterialPlanning, CRTNMaterialIssue - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term - licence: manufacturing-crtn-pln
- [Frequently Asked Questions — Manufacturing Module in Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/manufacturing-faq.html) (ar: أسئلة شائعة حول موديول التصنيع في نظام Nama ERP): You can achieve this through an Entity Flow (مسار كيان) that executes during the production order save operation. - entities: ProductionOrder

### Human Resources

- [Human Resources](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/) (ar: الموارد البشرية): The HR module runs the full employee lifecycle in Nama ERP — from the day someone is hired to the day they leave, and every payslip in between.
- [Attendance and Departure Formulas](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/attendance-machine-formula.html) (ar: معادلات الحضور والانصراف (Attendance and Departure Formulas)): Most employees record attendance and departure with a fingerprint on a dedicated time attendance machine. - entities: TimeAttendance
- [Ignoring Overlapping Attendance and Departure Lines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/ignore-overlapping-attendance.html) (ar: تجاهل سطور الحضور والانصراف المتقاطعة): In day-to-day operations, data coming from fingerprint machines is not always complete. - entities: TimeAttendance - menu: Payroll → Time Attendance → Time Attendance
- [Frequently Asked Questions — Payroll and Human Resources Module](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/human-resources-faq.html) (ar: أسئلة شائعة في موديول الرواتب والموارد البشرية): Three questions that come up often. - entities: LeavePermission, SalaryDocument, SalarySheet
- [Employee Services (Vehicles, Transport & Meals)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/employee-services.html) (ar: خدمات الموظفين (السيارات والنقل والوجبات)): Beyond salary, most companies run a handful of side benefits for their staff — a car to do the job with, a bus to get to the site, a hot meal at the canteen. - entities: CarAction, CarProblem, CarActionRequest, CarInfoUpdater, CarInsurancePolicy, CarInsuranceOfferDoc, CarInsuranceAddingDoc, CarInsuranceRemovingDoc, CarInsuranceInstallmentProofDoc, PickupPlan, MealType, MealsDetails, MealDeliveryPlan

#### Core Concepts

- [Core Concepts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/concepts/) (ar: المفاهيم الأساسية)
- [HR Requests, Documents & Aggregated Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/concepts/hr-requests-and-documents.html) (ar: طلبات ومستندات الموارد البشرية والمستندات المجمعة): Almost everything that happens to an employee in Nama HR — a vacation, a loan, joining the company, leaving it — is recorded through the same three-layer pattern.
- [How Salary Is Calculated](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/concepts/hr-salary-engine.html) (ar: كيفية حساب الراتب): A payslip in Nama is never typed in by hand — it is computed from building blocks you set up once and reuse every month.

#### Setup

- [Setup (Modules › Human Resources)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/setup/) (ar: الإعداد الأساسي)
- [HR Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/setup/hr-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات الموارد البشرية): Everything the payroll engine does that is not written on a document is written here. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Payroll → Settings → Human Resource Settings
- [HR Years, Periods & Salary Issuance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/setup/hr-years-and-periods.html) (ar: سنوات وفترات الموارد البشرية وإصدار الرواتب): Before any salary can be calculated, Nama needs to know two things: which time slice the run belongs to, and which pay stream it belongs to. - entities: HRYear, HRPeriod, HRSalaryIssuance
- [HR Calendar, Holidays & Weekends](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/setup/hr-calendar-and-holidays.html) (ar: تقويم الموارد البشرية والعطلات وأيام الراحة الأسبوعية): Every attendance rollup, every vacation-day count, and every payroll figure in Nama ultimately answers one question: was this a working day, a weekly rest day, or an official holiday? - entities: HRCalendar, HRHolidays
- [Employee HR Information](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/setup/employee-hr-information.html) (ar: معلومات شئون الموظف): Once someone joins the company, their record splits naturally into two layers. - entities: EmployeeHRInfo, EmployementInformation - menu: Payroll → Main → Employee HR Information

#### Payroll

- [Payroll](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/) (ar: الرواتب)
- [Salary Components](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/salary-components.html) (ar: مفردات الراتب (Salary Components)): Every payslip is built from small, reusable pieces: a basic salary, a housing allowance, a tax, an overtime line, an insurance deduction. - entities: SalaryComponent, SalaryComponentType, SalaryComponentGroup
- [Salary Calculation Formulas](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/salary-calculation-formulas.html) (ar: معادلات حساب الراتب (Salary Calculation Formulas)): A Salary Component set to Variable Value doesn't carry a number of its own — it carries a Component Calculation Formula, which is the recipe that turns that month's inputs into a figure. - entities: ComponentCalcFormula, DailySalary - menu: Payroll → Salary Configurations → Component Calculation Formula
- [Salary Structures](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/salary-structures.html) (ar: هياكل الراتب (Salary Structures)): Setting up every allowance and deduction on every employee one by one doesn't scale once a company has more than a handful of staff. - entities: SalaryStructure - menu: Payroll → Salary Configurations → Salary Structure
- [Salary Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/salary-documents.html) (ar: مستندات الرواتب (Salary Documents)): Everything on the salary components, formulas and structures pages is setup — the machinery that decides how much each employee should be paid. - entities: SalarySheet, SalaryDocument, SalaryGenerationRange
- [Annual Increases](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/hr-annual-increases.html) (ar: الزيادات السنوية (Annual Increases)): Salaries don't stay still. - entities: AnnualIncreasesDoc - menu: Payroll → Main → Annual Increases Document
- [Salary Blocking & Partial Payment](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/salary-blocking.html) (ar: حجب الرواتب والصرف الجزئي (Salary Blocking & Partial Payment)): Sometimes a salary shouldn't be paid out — at least not yet, and not in full. - entities: SalaryBlockRule, SalaryBlockDocument, SalaryUnBlockDocument, PartialSalaryPayment

#### Document Terms

- [Document Terms (Modules › Human Resources)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات المستندات)
- [Salary and Dues Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/document-terms/hr-terms-salary-and-dues.html) (ar: توجيهات الرواتب والتصفية): A salary document knows everything about the month it pays for. - entities: SalaryDocument, SalarySheet, DailySalary, DuesLiquidationDoc, AggrDuesLiquidationDoc, AnnualIncreasesDoc, EmployeeProvisionsOpening, EmployeeProvisionsRecalc, AggrEmpProvisionsRecalc - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Attendance and Vacation Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/document-terms/hr-terms-attendance-and-vacations.html) (ar: توجيهات الحضور والإجازات): Vacation and attendance documents rarely post anything by themselves — a vacation does not move money, it moves a balance, and the money follows later on a salary document. - entities: VacationDocument, AggregatedVacationDocument, AggregatedVacationStartingDoc, MultiEmpVacation, VacationCompensation, AggregatedVacationCompensation, AggregatedLeavePermission, AggregatedMissionDocument, HolidaysRestBalanceDoc - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Loan, Reward and Penalty Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/document-terms/hr-terms-loans-rewards-and-penalties.html) (ar: توجيهات السلف والمكافآت والجزاءات): These documents all move money that is not salary — an advance paid out, an instalment collected, a bonus granted, a fine deducted — so unlike the vacation family, most of them post, and their terms are mostly about accounts. - entities: HRLoanDocument, AggHRLoanDocument, HRLoanPaymentDocument, HRLoanReliefDocument, AggHRLoanInstallReschedule, RewardAndPenaltieDocument, AggrRewardAndPenaltieDoc, HOPenaltyDocument - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Employment and Government Relations Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/document-terms/hr-terms-employment-and-government.html) (ar: توجيهات التوظيف والعلاقات الحكومية): These are the documents that change who somebody is rather than what they are paid: the offer that hires them, the update that changes their salary or their department, the relocation, the termination, and — in the Gulf countries — the residence... - entities: JobOffer, CandidateJobOffer, UpdateEmployeeInfo, AggrUpdateEmpInfo, EmployeeRelocate, AggFiringDocument, AggFiringRequest, HODefinitionLetter, AggrResidenceRenewReq, AggrHOSponsorshipTransferDoc, AggrHOExitReEntryVisaReq - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Insurance Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/document-terms/hr-terms-insurance.html) (ar: توجيهات التأمينات): Two insurance products live in the HR module and they are not related to each other. - entities: EmployeeHealthInsurance, HealthInsuranceUpgrade, EmpHealthInsurDelete, HealthInsuranceClaimDoc, HealthInsuranceCredence, CarInsurancePolicy, CarInsuranceAddingDoc, CarInsuranceRemovingDoc, CarInsuranceInstallmentProofDoc - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

#### Time & Attendance

- [Time & Attendance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/attendance/) (ar: الحضور والإنصراف)
- [Attendance Plans & Shifts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/attendance/attendance-plans-and-shifts.html) (ar: خطط الدوام والورديات (Attendance Plans & Shifts)): Before Nama can tell whether a punch was "late" or an hour was "overtime," it needs to know what the employee's schedule was supposed to be that day. - entities: AttendanceShift, AttendancePlan
- [Time Attendance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/attendance/time-attendance.html) (ar: الحضور والانصراف (Time Attendance)): An Attendance Plan and Shift tells Nama what an employee's day is supposed to look like. - entities: TimeAttendance, ElectronicAttendance, ElectronicAttendanceZone
- [Attendance Machines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/attendance/attendance-machines.html) (ar: أجهزة البصمة (Attendance Machines)): Raw punch data can reach Nama in one of two ways. - entities: AttendanceMachineConfig - menu: Payroll → Time Attendance → Attendance Machine Config
- [Leave Permissions & Missions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/attendance/leave-permissions-and-missions.html) (ar: الاستئذانات والمأموريات (Leave Permissions & Missions)): Not every departure from the schedule needs a full vacation. - entities: LeavePermission, MissionDocument, LeavePermissionConfiguration, LeaveReason
- [Overtime and Lateness](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/attendance/overtime-and-lateness.html) (ar: الوقت الإضافي والتأخير): Two punches and a shift produce a surprising number of arguments. - entities: TimeAttendance, AttendancePlan, PerformanceIndicator

#### Vacations & Leaves

- [Vacations & Leaves](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/vacations/) (ar: الأجازات)
- [Vacation Types & Balances](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/vacations/vacation-types-and-balances.html) (ar: أنواع وأرصدة الأجازات): Before anyone can take a day of leave, Nama needs to know what kind of leave it is and how many days the employee is entitled to. - entities: VacationType, VacationBalanceRange, OpeningVacationBalanceDoc
- [Vacation Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/vacations/vacation-documents.html) (ar: مستندات الأجازات): This page covers the screens that actually put an employee on leave: the Vacation Request (طلب أجازة) and Vacation Document (سند أجازة) pair, the Vacation Plan Document (مستند خطة أجازة) used to schedule leave ahead of time... - entities: VacationDocument, VacationRequest, VacationPlanDocument, MultiEmpVacation, AggregatedVacationDocument
- [Vacation Compensation & Transfer](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/vacations/vacation-compensation-and-transfer.html) (ar: تعويض ونقل الأجازات): Not every leave document is about an employee actually being away. - entities: VacationCompensation, VacationTransferDocument, VacationChangingDocument, HolidaysRestBalanceDoc
- [Change Employee State](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/vacations/change-employee-state.html) (ar: تغيير حالة الموظف): Every employee carries one working state at a time — Working, In Vacation, Suspended, Resigned, Dismissed, Pension, and a set of open-ended "Other" states a company can repurpose for its own needs. - entities: ChangeEmployeeState - menu: Payroll → Vacations → ChangeEmployeeState

#### Loans & Installments

- [Loans & Installments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/loans/) (ar: السلف والأقساط)
- [Loan Types](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/loans/hr-loan-types.html) (ar: أنواع السلف): Every loan or salary advance in Nama starts from a Loan Type (نوع السلفة) — a master file that defines what an employee can borrow: the default and allowed range for the amount, the default and allowed range for the number of installments... - entities: HRLoanType - menu: Payroll → Loans / Installments → Loan Type
- [Loan Documents & Payments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/loans/hr-loan-documents.html) (ar: مستندات وسداد السلف): This page covers the three screens that turn a loan from a request into money in an employee's pocket, and eventually back out again: the Loan Request (طلب سلفة) and Loan Document (سند سلفة) pair... - entities: HRLoanDocument, HRLoanRequest, HRLoanPaymentDocument
- [Loan Adjustments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/loans/hr-loan-adjustments.html) (ar: تسويات السلف): Once a Loan Document is running, three separate screens change it without touching the original disbursement: writing part of the balance off, moving installments around in time, and pausing (or resuming) the whole loan. - entities: HRLoanReliefDocument, HRLoanInstallReschedule, HRLoanDisableDocument

#### Rewards, Penalties & Suspension

- [Rewards, Penalties & Suspension](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/discipline/) (ar: المكافآت والجزاءات والإيقاف)
- [Rewards & Penalties](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/discipline/rewards-and-penalties.html) (ar: المكافآت والجزاءات): Not every adjustment to an employee's pay comes from the salary structure or attendance — some of it is ad hoc: a one-off bonus for good work, or a deduction for a specific incident. - entities: RewardAndPenaltieDocument, RewardAndPenalty
- [Suspension](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/discipline/hr-suspension.html) (ar: إيقاف الموظف عن العمل): A Suspension Document (إيقاف عن العمل) records that an employee was suspended from work for a stretch of days — and, depending on why, whether that stretch is paid or not. - entities: SuspensionDocument - menu: Payroll → Reward / Penalty → Suspension Document

#### Performance

- [Performance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/performance/) (ar: تقييم الأداء)
- [Performance Indicators](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/performance/performance-indicators.html) (ar: مؤشرات الأداء (Performance Indicators)): Some pieces of an employee's pay aren't fixed numbers — they depend on something that has to be measured first: how many overtime hours were worked, how many late arrivals happened, how many sales were closed... - entities: PerformanceIndicator, PerformanceMeasure, ManualMeasures, SysIndicatorApproval
- [Employee Evaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/performance/employee-evaluation.html) (ar: تقييم الموظف (Employee Evaluation)): Where Performance Indicators measure things that can be counted automatically — hours, occurrences, sales — an Employee Evaluation (تقييم موظف) is for the parts of performance that need a human judgment: how well someone communicates... - entities: EmployeeEvaluation, EmployeeEvaluationReq, EvaluationElement, EvaluationElementsGroup - menu: Human Resources → Recruitment → Employee Evaluation

#### Recruitment

- [Recruitment](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/) (ar: التوظيف)
- [Vacancies & Candidates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/vacancies-and-candidates.html) (ar: الوظائف الشاغرة والمرشحون (Vacancies & Candidates)): Hiring in Nama starts before anyone applies. - entities: HRVacancy, HRVacancyType, HRCandidate, HRTest, HRTestResult
- [Job Offers & Tests](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/job-offers-and-tests.html) (ar: عروض العمل والاختبارات (Job Offers & Tests)): A candidate who clears interviews and testing doesn't just get hired on a handshake — Nama puts the proposed terms of employment into their own document first, so the job title, salary package... - entities: JobOffer, CandidateJobOffer, AggregatedJobOffer, HRTest, HRTestResult
- [Work Starting](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/work-starting.html) (ar: بدء العمل): An offer being accepted, a suspension ending, a long vacation running its course — none of these, on their own, put a person back on the payroll. - entities: WorkStartingDocument, WorkStartingRequest, AggregatedVacationStartingDoc - menu: Payroll → Recruitment → Work Starting Document
- [Employee Relocation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/employee-relocation.html) (ar: نقل الموظف): People and their records change after they're hired: a branch gets restructured and someone's whole department moves, an employee needs a raise or a new job title, a passport gets renewed... - entities: EmployeeRelocate, EmployeeRelocateRequest, UpdateEmployeeInfo, AggrUpdateEmpInfo, WorkPlaceUpdate

#### Training

- [Training](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/training/) (ar: التدريب)
- [Training Courses & Plans](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/training/training-courses-and-plans.html) (ar: الدورات وخطط التدريب): Before anyone can be trained, there has to be something to train them in. - entities: TrainingCourse, TrainingPlan, CourseEnrollment, EndTrainingCourse
- [Course Evaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/training/hr-course-evaluation.html) (ar: تقييم الدورة التدريبية (Course Evaluation)): Employee Evaluation rates ongoing staff performance against a catalog of scored criteria. - entities: CourseEvaluation, EvaluationElement - menu: Human Resources → Training → Course Evaluation

#### Provisions & End of Service

- [Provisions & End of Service](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/) (ar: المخصصات وإنهاء الخدمة)
- [HR Provisions (End-of-Service & Vacation Accrual)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/hr-provisions.html) (ar: مخصصات الموظفين (نهاية الخدمة ورصيد الأجازات)): When an employee eventually leaves, the company owes them money it has been quietly building up for years: an end-of-service gratuity (a lump sum based on how long they served) and the cash value of any vacation days they never took. - entities: EmployeeProvisionsRecalc, EmployeeProvisionsOpening, AggrEmpProvisionsRecalc
- [Firing & Termination](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/firing-and-termination.html) (ar: إنهاء الخدمة والتصفية): Ending someone's employment is never just a status change. - entities: FiringDocument, FiringRequest, TerminationReason, AggFiringDocument, AggFiringRequest
- [Dues Liquidation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/dues-liquidation.html) (ar: تصفية المستحقات (Dues Liquidation)): When someone leaves the company, a single document has to draw a line under everything the two sides still owe each other and turn it into one number to pay. - entities: DuesLiquidationDoc, DuesLiquidationComponent, AggrDuesLiquidationDoc - menu: Payroll → Dues Liquidation and Firing → Dues Liquidation Document
- [Evacuation Approval](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/evacuation-approval.html) (ar: الموافقة على إخلاء الطرف (Evacuation Approval)): Before a departing employee can be paid off — or before a long leave is signed off — most companies run a clearance: the person has to be signed out by each department they owe something to. - entities: EvacuationPartyDocument, EvacuationApprovalSettings, EvacuationApprovalDocument

#### Government Relations

- [Government Relations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/) (ar: العلاقات الحكومية)
- [Government Relations Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/government-relations-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على العلاقات الحكومية (Government Relations Overview)): Every company that employs expatriate staff in the Gulf runs a small back office that never stops: residency (Iqama) permits expire, work licences have to be renewed, exit and re-entry visas are issued, passports are handed in and out... - entities: HOTransactionType, HODefinitionLetter, HOPaymentRequest
- [HR Visas](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/hr-visas.html) (ar: التأشيرات (HR Visas)): An expatriate employee in the Gulf cannot simply leave the country and come back, or bring family over to visit, without a government visa each time — and every one of those visas has an issue date, a duration and an expiry that HR has to track. - entities: HOExitReEntryVisaReq, AggrHOExitReEntryVisaReq, HOExtendingVisaReq, HOFinalExitVisaReq, HOFamilyVisitVisaRequest, HOPassportDeliveringReq
- [Residence Renewal](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/residence-renewal.html) (ar: تجديد الإقامة (Residence Renewal)): Of every deadline the PRO desk tracks, the Iqama (residency permit) is the one that cannot slip — an expired residency stops an employee from working, travelling or even opening a bank account. - entities: ResidenceRenewReq, AggrResidenceRenewReq - menu: Human Resources → ADMINISTRATIVE TRANSACTIONS → Residence Renew Request
- [Visa Pool](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/visa-pool.html) (ar: مجمع التأشيرات (Visa Pool)): Before a single overseas hire can travel, the company needs a work visa allocated to them — and in Saudi / Gulf recruiting, those visas are not requested one at a time. - entities: HRIssuedVisas, HRVisasDelegation, HRVisaHandling
- [Social Insurance & Sponsorship](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/social-insurance-and-sponsorship.html) (ar: التأمينات الاجتماعية والكفالة): Two of the most sensitive government touch-points for an expatriate workforce are the GOSI social insurance register and the sponsorship (Kafala) relationship. - entities: HOEmpSocialInsuranceAdd, HOEmpSocialInsuranceRemove, HOSponsorshipTransferDoc, AggrHOSponsorshipTransferDoc
- [Government Penalties](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/government-penalties.html) (ar: الجزاءات الحكومية): Alongside the visa and fee work, the government-relations desk maintains the company's disciplinary code — the internal list of workplace violations and the penalties attached to them — and issues the documents that apply a penalty to an employee. - entities: HOViolationItem, HOViolationList, HOPenaltyDocument, HOPenaltyRequest

#### Health Insurance

- [Health Insurance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/health-insurance/) (ar: التأمين الصحي)
- [Employee Health Insurance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/health-insurance/employee-health-insurance.html) (ar: التأمين الصحي للموظف (Employee Health Insurance)): In the Gulf, private health insurance is not optional paperwork — it is a government-mandated benefit, and covering the wrong category, missing a spouse, or letting a policy lapse creates real liability. - entities: EmployeeHealthInsurance, HealthInsuranceOffer, HealthInsuranceClaimDoc, HealthInsuranceUpgrade, HealthInsuranceCredence, EmpHealthInsurDelete

### Point of Sale

- [Point of Sale](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/) (ar: نقاط البيع): Most of Nama ERP runs in a web browser.
- [Nama POS — Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-overview.html) (ar: نقاط البيع (Nama POS) — نظرة عامة): Most of Nama ERP runs in a web browser.
- [Installing Nama POS on a New Register and Connecting It to the Server](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-installation.html) (ar: تنزيل نقاط البيع على ماكينة جديدة وربطها بالخادم الرئيسي): Nama POS is a desktop application that runs right on the cash register and keeps its own local database, so it can keep selling even when the connection to the central server drops.
- [Getting Started at the Register](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-getting-started.html) (ar: البداية على الماكينة): This page walks through the everyday basics: starting the application, signing in, finding your way around the menu, locking the screen when you step away, and switching language or theme. - entities: POSSecurityProfile, NamaPOSShortcuts
- [The Sales Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-sales-invoice.html) (ar: فاتورة المبيعات): The sales screen is where a cashier spends almost the whole day. - entities: NamaPOSSalesInvoice - menu: Point of sale → Documents → POS Sales Invoice
- [Payment & Tender](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-payment-and-tender.html) (ar: الدفع والتحصيل): Pressing F5 on a finished invoice opens the tender screen — the moment of truth where money changes hands. - entities: NamaPOSSalesInvoice
- [Returns & Replacements](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-returns-and-replacements.html) (ar: المرتجعات والإحلال): Goods come back. - entities: NamaPOSSalesReturn, NamaPOSSalesReplacement, NamaPOSCreditNote
- [Shifts & Cash](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-shifts-and-cash.html) (ar: الورديات والنقدية): A shift is one work session on a register: it opens when a cashier starts, and closes when they count down the drawer and hand over. - entities: POSShiftOpening, POSShiftClosing, POSReceiptFromRegister, POSPaymentToRegister
- [Tables, Reservations & Captain Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-tables-and-restaurant.html) (ar: الطاولات والحجوزات وكابتن أوردر): Restaurants and cafés sell differently from a shop counter: orders belong to tables, waiters take them away from the till, and some are booked in advance. - entities: NamaPOSHall, NamaPOSTable, NamaPOSOrderReservation, NamaPOSCancelReservation
- [Item Add-ons](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-item-addons.html) (ar: إضافات الأصناف): Some items are not sold plain. - entities: NamaPosItemAdditionalItems - menu: Point of sale → Settings → POS Item Additional Items
- [Inventory Operations at the Register](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-inventory-operations.html) (ar: العمليات المخزنية على الماكينة): A point of sale is not only a till — it is also the front line of the store's stock. - entities: NamaPOSStockReceipt, NamaPOSStockTransferReq, NamaPOSStockTakingDetails, NamaPOSScrapDoc, NamaPOSShortfallsDoc
- [Reports & Tools](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-reports-and-tools.html) (ar: التقارير والأدوات): Beyond selling, the register carries a handful of everyday tools: running reports, messaging other staff, checking a price without making a sale, and — for supervisors — running maintenance utilities. - entities: NamaPOSInternalMessage
- [How POS Data Syncs with the Server](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-data-sync.html) (ar: كيف تتزامن بيانات نقاط البيع مع الخادم): This is the idea that makes Nama POS what it is, so it is worth understanding even if you never touch the technical side.

#### Server-Side Setup

- [Server-Side Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/) (ar: الإعداد على الخادم): The rest of the POS guide is about the register: selling, taking payment, closing a shift.
- [Setting Up a Register](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-register-setup.html) (ar: إعداد الماكينة (Register)): Every machine that runs Nama POS is described on the server by one Register record (ماكينة). - entities: NamaPOSRegister, NamaPOSHall, NamaPOSTable - menu: Point of sale → Register → Register
- [The POS Settings Screen](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-settings-screen.html) (ar: شاشة إعدادات نقاط البيع): POS Settings (إعدادات نقاط البيع) is where the behaviour of every register in the company is decided: how prices are found, what the payment dialog does, which documents a cashier may save without a connection, how sales reach the server. - menu: Point of sale → Settings → POS Settings
- [Numbering POS Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-document-numbering.html) (ar: ترقيم مستندات نقاط البيع): Registers work offline, so they cannot ask the server for the next invoice number the way a screen in the ERP does. - entities: NamaPOSRegister - menu: Point of sale → Register → Register
- [Shift Opening, Closing & Cash-Reset Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-shift-close-settings.html) (ar: إعدادات فتح وغلق الوردية وتصفير النقدية): A cashier opens and closes shifts at the register (see Shifts & Cash). - entities: POSShiftOpening, POSShiftClosing, POSCashDrawer - menu: Point of sale → Documents → POS Shift Closing
- [POS Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-document-terms.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات نقاط البيع): A cashier never picks a book or a term — the register screen has no such field. - entities: DocumentTerm, NamaPOSRegister
- [POS Security Profiles](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-security-profiles.html) (ar: صلاحيات نقاط البيع (POS Security Profile)): What a cashier may do at the register — change a price, give a discount, return without an invoice, close someone else's shift — is not controlled by the ERP's ordinary roles and capabilities. - entities: POSSecurityProfile - menu: Point of sale → Settings → POS Security Profile
- [Service Charge, Minimum Charge, Delivery & Return Reasons](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-charges-and-returns-settings.html) (ar: الخدمة السياحية والحد الأدنى للطلب والتوصيل وأسباب الإرجاع): Restaurants and cafés often add something to the bill that is not a dish: a service charge, a delivery fee, or a top-up when a table spends less than the minimum. - entities: POSServiceChargeSettings, PosMinChargeSettings, NamaPOSDeliveryCost, NamaPOSDepreciationReason, NamaPOSReturnReason
- [What a Register Receives: Items, Barcodes & Sync Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-items-and-sync-settings.html) (ar: ما الذي تستلمه الماكينة: الأصناف والباركود وإعدادات المزامنة): A register only knows what the server sends it. - entities: NaMaPosItemsToSend, NamaPOSItemQtyUpdateConfig, NamaPOSItemBarcodeParser, NamaPOSReadQueuePriorityConfig, NamaPOSInvSavingSettings, NamaPOSExtraFilter, NamaPOSDBUpdateStatement
- [Screen, Keyboard & Device Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-screen-and-device-settings.html) (ar: إعدادات الشاشة ولوحة المفاتيح والأجهزة): A register in a supermarket and a register in a café should not look the same. - entities: NamaPosUISettings, NamaPosMobileUISettings, NamaPOSShortcuts, NamaPosPoleDisplaySpecs, NamaPosDefaultsTemplate, NamaPosRequiredFields, NamaPOSCustomerPhoneCountryCodes, NamaPOSPaymentMethodsSettings, PaymentFromPosSettings
- [POS Documents on the Server](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-documents-on-the-server.html) (ar: مستندات نقاط البيع على الخادم): Everything a cashier does at the register — a sale, a refund, a pay-out, a stock count — is saved on the register first and then synced up to Nama ERP as a document (see How POS Data Syncs with the Server). - entities: NamaPOSSalesInvoice, NamaPOSSalesReturn, NamaPOSSalesReplacement, NamaPOSHeldInvoice, NamaPOSReturnPeriodExtension, NamaPOSOrderReservation, NamaPOSCancelReservation, POSPaymentToRegister, POSReceiptFromRegister, NamaPOSStockTransferReq, NamaPOSStockTakingDetails, NamaPOSStockReceipt, NamaPOSShortfallsDoc, NamaPOSScrapDoc, NamaPOSCreditNote, NamaPOSInternalMessage, NamaPOSGenericReference, NamaPOSAggGenericReference
- [Nama POS — Technical Points of Use Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/nama-pos.html) (ar: دليل استعمال النقاط الفنية في نقاط البيع): Nama ERP is a web-based system, but its Nama POS module includes a dedicated desktop application for Points of Sale (POS), offering both online and offline capabilities: - entities: NamaPosPoleDisplaySpecs
- [Free Items in POS: Claim at Scan and Reconciliation at Payment](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-free-items-claim-and-reconciliation.html) (ar: الأصناف المجانية في نقاط البيع: المطالبة بالمسح والتسوية عند الدفع): When you have a promotion of the "buy one item and get another for free" type, the default behavior in the POS is to add the free item to the invoice immediately upon adding the qualifying item. - entities: NamaPOSSalesInvoice
- [Fingerprint Login in Point of Sale](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-fingerprint-login.html) (ar: تسجيل الدخول بالبصمة في نقاط البيع): Imagine you have several employees taking turns at the same POS terminal throughout the day. - entities: UserFingerprint
- [Point of Sale FAQ](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-faq.html) (ar: أسئلة شائعة حول نقاط البيع): When the option "Hide the system's default deferred payment method" is enabled in the POS settings, the deferred payment method is expected to be hidden from the payment screen.

### Real Estate

- [Real Estate](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/) (ar: العقارات): Nama Real Estate is the module for companies whose product is property.
- [Real Estate Module Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/realestate-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على وحدة العقارات): A property company has a problem that ordinary trading companies do not: its stock is a tree.
- [Real Estate Module Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/realestate-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات وحدة العقارات): Most of what the Real Estate module does is decided per document book, on the document's term. - entities: ConfigEntry - menu: Real Estate and Property → Settings → Real estate Configurations

#### Real Estate Document Terms

- [Real Estate Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات مستندات العقارات)
- [How Real Estate Document Terms Work](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/document-terms/realestate-terms-basics.html) (ar: كيف تعمل توجيهات مستندات العقارات): A sales contract knows everything about the business event it records. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Sales Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/document-terms/realestate-terms-sales.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات البيع): Selling a property is not one accounting event. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Rent Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/document-terms/realestate-terms-rent.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الإيجار): A lease is a promise stretched over time. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Collection, Maintenance, Investment and Cost Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/document-terms/realestate-terms-other.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات التحصيل والصيانة والاستثمار والتكاليف): Once the two contract families are configured, everything else in Real Estate is a short term. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

#### Properties

- [Properties](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/properties/) (ar: العقارات والوحدات)
- [How Properties Are Modelled](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/properties/realestate-estate-model.html) (ar: كيف يُمثَّل العقار في النظام): Everything the Real Estate module does — selling, leasing, collecting, maintaining, revaluing — starts from one question: what exactly is being sold? - entities: REProject, RESquare, REBlock, RELand, REBuilding, REFloor, RERentalUnit, REUnitGroup
- [Projects, Squares, Blocks and Land Plots](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/properties/realestate-projects-blocks-lands.html) (ar: المشاريع والمربعات والبلوكات وقطع الأراضي): A land-subdivision business does not enter its portfolio plot by plot. - entities: REProject, RESquare, REBlock, RELand
- [Buildings, Floors and Rental Units](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/properties/realestate-buildings-floors-and-units.html) (ar: المباني والطوابق والوحدات): The other half of the estate tree goes upwards instead of sideways. - entities: REBuilding, REFloor, RERentalUnit, REUnitGroup, REUnitModel
- [Owners, Buyers and Standard Contract Clauses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/properties/realestate-owners-and-contract-clauses.html) (ar: الملاك والمشترون وبنود التعاقد القياسية): Every document in the Real Estate module names people: the landlord who owns the building, the customer who buys the flat, the tenant who leases the shop, the investor who put money into the fund. - entities: REOwner, REStandardTermsConditions
- [Transferring Ownership Between Owners](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/properties/realestate-ownership-transfer.html) (ar: تحويل الملكية بين الملاك): Not every change of owner is a sale. - entities: REOwnerShipTransfer - menu: Real Estate and Property → Documents → OwnerShip Transfer Document

#### Sales

- [Sales](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/) (ar: المبيعات)
- [The Property Sales Cycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-sales-cycle.html) (ar: دورة بيع العقار): Selling a property is rarely one signature. - entities: RESalesOffer, RETempReservation
- [Price Lists and Payment Plan Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-price-lists-and-payment-methods.html) (ar: قوائم الأسعار ونماذج الدفع): There are two numbers a salesperson should never type from memory: what the unit costs, and how the customer is allowed to pay for it. - entities: RESalesPriceList, RESalesPaymentMethod
- [Reservations and Initial Sales Contracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-reservations-and-initial-contracts.html) (ar: الحجوزات وعقود البيع المبدئية): Between "the customer is interested" and "the customer has bought" there is a stretch of time where the unit must be taken off the market without any revenue being recognised. - entities: REReservationDoc, REReservationDocCancel, REInitialSalesContract
- [The Sales Contract](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-sales-contract.html) (ar: عقد البيع): Everything before this point in the sales cycle is about intent. - entities: RESalesDoc - menu: Real Estate and Property → Sales → Sales Contract
- [Building the Installment Plan](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-installment-plans.html) (ar: إنشاء خطة الأقساط): Property is sold on time. - entities: RESalesDoc
- [Handing the Unit Over](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-handover.html) (ar: تسليم الوحدة): Handover is the moment the property stops being a promise on a contract and becomes a set of keys in somebody's hand. - entities: REEStateHandover, REInspectionDoc, PostHandoverCost
- [Waivers and Cancelling a Sale](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-waiver-and-cancellation.html) (ar: التنازل وفسخ عقد البيع): Most readers arrive at this page with one of two questions. - entities: REWaiverDoc, RECancelContractReq - menu: Real Estate and Property → Documents → Waiver Document

#### Rent

- [Rent](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/) (ar: الإيجارات)
- [The Leasing Cycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-cycle.html) (ar: دورة التأجير): A company owns Shop G-07 on the ground floor of Al-Nakheel Tower. - entities: RERentContract, RERentOffer, RERentOfferCancel, REMultiRentContract, REOpeningRentContract, RERentInstallmentLedger, RECancelContract
- [Rent Offers and Reserving a Unit for Rent](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-offers.html) (ar: عروض أسعار الإيجار وحجز الوحدة): Before anybody signs anything, a prospective tenant wants a number: what would Shop G-07 cost for three years, and what is the deposit? - entities: RERentOffer, RERentOfferCancel - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Rent offer
- [The Rent Contract](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-contract.html) (ar: عقد الإيجار): The rent contract is the document the whole leasing area revolves around. - entities: RERentContract - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Rent Contract
- [Generating the Rent Schedule](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-schedule.html) (ar: إنشاء جدول الإيجارات): A lease is signed once, but it is paid many times. - entities: RERentContract, REMultiRentContract
- [Rent Installment Accrual Ledgers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-accrual-ledger.html) (ar: قيود إثبات استحقاق أقساط الإيجار): A rent contract is one document with one date. - entities: RERentInstallmentLedger - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Rent Installment Ledger
- [Renewing and Ending a Lease](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-renewal-and-termination.html) (ar: تمديد عقد الإيجار وإنهاؤه): Every lease ends. - entities: RECancelContract, RERentContract - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Cancel Contract

#### Collections and Payments

- [Collections and Payments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/) (ar: التحصيل والمدفوعات)
- [How Installment Collection Works](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-collection-basics.html) (ar: كيف يتم تحصيل الأقساط): Every contract in the Real Estate module ends up as a schedule of money: a sales contract, an opening sales contract, a rent contract, an opening rent contract, a reservation and even a waiver all carry a grid of installments.
- [Collect Documents and Bulk Collection](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-collect-documents.html) (ar: سندات التحصيل والتحصيل المجمع): The collect document (سند تحصيل) is where the money side of the Real Estate module actually happens. - entities: RECollectDoc, RECollectReq, AggrRECollectDoc
- [Paying Collected Money to the Bank or the Owner](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-collection-payouts.html) (ar: توريد المحصل للبنك أو للمالك): Collecting rent is only half of a property agency's day. - entities: REBankPay, REOwnerPay
- [Exemptions and Returning Money to the Buyer](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-exemptions-and-returns.html) (ar: الإعفاءات ورد المبالغ للمشتري): Not every installment is closed by cash. - entities: REExemptionDoc, REReturnPaymentDoc
- [Late-Payment Fines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-fines.html) (ar: غرامات التأخير): A customer who is three months late on a 50,000 installment still owes 50,000. - entities: REFineDoc, REFineDocType - menu: Real Estate and Property → Fines → Real state fine Doc

#### Real Estate Maintenance

- [Real Estate Maintenance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/maintenance/) (ar: صيانة العقارات)

- [Accruing the Annual Maintenance Charge](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/maintenance/realestate-maintenance-accrual.html) (ar: إثبات استحقاق الصيانة السنوية): A compound has to be run. - entities: REMaintenanceAccrual - menu: Real Estate and Property → Documents → Maintenance Accrual
- [Maintenance Requests and Expenses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/maintenance/realestate-maintenance-expenses.html) (ar: طلبات ومصروفات الصيانة): Accruing the annual charge tells you what the community owes. - entities: REMaintenanceExpense, REMaintenanceExpenseRequest - menu: Real Estate and Property → Documents → Maintenance Expense
