- [Opening Rent Contracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/opening/realestate-opening-rent-contracts.html) (ar: عقود الإيجار الافتتاحية): A shop in Al-Nakheel Tower has been leased since early 2024: three years at 120,000 a year, paid quarterly, and the whole first year has already been collected. - entities: REOpeningRentContract - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Opening rent contract

### Contracting

- [Contracting](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/) (ar: المقاولات): Nama Contracting is the module for companies that build.
- [Contracting Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contracting-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على المقاولات): A contracting company lives on two mirrored promises.
- [Contracting Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contracting-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات المقاولات): The Contracting module keeps its settings in a single record, and that record shapes the behaviour of every contract, extract and cost document in the database. - entities: ConfigEntry

#### Contracting Master Files and Setup

- [Contracting Master Files and Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/) (ar: ملفات وإعدادات المقاولات)
- [Contracting Projects](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-projects.html) (ar: مشروع المقاولات): Ask a site manager what he is working on and he will not answer "contract PC-2026-001". - entities: Project - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contracting Project
- [Standard Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-standard-terms.html) (ar: البنود القياسية): A contracting company does not sell things. - entities: ContractingStandardTerm - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Standard Term
- [Term Sheets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-term-sheets.html) (ar: كراسة الشروط): A term sheet is a bill of quantities saved as a document. - entities: TermSheet - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Term Sheet
- [Term Analysis Cards](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-term-analysis-cards.html) (ar: كارت تحليل البند): A term line says "plain concrete, 300 m³, 420 each". - entities: TermAnalysisCard - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Term Analysis Card
- [Contract Conditions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-conditions.html) (ar: الشروط التعاقدية): Every construction contract carries clauses that move money without being work: retain 5% of each payment until final handover, recover the mobilisation advance at 20% of every certificate, deduct 1,000 per day of delay... - entities: ContractingCondition, ContractingConditionsGroup - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contracting Condition
- [Contracting Price Lists](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-price-lists.html) (ar: قوائم أسعار المقاولات): Typing a unit rate onto every line of every bill of quantities is how estimating mistakes happen. - entities: ContractingPriceList - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contracting Price list
- [Phases and Work Areas](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-phases-and-work-areas.html) (ar: المراحل ومناطق العمل): A bill of quantities answers what work is being done. - entities: ContractingPhase, ContractingPhasesGroup, ContrWorkArea
- [Contract Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-contract-templates.html) (ar: نماذج العقود): Contractors repeat themselves. - entities: ContractTemplate - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contract Template
- [Contractors and Consultants](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-contractors-and-consultants.html) (ar: المقاولون والاستشاريون): Two parties stand beside the project owner on every construction job, and the module keeps a master file for each of them. - entities: Contractor, ContractingAdvisory, ContractorClassification
- [Modify Contractor Info Request](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-modify-contractor-info-request.html) (ar: طلب تعديل بيانات المقاول (Modify Contractor Info Request)): A subcontractor's file carries the details his payments depend on: his names, his supplier link, his contact details, his accounts and his tax registration. - entities: ModifyContractorInfoReq - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Modify Contractor Info Request
- [Units, Tasks and Other Lookups](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-lookups.html) (ar: وحدات القياس والمهام والملفات المساعدة): Six small master files sit under Contracting > Master Files and do not deserve a page each. - entities: ContractingUOM, ContractingTask, ContrTermCategory, ContrTermCategory2, ContractingFineReason, ContractingDirectCost, ContractingTaxExtractTerm

#### Contracting Document Terms

- [Contracting Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات مستندات المقاولات)
- [Document Terms Basics](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/contracting-terms-basics.html) (ar: أساسيات توجيه المستندات): A document term (توجيه المستند) is the small configuration record that tells one document type how to behave — and, above everything else in Contracting, which accounts it posts to. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Extract Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/contracting-terms-extracts.html) (ar: توجيه المستخلصات): The extract is the only document in a contracting chain that reaches the ledger, which makes its term the most consequential piece of configuration in the module. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Material and Payment Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/contracting-terms-materials.html) (ar: توجيه مستندات الخامات والدفعات): The terms on this page cover two families that look unrelated and turn out to be closely connected: the documents that move material onto a site, and the documents that move money in advance of an extract. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Other Contracting Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/contracting-terms-other.html) (ar: توجيه مستندات المقاولات الأخرى): Once the extracts, the material streams and the payment documents are configured, what remains is a long tail of terms that are mostly very small: one debit, one credit, and a guard or two. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

#### Project Contracting

- [Project Contracting](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/) (ar: مقاولة المشروع)
- [The Project Contracting Cycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-owner-cycle.html) (ar: دورة مقاولة المشروع): A contracting business runs two mirrored chains at the same time. - entities: ContractingJobOrder - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Contracting Job Order
- [Contracting Offers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-offers.html) (ar: عرض سعر المقاولات): Every contract in this module starts as a number somebody had to justify. - entities: ContractingOffer - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Contracting Offer
- [Contracting Assays](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-assays.html) (ar: مقايسة المقاولات): The document this page describes is مقايسة مقاولات — a priced bill of quantities, the classic Arabic construction term for a measured schedule of works with quantities and rates. - entities: ContractingAssay - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Contracting Assay
- [Project Contracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-contract.html) (ar: عقد المشروع): The project contract is the centre of gravity of the whole contracting module. - entities: ProjectContract - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract
- [Project Contract Updates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-contract-updates.html) (ar: تعديل عقد المشروع): Clients change their minds. - entities: ProjectContractUpdate - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Update
- [Project Execution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-execution.html) (ar: حصر كميات المشروع): A month of work has happened on site. - entities: ProjContractExecution - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Execution
- [Project Extracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-extracts.html) (ar: مستخلص المشروع): Signing a contract in Nama books nothing. - entities: ProjContrExtract - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Extract
- [Taxes on Extracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-extract-taxes.html) (ar: الضرائب على المستخلصات): A tax authority will not accept a bill of quantities. - entities: ProjContrExtract, ContractingTaxExtractTerm
- [Project Advance Payments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-advances.html) (ar: الدفعات المقدمة من العميل): Nobody mobilises a tower crane out of goodwill. - entities: ProjectAdvancePayment - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Advance Payment
- [Project Fines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-fines.html) (ar: غرامات عقد المشروع): Contracts have teeth. - entities: ProjectContractFine - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Fine
- [Measurements, Submittals and Handover](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-measurements-and-approvals.html) (ar: طلبات الرفع والاعتمادات والتسليم): Three documents sit around the edges of the billing chain: one before the contract is even priced, one that governs what materials may be bought, and one that records the day the keys change hands. - entities: MeasurementsRequest, CustomerSubmittal, ProjectDeliverLetter

#### Subcontractor Contracting

- [Subcontractor Contracting](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/) (ar: مقاولة مقاول الباطن)
- [The Subcontractor Cycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-cycle.html) (ar: دورة مقاول الباطن): A contracting business runs two mirrored chains at once. - entities: ContractorContract, ContractorContrExtract, ContractorContractOffer, ContractorContractExecution, ContractorContractUpdate, Contractor
- [Subcontractor Offers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-offers.html) (ar: عرض سعر مقاول الباطن): Before you award a package you ask two or three firms what they want for it. - entities: ContractorContractOffer - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Offer
- [Subcontracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-contract.html) (ar: عقد مقاول الباطن): The subcontract is the centre of gravity of the cost side, exactly as the project contract is of the revenue side: the rates you have agreed to pay one firm for one package, the clauses that will reduce every certificate you issue him... - entities: ContractorContract - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract
- [Subcontract Updates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-contract-updates.html) (ar: تعديل عقد مقاول الباطن): Scope moves. - entities: ContractorContractUpdate - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Update
- [Subcontractor Execution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-execution.html) (ar: حصر كميات مقاول الباطن): A subcontractor's invoice is only as trustworthy as the measurement behind it. - entities: ContractorContractExecution - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Execution
- [Subcontractor Extracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-extracts.html) (ar: مستخلص مقاول الباطن): Everything else on the subcontractor side is preparation. - entities: ContractorContrExtract - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Extract
- [Subcontractor Advances and Other Payments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-advances-and-payments.html) (ar: دفعات مقاول الباطن): A blockwork subcontractor cannot start without buying scaffolding, hiring a gang and putting a mixer on site, and he will not have been paid a penny yet because nothing has been measured. - entities: ContractorAdvancePayment, ContractorOtherPayment - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Advance Payment
- [Subcontractor Fines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-fines.html) (ar: غرامات مقاول الباطن): A blockwork gang builds forty square metres of wall out of plumb and has to knock it down and build it again. - entities: ContractorContractFine - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Fine

#### Budgets

- [Executive Budgets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/budgets/contracting-executive-budget.html) (ar: الموازنة التنفيذية): The estimated budget is what the estimating team thinks the job will cost. - entities: ContractingExecutiveBudget - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contracting Executive Budget
- [Budget Execution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/budgets/contracting-budget-execution.html) (ar: حصر كميات الموازنة): The English name on the menu invites you to expect a variance report — budget against actual, in one screen. - entities: ContractingBudgetExecution - menu: Contracting → Costs → Contracting Budget Execution Document
- [Budget Item Requests](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/budgets/contracting-budget-item-requests.html) (ar: طلب شراء خامات من الموازنة التنفيذية): An approved executive budget says which materials the job needs, how much of each, and at what price the client approved them. - entities: ExecutiveBudgetItemRequest - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Executive Budget Item Request

#### Contracting Costs

- [Contracting Costs](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/) (ar: تكاليف المقاولات)
- [How Project Cost Is Built](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-cost-model.html) (ar: كيف تتكوّن تكلفة المشروع): Knowing what a project is worth is easy: the contract says 230,000, term by term, and nobody argues about it. - entities: ContractingDirectCost
- [Cost Execution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-cost-execution.html) (ar: حصر تكاليف المقاولات): The contract's term lines will tell you that blockwork has cost 34,800 so far. - entities: ContractingCostExecution - menu: Contracting → Costs → Contracting Cost Execution
- [Issuing Material to a Project](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-project-materials.html) (ar: صرف الخامات للمشروع): Two menu items sitting next to each other under Contracting > Costs look almost identical and behave nothing alike. - entities: ContractingMaterialIssue, ContractingMaterialReturn, ContractingMaterialIssueReq - menu: Contracting → Costs → Contracting Material Issue
- [Selling Material to a Subcontractor](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-contractor-materials.html) (ar: صرف الخامات لمقاول الباطن): Contractors supply their subcontractors constantly. - entities: ContractorMaterialIssue, ContractorMaterialReturn, ContractorMaterialIssueRequest - menu: Contracting → Costs → Contractor Material Issue
- [Contracting Purchase Requests and Orders](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-purchasing.html) (ar: طلبات وأوامر شراء المقاولات): Nama already has a perfectly serviceable purchase request and purchase order in the supply chain module. - entities: ContractingPurchaseRequest, ContractingPurchaseOrder
- [Miscellaneous Contracting Spend](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-misc-spend.html) (ar: مصروفات المقاولات المتنوعة): Most of what a site costs is not an item in a warehouse. - entities: MiscContractingInvoice, MiscContractingOrder, MiscContractingRequest - menu: Contracting → Costs → Misc Contracting Invoice
- [Daily Labour and Site Diary](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-daily-labour.html) (ar: مستند السركى والأعمال اليومية): Two documents in this part of the module are written by the people who are actually on site, at the end of the day, in their own handwriting before anyone types them up. - entities: DailyLaborBook, DailyEngineeringDoings - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Daily Labor Book
- [Employees, Equipment and Their Costs](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-equipment-and-allocations.html) (ar: تسكين الموظفين والمعدات وتكاليفهم): The site engineer who spends March on Tower A is on the company payroll. - entities: ContrEmployeeEquipmentAlloc, ContrEmployeeEquipmentCost, ContrEmployeeEquipInvoice, EquipmentStatementDoc, FACreationDoc
- [Pushing Cost onto Real Estate Units](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-realestate-cost-bridge.html) (ar: ترحيل التكلفة إلى الوحدات العقارية): A contractor working on somebody else's land only ever needs cost per term: what did the blockwork cost, what did the plastering cost, are we inside the rate we tendered.

#### Contracting Quality Control

- [Contracting Quality Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/) (ar: ضبط جودة المقاولات)
- [Site Quality Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-quality-overview.html) (ar: ضبط الجودة بالموقع): Every construction site runs on paper.
- [Inspection and Test Plans](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-inspection-plans.html) (ar: خطط الفحص والاختبار): An ITP — an Inspection and Test Plan — is the document a contractor submits at the start of a job to answer one question in advance: for every activity on this project, what will be inspected, against which specification, and who has to witness it. - entities: CQCITP, CQCITPRegister
- [Activity Inspection Requests](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-activity-inspections.html) (ar: طلب فحص نشاط): Reinforcement gets covered by concrete. - entities: CQCActivityInspectionReq - menu: Contracting → Quality → Activity Inspection Request
- [Material Inspection on Delivery](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-material-inspection.html) (ar: فحص الخامات عند التوريد): A lorry arrives at the site gate. - entities: CQCMaterialReceipt, CQCMRRRegister
- [Site Checklists and Test Reports](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-site-checklists.html) (ar: قوائم فحص الموقع وتقارير الاختبار): Eight of the thirteen screens in the Quality group are specific site forms — the sheet you fill before a pour, the sheet you fill after it, the one for a buried pipe run, the one for a pressure test. - entities: FinishingWorksCheckList, DiggingBackFilingCheckList, CQCPreConcreteInspection, CQCPostConcreteInspection, CQCUndergroundPipingChecks, CQCCleaningAndFlushing, CQCHydroStaticFireSysTest, TestReport
- [Contracting FAQ](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contracting-faq.html) (ar: أسئلة متكررة عن المقاولات): These are the questions that come up again and again on live Contracting installations.

### Project Management

- [Project Management](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/) (ar: ادارة المشاريع): Project Management (ECPA) is the Nama module for firms whose product is professional time rather than goods: architecture and engineering offices, consultancies, audit and legal practices, design studios.
- [Project Management (ECPA) Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/ecpa-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على ادارة المشاريع (ECPA)): An engineering office does not sell anything you can put on a shelf. - licence: ecpa
- [Project Management Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/ecpa-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات ادارة المشاريع): Most of what makes a project behave the way it does — its phases, its disciplines, its rates, its accounts — is set on the project itself. - entities: ConfigEntry - licence: ecpa
- [Where Project Cost and Revenue Come From](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/ecpa-costing-and-profitability.html) (ar: مصادر تكلفة وإيراد المشروع): "What did this project cost us, and did we make money on it?" - entities: CPAProject, CPAProjectStage - licence: ecpa
- [Project Management Reports](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/ecpa-reports.html) (ar: تقارير ادارة المشاريع): Project Management (ECPA) ships two reports, and both of them are about the same thing: employee time. - licence: ecpa

#### Projects

- [Projects](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/) (ar: المشاريع)
- [Project Types, Classes and Disciplines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-project-setup.html) (ar: أنواع وتصنيفات وتخصصات المشاريع): Before an engineering office can open its first project in Project Management (ECPA), it has to teach Nama its own vocabulary: what kinds of work it sells, how it likes to slice its portfolio for reporting... - entities: CPAProjectType, CPAProjectSubType, CPAProjectClass, CPADiscipline - licence: ecpa
- [Milestones and the Phase–Discipline Matrix](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-milestones-and-matrix.html) (ar: المراحل ومصفوفة المراحل والتخصصات): An engineering office never sells "a villa". - entities: CPAProjectMileStone, CPAPhasesDisciplineGroup, CPAProject - licence: ecpa
- [The Managed Project](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-managed-project.html) (ar: المشروع الإداري): Everything in Project Management (ECPA) hangs off one record: the Managed Project. - entities: CPAProject - menu: ECPA → Projects → Managed Project
- [Project Sales Quotation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-sales-quotation.html) (ar: عرض أسعار المشروع): Everything else in Project Management (ECPA) assumes a project already exists. - entities: CPASalesQuotation - menu: ECPA → Projects → CPA Projects Sales Quotation - licence: ecpa
- [Project Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-project-templates.html) (ar: قوالب المشاريع): Most firms do the same handful of jobs over and over. - entities: CPATemplateProject - menu: ECPA → Projects → Template Project
- [Project Stages](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-project-stages.html) (ar: مستندات مرحلة المشروع): Most of Project Management (ECPA) is built around people and hours. - entities: CPAProjectStage - menu: ECPA → Projects → Project Stage
- [Stage Extensions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-stage-extensions.html) (ar: تمديد مراحل المشروع): A Project Stage holds the promise: each phase, its targeted number of days, and the dates that follow from them. - entities: CPAProjectStageExtension, CPAStageExtensionReason, CPAStageExtensionReasonType - menu: ECPA → Projects → Project Stage Extension
- [Procedures](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-procedures.html) (ar: الاجراءات): The name invites a misunderstanding, so start here: a Procedure in Project Management (ECPA) is not a workflow definition, not a checklist template and not a stored routine. - entities: CPAProcedure - menu: ECPA → Projects → Procedure

#### Tasks

- [Project Tasks](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/tasks/ecpa-tasks.html) (ar: مهام المشروع): A project in Project Management (ECPA) is a container: a customer, a set of milestones, a set of disciplines. - entities: CPATask, CPATaskType - menu: ECPA → Tasks → Task

- [Approving Worked Hours](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/task-execution/ecpa-timesheet-approval.html) (ar: الموافقة على أوقات التنفيذ): Hours recorded on a Tasks Executing document are a claim, not a fact. - entities: CPATimeSheetApproval - menu: ECPA → Task Execution / Approvals → TimeSheet Approval

- [Project Return](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/invoicing/ecpa-project-returns.html) (ar: مردود فاتورة المشاريع): Sooner or later a design office bills something it should not have billed. - entities: CPAProjectReturn - menu: ECPA → Invoice → Project Return
- [Document Terms for Project Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/invoicing/ecpa-document-terms.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات المشاريع): A document in Nama knows what happened — 38 hours on a task, 1,500 of travel, a fee of 10,860. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Fixed Assets

- [Fixed Assets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/) (ar: الأصول الثابتة): Nama Fixed Assets is the register of everything your company owns and uses rather than sells — machines, vehicles, buildings, furniture, land.
- [Fixed Assets Module Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/fixedassets-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على وحدة الأصول الثابتة): The general ledger knows that you own machinery worth 2,400,000 and that 400,000 of depreciation has piled up against it.
- [Module Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/fixedassets-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات الوحدة): Most of what the Fixed Assets module does is decided document by document, on the document's term (توجيه). - menu: Assets → Settings
- [Getting Started with Fixed Assets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/fixedassets-getting-started.html) (ar: البدء والتأسيس في الأصول الثابتة): Setting up Fixed Assets in a fresh database is not hard, but the order matters more than in most modules.

#### Master Files and Setup

- [Master Files and Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/) (ar: الملفات والإعدادات)
- [Fixed Asset Types](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-asset-types.html) (ar: أنواع الأصول الثابتة): Al-Waha Industries owns forty machines. - entities: FAType - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset Type
- [The Fixed Asset Record](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-asset-master.html) (ar: بطاقة الأصل الثابت): There is one rule that explains the whole of this screen, and reading it first will save you an hour of hunting for a field that does not exist: - entities: FixedAsset - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset
- [Asset Statuses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-asset-status.html) (ar: حالات الأصل): The Status field on a fixed asset is one word, it cannot be typed, and it decides more about what you are allowed to do than any other field on the record. - entities: FixedAsset - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset
- [Classifications](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-classifications.html) (ar: تصنيفات الأصول الثابتة): Al-Waha Industries has three hundred assets and one asset type for all of its machinery. - entities: FAClassification1, FAClassification2, FAClassification3, FAClassification4, FAClassification5
- [Asset Locations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-locations.html) (ar: مواقع الأصول): An asset register that cannot tell you where the machine is standing is only half a register. - entities: FALocation - menu: Assets → Master Files → Asset Location
- [Components and Component Types](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-components.html) (ar: المكونات وأنواع المكونات): The CNC machine MCH-0007 is one asset, one cost, one depreciation schedule. - entities: FAComponentType - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset Component Type
- [The Fixed Asset Creation Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-creation-document.html) (ar: سند إنشاء أصول): A contracting company spends a year building a warehouse. - entities: FACreationDoc - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset Creation Document

#### Acquiring Assets

- [Acquiring Assets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/) (ar: اقتناء الأصول)
- [How an Asset Is Acquired](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-acquisition-cycle.html) (ar: كيف يُقتنى الأصل): Buying a machine is not one event.
- [Fixed Asset Purchase Request](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-purchase-request.html) (ar: طلب شراء أصل): The purchase request is the internal ask: the paint shop needs a compressor, production needs a CNC cutting machine. - entities: FAPurchaseRequest - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Purchase Request
- [Offers and Purchase Orders](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-purchase-offers-and-orders.html) (ar: عروض الأسعار وأوامر الشراء): Between "we need a CNC machine" and "here is the supplier's invoice" sit the two documents where purchasing does its work: the Fixed Asset Offer (عرض سعر أصل), which records what a supplier is willing to sell for... - entities: FAPurchaseOffer, FAPurchaseOrder
- [The Fixed Asset Purchase Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-purchase-document.html) (ar: سند شراء أصل ثابت): Everything before this document is paperwork. - entities: FAPurchaseDocument - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Purchase Document
- [Taking Delivery: Initial Receipt and Receipt Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-receipts.html) (ar: الاستلام: السند المبدئي ومستند الاستلام): Two documents in this module have "receipt" in their name, they sit in different menu folders, they need different licences, and they do completely different jobs. - entities: FAInitialReceipt, FAReceiptDoc
- [Opening Balances for Assets You Already Own](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-opening-balances.html) (ar: الأرصدة الافتتاحية للأصول المملوكة سلفاً): Almost nobody starts using Fixed Assets on the day they buy their first machine. - entities: FAOpeningDocument, FAOpeningDocumentUpdate - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Opening Document
- [Custodies Delivery Receipt Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-delivery-receipt.html) (ar: سند استلام وتسليم عهد): People leave. - entities: FADeliveryReceiptDoc - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → Custodies Delivery Receipt Document

#### Letters of Credit

- [Letters of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/) (ar: إعتمادات الأصول)
- [Importing Assets on a Letter of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-lc-overview.html) (ar: استيراد الأصول باعتماد مستندي): A press bought from a factory down the road costs what the invoice says it costs.
- [The Letter of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-letter-of-credit.html) (ar: اعتماد الأصول): Everything about one import deal has to hang off a single peg: the proforma invoice, half a dozen expense invoices from four different parties, and finally the document that turns all of it into asset cost. - entities: FALetterOfCredit - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Letter of Credits → Fixed asset Letter of Credit
- [The Proforma Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-lc-proforma-invoice.html) (ar: الفاتورة المبدئية): The Fixed Asset ProformaInvoice is the shortest document in the chain and the most misunderstood. - entities: FALCProformaInvoice - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Letter of Credits → Fixed Asset ProformaInvoice
- [Expenses and Distribution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-lc-expenses.html) (ar: مصروفات الاعتماد وتوزيعها): This is where the import stops being paperwork and starts being money. - entities: FALcExpenseDocument, AdditionalCost - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Letter of Credits → Fixed Asset Expense Document
- [The Cost Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-lc-cost-document.html) (ar: سند تكليف الاعتماد): Up to this point the import has cost 615,000 and nobody owns a press. - entities: FALCCostDoc - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Letter of Credits → Fixed Asset Letter of Credit cost

#### Depreciation and Value Changes

- [Depreciation and Value Changes](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/) (ar: الإهلاك وتعديل القيمة)
- [How Depreciation Works](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-depreciation-concepts.html) (ar: كيف يحسب النظام الإهلاك): Everything the Fixed Assets module does with depreciation comes out of a single line of arithmetic applied once per fiscal period.
- [The Depreciation Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-depreciation-document.html) (ar: سند الإهلاك): The depreciation document is the period-end run: one document per fiscal period, holding one line per asset, each line carrying that asset's charge for the period. - entities: FADepreciation - menu: Assets → Documents → Depreciation Document
- [The Aggregated Depreciation Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-aggregated-depreciation.html) (ar: سند الإهلاك المجمع): Al-Waha Industries goes live on Nama in November, backdated to the start of the year. - entities: AggrFADepreciation - menu: Assets → Documents → Aggregated Depreciation Document
- [Freezing an Asset's Depreciation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-prevent-depreciation.html) (ar: تجميد إهلاك أصل): Sometimes an asset should not be depreciated for a while. - entities: FAPreventAssetsDeprec - menu: Assets → Documents → Prevent Assets Depreciation Document
- [Revaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-revaluation.html) (ar: إعادة تقييم الأصول): Some assets do not lose value on a formula. - entities: FARevaluation - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Revaluation
- [Additions and Deductions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-additions-and-deductions.html) (ar: الإضافة والإستبعاد): In January 2027 Al-Waha's CNC machine gets a new control unit. - entities: FAAdditionDeduction, AggrAdditionDeduction - menu: Assets → Documents → Asset addition deduction
- [Re-estimating an Asset's Life and Salvage Value](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-properties-document.html) (ar: إعادة تقدير عمر الأصل وقيمة خردته): Useful life and salvage value are estimates, and estimates get revised. - entities: FAPropertiesDocument, AggrFAPropertiesDocument - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Properties

#### Transfers and Stocktaking

- [Transfers and Stocktaking](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/) (ar: نقل الأصول والجرد)
- [Moving an Asset: The Transfer Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-transfer-document.html) (ar: نقل الأصل: سند نقل الأصل): Al-Waha Industries wheels the CNC cutting machine MCH-0007 from Hall 2 to Hall 3 of the Riyadh plant. - entities: FATransferDocument, AggrFATransferDoc - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → Transfer document
- [Asking for a Move: The Transfer Request](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-transfer-requests.html) (ar: طلب النقل: كيف يُطلب تحريك الأصل): In most plants the person who decides that a machine should move is not the person who is allowed to change the asset register. - entities: FATransferRequest, AggFATransferRequest - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → Fixed Asset Transfer Request
- [Transfers Between Companies](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-intercompany-transfers.html) (ar: النقل بين الشركات): Moving a machine between two branches of one company is bookkeeping housekeeping: the same balances sit under a different label. - entities: FATransferDocument - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → Transfer document
- [Sending Assets Out and Bringing Them Back](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-movement-in-out.html) (ar: خروج الأصول من المنشأة ورجوعها): Al-Waha Industries is exhibiting at a trade fair in Dammam. - entities: FAMovementOutDoc, FAMovementInDoc
- [Stocktaking Fixed Assets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-stocktaking.html) (ar: جرد الأصول الثابتة): Once a year somebody walks the plant with a scanner and finds out what is actually there. - entities: FAFixedAssetsTaking - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → FixedAssets Taking Document

#### Custodies

- [Custodies](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/) (ar: العهد)
- [Custody — Items Handed to Staff](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-overview.html) (ar: العهد — الأشياء التي تسلّمها لموظفيك): In the same week, Al-Waha Industries buys two things.
- [Custody Types](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-types.html) (ar: أنواع العهد): Before Al-Waha Industries can register its first laptop, somebody has to answer a question the system will otherwise ask on every single record: do items of this kind have a money value? - entities: CustodyType - menu: Assets → Custodys → Custody Type
- [The Custody Record](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-register.html) (ar: سجل العهدة): The custody record is the register itself — one record for one physical item that Al-Waha Industries has handed out, or is about to. - entities: FACustody - menu: Assets → Custodys → Custody
- [Buying Custody Items](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-purchase.html) (ar: شراء العهد): Al-Waha Industries buys a laptop for 6,000 from Riyadh IT Supplies. - entities: FACustodyPurchaseDocument - menu: Assets → Custodys → Custody purchase document
- [Delivering and Transferring Custody](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-delivery-and-transfer.html) (ar: تسليم العهد ونقلها): A custody item that nobody is holding is just stock. - entities: FACustodyDeliveryDoc, FACustodyTransferDocument
- [Disposing of a Custody Item](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-disposal.html) (ar: التخلص من العهدة): Eventually the laptop stops being worth keeping. - entities: FACustodyDisposal - menu: Assets → Custodys → Custody Disposal

### Customer Relationship Management

- [Customer Relationship Management](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/) (ar: خدمة العملاء): The CRM menu covers the whole life of a customer relationship on paper: chasing a lead, logging the calls and visits that warm it up, running campaigns and surveys, answering complaints and support tickets, selling service contracts — and...
- [CRM Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/crm-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على خدمة العملاء): The Customer Relationship Management menu — «خدمة العملاء» — is one of the widest branches in Nama ERP.
- [CRM Getting Started](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/crm-getting-started.html) (ar: البدء السريع مع خدمة العملاء): Because the CRM menu holds four separate products, there is no single setup order that covers all of it.
- [CRM Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/crm-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات خدمة العملاء): The CRM module has its own settings screen, reached from the configuration area rather than from the CRM menu itself. - entities: ConfigEntry
- [CRM Reports and Printed Forms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/crm-reports-and-forms.html) (ar: التقارير والنماذج المطبوعة لخدمة العملاء): This is a short page, and the shortness is the point.
