#### Technician Appointments

- [Technician Appointments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/technician-appointments/) (ar: مواعيد الفنيين): If your business sells something and then has to turn up at the customer's address to make it work — install the split unit, assemble the wardrobe, take the sample — this is the part of the menu that plans the visit.
- [Technician Appointments Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/technician-appointments/crm-technician-appointments-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على مواعيد الفنيين): Some businesses sell a product and then have to turn up at the customer's address to make it work. - licence: crm-technician-appointments
- [Services and Procedures](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/technician-appointments/crm-technician-services-and-procedures.html) (ar: الخدمات والإجراءات الفنية): Before you can book anybody you have to tell the system what you book people for. - entities: TechnicianService, TechnicianProcedure - licence: crm-technician-appointments
- [Technician Crews](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/technician-appointments/crm-technician-crews.html) (ar: فرق الفنيين): You do not book individual people in this feature — you book a crew. - entities: TechnicianCrew - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Technician Appointments → Technician Crew - licence: crm-technician-appointments
- [Technician Unavailability](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/technician-appointments/crm-technician-unavailability.html) (ar: سند إيقاف فني عن الحجز): You book crews, not people, but a crew can only go out if its people are there. - entities: TechnicianUnavailability - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Technician Appointments → Technician Unavailability - licence: crm-technician-appointments
- [Appointment Booking Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/technician-appointments/crm-appointment-booking-settings.html) (ar: إعدادات حجز المواعيد): The booking calendar has to know two things before it can stop anybody making a bad booking: when your crews work, and how finely you want the day chopped up. - entities: TechnicianBookingSettings - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Technician Appointments → Appointment Booking Settings - licence: crm-technician-appointments
- [The Technician Appointment](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/technician-appointments/crm-technician-appointment.html) (ar: الموعد الفني): The Technician Appointment (موعد فني) is the booking itself — one crew, one job, the times they are reserved for, and the materials the visit will use. - entities: TechnicianAppointment - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Technician Appointments → Technician Appointment - licence: crm-technician-appointments
- [The Booking Calendar](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/technician-appointments/crm-technician-appointment-calendar.html) (ar: تقويم الحجز): Technician Appointment Creator (إنشاء موعد فني) is the screen booking staff spend their day in. - entities: TechnicianAppointment - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Technician Appointments → Technician Appointment Creator - licence: crm-technician-appointments
- [My Appointments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/technician-appointments/crm-my-appointments.html) (ar: مواعيدي): The booking calendar is for the people who plan the visits. - entities: TechnicianAppointment, TechnicianCrew, DepartmentSection - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Technician Appointments → My Appointments - licence: crm-technician-appointments
- [Service Distribution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/technician-appointments/crm-technician-service-distribution.html) (ar: سند توزيع الخدمات): The appointment says the Giza crew is booked on Sunday morning for a split unit installation. - entities: TechnicianServiceDistribution - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Technician Appointments → Technician Service Distribution - licence: crm-technician-appointments
- [Technician Transfers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/crm/technician-appointments/crm-technician-transfers.html) (ar: سندات نقل الفنيين): Because a technician may belong to only one crew, moving somebody is not a matter of editing two crew records — you would be rejected halfway through, with the person briefly a member of both. - entities: TechnicianTransfer - menu: Customer Relationship Management → Technician Appointments → Technician Transfer - licence: crm-technician-appointments

### Travel

- [Travel](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/travel/) (ar: السفر والرحلات): Welcome to the Travel module of Nama ERP — the module built for tour operators and travel agencies, where what you sell isn't a product on a shelf but an arrangement: forty people landing on the 14th, five nights split between two hotels...
- [Travel Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/travel/travel-master-files.html) (ar: الملفات الرئيسية للسفر والرحلات): A travel agency does not sell shirts out of a warehouse. - entities: TRHotel, TRRestaurant, TRTourService, TRTourGuide, TRCity, TRCountry, TRHotelClass, TRRestaurantClass, TRTourServiceClass
- [Travel Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/travel/travel-document-terms.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات السفر والرحلات): Open the Travel menu and you will find exactly two groups: Master Files and Documents. - entities: TRSalesInvoice, TRSalesOrder, TRSalesReturn, TRPurchaseInvoice, TRPurchaseOrder, TRPurchaseReturn, TRTour
- [Tour Programs](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/travel/tour-programs.html) (ar: البرامج السياحية): A tour operator does not invent a new trip for every group that lands at the airport. - entities: TRTourProgram - menu: Travel → Master Files → Tour Program
- [Tours](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/travel/tours.html) (ar: الرحلات السياحية): A tour program is the recipe. - entities: TRTour - menu: Travel → Documents → Tour
- [Hotel & Restaurant Vouchers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/travel/travel-vouchers.html) (ar: قسائم الفنادق والمطاعم): Long before anyone had an ERP, a travel agency confirmed a booking by writing a voucher: a slip of paper handed to the hotel — or to the restaurant — saying "these people are coming, on these dates, this is what we have booked for them... - entities: TRHotelVoucher, TRRestaurantVoucher
- [Buying from Suppliers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/travel/travel-purchase-cycle.html) (ar: الشراء من الموردين): A tour costs money long before it earns any. - entities: TRPurchaseInvoice, TRPurchaseOrder, TRPurchaseReturn
- [Selling to the Client](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/travel/travel-sales-cycle.html) (ar: البيع للعميل): A travel agency sells nights, seats, transfers, entrance tickets and guiding hours. - entities: TRSalesInvoice, TRSalesOrder, TRSalesReturn
- [Payments, Instalments & Contract Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/travel/travel-payments-and-terms.html) (ar: الدفعات والأقساط وشروط التعاقد): A travel agency almost never gets paid the way a shop does. - entities: TRSalesInvoice, TRSalesOrder, TRSalesReturn, TRPurchaseInvoice, TRPurchaseOrder, TRPurchaseReturn

### Education

- [Education](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/education/) (ar: التعليم): Welcome to the Education module of Nama ERP — the module for organisations whose customers are students: a school with stages, classes and a register to call every morning...
- [Students, Guardians and the Academic Structure](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/education/education-master-files.html) (ar: الطلاب وأولياء الأمور والهيكل الدراسي): A school cannot record a single day of attendance, print a single mark sheet or sign a single training contract before it has described itself to the system: which stages it teaches, how those stages are divided... - entities: EDStudent, EDGuardian, EDEducationalStage, EDStageType, EDClassRoom, EDRank, EDLecturer, EDContractor, EDStudentInfoUpdater, EDExpense, EDMainLevel, EDSubLevel
- [Course Definitions and Courses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/education/education-courses.html) (ar: تعريفات الدورات والمواد الدراسية): A training centre's brochure lists Advanced Excel for Accountants once: thirty hours, taught in English, in the classroom, aimed at the intermediate accounting level, ending with an attendance certificate. - entities: EDCourse, EDCourseDefinition, EDMainLevel, EDSubLevel
- [Course Contracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/education/education-course-contracts.html) (ar: عقود الدورات التدريبية): Most of the Education module records information rather than money: who is enrolled, who turned up, what marks were scored, which bus a student rides. - entities: EDCourseContract - menu: Education → Master Files → Course Contract
- [Payment Schedules and Collection](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/education/education-payment-schedules.html) (ar: جداول الأقساط والتحصيل): Very few families pay a year of tuition in one go, and very few companies pay for a training programme up front. - entities: EDCourseContract
- [Cancelling a Course Contract](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/education/education-contract-cancellation.html) (ar: إلغاء عقد دورة تدريبية): A contract is signed for a full training programme, the trainee attends three months and then withdraws. - entities: EDCourseContractCancel - menu: Education → Master Files → Course Contract Cancel
- [Education Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/education/education-document-terms.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات التعليم): Open the Education menu and you find five groups of master files and documents — students and guardians, attendance, buses, meals, school trips — and nowhere among them a Settings screen. - entities: EDCourseContract, EDCourseContractCancel
- [Attendance, Daily Monitoring and Leave](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/education/education-attendance.html) (ar: الحضور والمتابعة اليومية وأذون الانصراف): Three screens carry the day-to-day life of a school: who was in class this morning, what the teachers and the families had to say about a pupil, and who was allowed to leave early. - entities: EDAttendance, EDDailyMonitoring, EDLeavePermission, EDLeaveReason
- [Recording Marks](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/education/education-marks.html) (ar: رصد الدرجات): At the end of the term somebody has to write down what each student scored in each subject. - entities: EDMarksBalance - menu: Education → Master Files → Marks Balance
- [Buses, Meals and School Trips](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/education/education-transport-and-meals.html) (ar: الحافلات والوجبات والرحلات المدرسية): A school runs on more than lessons and fees. - entities: EDBus, EDBusAction, EDMealType, EDMealsDetails, EDMealDeliveryPlan, EDSchoolTrip

### Mobile Applications

- [Mobile Applications](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/mobile/) (ar: تطبيقات الجوال)
- [Nama Mobile App — Overview, Navigation & Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/mobile/mobile-application-guide.html) (ar: تطبيق نما للهواتف المحمولة — نظرة عامة والتنقل والإعدادات): Nama Mobile is the mobile front end for the Nama ERP system. - entities: MobileAppMenuDefinition, MobileAppShortcut
- [Employee Self-Service — Attendance & Leaves](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/mobile/mobile-hr-self-service.html) (ar: الخدمة الذاتية للموظفين — الحضور والإجازات): One of the most common uses of the Nama app is as the employee self-service (ESS) gateway: the employee clocks in and out, tracks their leave balance, and submits requests (vacation, permission, mission...
- [Sales, Inventory & Item Inquiry](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/mobile/mobile-sales-inventory.html) (ar: المبيعات والمخازن والاستعلام عن الأصناف): Nama Mobile turns the phone into a mobile point of sale and inventory tool: the rep writes sales orders and invoices at the customer's site, the warehouse keeper pulls items by barcode...
- [Customer Service, Delivery & Receipts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/mobile/mobile-crm-delivery.html) (ar: خدمة العملاء والتوصيل والقبض): Besides sales and inventory, the app serves the other field teams: the customer-service rep who logs visits, the maintenance technician, the delivery driver, and the collector who issues receipt vouchers at the customer's site.
- [Shipment Delivery: Plan, Deliver, Return](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/mobile/mobile-shipment-delivery.html) (ar: توصيل الشحنات: الخطة والتوصيل والمرتجع): The driver app's Shipment delivery voucher and Delivery orders screens (see Customer Service, Delivery & Receipts) are only the front end. - entities: DLVDeliveryPlan, DLVDeliveryDocument, DLVDeliveryReturn, DLVDeliveryConfig, DLVDeliveryArea, DLVDriverCarAreaAssignment, DeliveryCar - licence: basic-mobile-shipment-delivery
- [Administering Nama Mobile from the ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/mobile/mobile-administration.html) (ar: إدارة تطبيق نما موبايل من النظام): Nothing about Nama Mobile is configured on the phone beyond the server address and the printer. - entities: MobileAppDashboard - menu: Basic → Mobile Apps → Mobile Application Dashboard
- [Shaping the App's Screens: Fields, Card Titles, Labels and Lookups](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/mobile/mobile-screen-customisation.html) (ar: تشكيل شاشات التطبيق: الحقول وعناوين البطاقات والتسميات وحقول البحث): Every screen in Nama Mobile comes with a sensible default: the sales order shows customer, warehouse and lines; the vacation request shows the vacation type, the dates and the balance. - entities: MobileAppScreenModifier, MobileEntityTitleModifier, MobileAppTranslationOverride, MobileAppFieldsSearcherContext
- [Binding Users to Their Phones](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/mobile/mobile-device-binding.html) (ar: ربط المستخدمين بهواتفهم): A user name and a password travel easily. - entities: UserMobileIdentifierDocument - menu: Basic → Mobile Apps → User Mobile Identifier Document
- [Mobile QR Integrator Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/mobile/mobile-qr-integrator.html) (ar: دليل Mobile QR Integrator): The Mobile QR Integrator is a powerful feature that enables Nama ERP to respond to QR codes scanned by mobile devices. - entities: MobileQRIntegrator - menu: Basic → Mobile Apps → Mobile QR Integrator

### e-commerce Integration

- [e-commerce Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/) (ar: تكامل التجارة الإلكترونية): This module connects Nama ERP to the outside world of online selling and fulfillment.
- [E-Commerce Integration Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/ecommerce-integration-guide.html) (ar: دليل تكامل التجارة الإلكترونية): This guide explains the settings that every online shop connected to Nama ERP shares: the shop record, linking items to the shop's products, turning shop orders into sales documents, and sending stock, prices and items back to the shop... - entities: MAGMagentoSite, MagentoItemLinker, MagentoPriceUpdaterDoc, EcommerceProductConfig, EcommerceCategoryConfig - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [Salla Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/salla-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع سلة (Salla)): This page explains how Nama ERP works with a Salla store: connecting the store, bringing Salla orders and returns into Nama, sending prices and stock quantities to Salla, and receiving new orders within a minute through webhooks. - entities: MAGMagentoSite - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [Zid Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/zid-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع زد (Zid)): This page explains how to connect a Zid (zid.sa) store to Nama ERP: the two ways to authorise the connection, how Zid orders are read into Nama, what Nama sends back to Zid (prices and quantities), and how abandoned carts are collected. - entities: MAGMagentoSite - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [Shopify Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/shopify-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع شوبيفاي (Shopify)): This page explains how to connect a Shopify store to Nama ERP: how the connection is set up, how Shopify orders become sales documents in Nama, and how products, prices and stock quantities are sent from Nama to Shopify. - entities: MAGMagentoSite - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [WooCommerce Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/woocommerce-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع ووكومرس (WooCommerce)): This page explains how to connect a WooCommerce shop to Nama ERP: importing shop orders as sales documents, sending products, prices and stock to the shop, writing order statuses and notes back... - entities: MAGMagentoSite, RewardPointsConfig - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [BigCommerce Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/bigcommerce-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع BigCommerce): This page explains how to connect a BigCommerce store to Nama ERP: the connection settings, how BigCommerce orders are read into Nama, and how products, prices and stock quantities are sent to the store. - entities: MAGMagentoSite - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [Salasa Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/salasa-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع سلاسه (Salasa)): This page explains how to connect Nama ERP to Salasa, the fulfilment (3PL) company that stores your goods in its warehouses and ships your orders: the two records to set up, how Salasa's webhooks reach Nama... - entities: EcommerceShippingSite, MAGMagentoSite - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Ecommerce Shipping Site
- [OTO Stock Synchronisation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/oto-stock-sync.html) (ar: مزامنة المخزون مع OTO): This page explains how Nama ERP keeps the stock quantities in OTO's fulfilment locations in step with the quantities in your Nama warehouses. - entities: MAGMagentoSite - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [Atheer Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/atheer-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع أثير (Atheer)): This page explains how the Atheer platform sends its orders and requests into Nama ERP: the Magento Site record to set up, the address Atheer calls, the four operations it can send, the ZATCA QR code Nama returns... - entities: MAGMagentoSite - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [Omniful Integration Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/omniful-integration.html) (ar: دليل التكامل مع Omniful): Nama ERP integrates with Omniful, a unified supply chain platform that provides comprehensive warehouse management and order fulfillment capabilities. - entities: OmnifulConfig - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Omniful Configuration
- [Amazon Order Notifications](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/amazon-order-notifications.html) (ar: إشعارات طلبات أمازون): If you sell on Amazon, you don't want to sit refreshing Seller Central waiting for orders to ship so you can punch them into the ERP by hand. - entities: MAGMagentoSite

### Integrations

- [Integrations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/) (ar: التكاملات): The Integrations module is where Nama keeps its ready-made links to outside platforms that a customer is required to report to.

#### Eltezam (MCS)

- [Eltezam (MCS)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/eltezam/) (ar: التزام (وزارة الخدمة المدنية))
- [Eltezam (MCS) Integration — Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/eltezam/eltezam-overview.html) (ar: الربط مع خدمة التزام (MCS Eltezam) — نظرة عامة): A Saudi government agency does not only pay its employees; it also has to tell the Ministry of Civil Service (MCS) about them. - entities: EltezamSubmissionDoc, EltezamConfiguration, EltezamCodeTable
- [Setting up Eltezam](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/eltezam/eltezam-setup.html) (ar: إعداد التزام): Before Nama can send anything to the Ministry of Civil Service, it needs to know three things: where the ministry's Eltezam service is, who the agency is in the ministry's eyes, and which employees and HR records it should report. - entities: EltezamConfiguration - menu: integrations → Master Files → MCS Eltezam Configuration
- [Eltezam Code Tables](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/eltezam/eltezam-code-tables.html) (ar: جداول أكواد التزام): The ministry does not want to hear that an employee is "Male", works in "Riyadh Branch" and holds the position "Senior Accountant". - entities: EltezamCodeTable - menu: integrations → Master Files → MCS Eltezam Code Table
- [What Nama Sends to Eltezam](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/eltezam/eltezam-data-sources.html) (ar: ما الذي يرسله «نما» إلى التزام): Sooner or later a customer calls with "MCS says the job number of employee 1045 is wrong — where does Nama get it from?". - entities: EltezamSubmissionDoc, EltezamConfiguration
- [Eltezam Submissions and Sending](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/eltezam/eltezam-submissions-and-sending.html) (ar: مستندات إرسال التزام وطريقة الإرسال): Every time the agency reports to MCS — the monthly payslips, a batch of new hires, the year's appraisals — it does so through an MCS Eltezam Submission (إرسال بيانات التزام), under Documents → MCS Eltezam Submission in the integrations menu. - entities: EltezamSubmissionDoc - menu: integrations → Documents → MCS Eltezam Submission
- [Eltezam Troubleshooting](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/eltezam/eltezam-troubleshooting.html) (ar: حل مشكلات التزام): Eltezam problems fall into three kinds, and the error code on the request log tells you which one you are looking at before you read a word of the message: - entities: EltezamSubmissionDoc, EltezamConfiguration, EltezamCodeTable

#### Alwatania Distributors

- [Alwatania Distributors](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/alwatania/) (ar: موزعو الوطنية)
- [Alwatania Distributors Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/alwatania/alwatania-overview.html) (ar: الربط مع موزعي الوطنية (Alwatania Distributors)): A company that distributes for Alwatania has to keep the distributor's platform informed: which customers it sells to, which salesmen visit them, which items it carries, and every invoice and return it issues. - entities: AlwataniaDistConfig - menu: integrations → Master Files → Alwatania Distributors Config
- [Setting Up the Alwatania Config](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/alwatania/alwatania-setup.html) (ar: إعداد ربط الوطنية (Alwatania Distributors Config)): Everything Nama needs to reach the Alwatania platform lives on one record, the Alwatania Distributors Config. - entities: AlwataniaDistConfig - menu: integrations → Master Files → Alwatania Distributors Config
- [Sending Master Data and Invoices to Alwatania](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/alwatania/alwatania-sending-data.html) (ar: إرسال البيانات الأساسية والفواتير إلى الوطنية): The Alwatania config screen has no Send button.
- [Alwatania Send Logs and Resending](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/alwatania/alwatania-send-logs.html) (ar: سجلات الإرسال إلى الوطنية وإعادة الإرسال): Every time Nama sends something to Alwatania it writes down what it sent and what the platform answered. - entities: AlwataniaDistConfig - menu: integrations → Master Files → Alwatania Distributors Config

### Artificial Intelligence

- [Artificial Intelligence](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ai/) (ar: الذكاء الاصطناعي): The AI module brings language-model capabilities inside Nama ERP — but in a governed way: the AI can do nothing except through tools the system administrator defines, and every tool executes as a real user with the full security model applied.
- [Getting Better Support with an AI Assistant](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ai/ai-assisted-support.html) (ar: دعم أفضل بمساعد ذكاء اصطناعي): Most support questions are already answered somewhere on this site — the trouble is finding the paragraph. - entities: AIToolDefinition
- [AI Tool Definitions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ai/ai-tool-definitions.html) (ar: تعريفات أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي (AI Tool Definitions)): When an AI assistant talks to Nama ERP — whether it is the assistant built into the system or an external client connected through the MCP server — it can do nothing on its own. - entities: AIToolDefinition - menu: ai → Master Files → AI Tool Definition
- [The In-System AI Assistant](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ai/ai-assistant.html) (ar: المساعد الذكي داخل النظام): Besides connecting external clients through the MCP server, Nama ERP ships with a built-in AI assistant that works right inside the interface: a chat window the user opens to ask questions in natural language — Arabic or English...
- [AI Module Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ai/ai-configuration.html) (ar: إعداد وحدة الذكاء الاصطناعي): Before the AI assistant answers a question, or an MCP client connects to the system, the module needs basic setup: which language model do you use? - entities: ConfigEntry, AIRecordEmbeddingConfig
- [Nama ERP MCP Server](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ai/ai-mcp-server.html) (ar: خادم MCP لنظام نما ERP): MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the open standard AI assistants — such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and others — use to connect to external systems, read their data, and act on them. - entities: AIToolDefinition, APICredentials

## External Integrations

- [External Integrations](https://docs.namasoft.com/integration/) (ar: التكاملات الخارجية): Nama ERP rarely lives alone.
- [Nama ERP REST API](https://docs.namasoft.com/integration/nama-erp-api.html) (ar: واجهة برمجية REST لنظام نما ERP): Nama ERP has a REST API for creating, reading, updating and deleting records of any entity, and publishes an OpenAPI 3.0 description of each entity for third-party systems to build against. - entities: APICredentials
- [Integration Scenarios Between Nama and Other Systems](https://docs.namasoft.com/integration/system-integration-scenarios.html) (ar: سيناريوهات الربط بين نظام نما والأنظمة الأخرى): We receive — on an almost daily basis — a question from customers and colleagues in sales, implementation, and technical support teams that goes something like:
- [Integration with Attendance Machines](https://docs.namasoft.com/integration/attendance-machines-integration.html) (ar: الربط مع ماكينات الحضور والانصراف): The system supports two methods for integrating with attendance machines: - entities: AttendanceMachineConfig, TimeAttendance
- [The attcron Attendance Agent](https://docs.namasoft.com/integration/attcron-agent.html) (ar: تطبيق attcron لسحب بيانات الحضور (The attcron Attendance Agent)): Fingerprint machines are almost always the most awkward device on a company's network. - entities: AttendanceMachineConfig
- [Reporting Medicine Movements to the SFDA](https://docs.namasoft.com/integration/sfda-drug-track-and-trace.html) (ar: الإبلاغ عن حركات الأدوية للهيئة السعودية للغذاء والدواء): The Saudi Food and Drug Authority runs a national drug track-and-trace system. - entities: SFDARSDConfig - menu: Inventory → Settings → SFDA RSD Configuration

## System Administration

- [System Administration](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/) (ar: إدارة النظام): This is the toolkit for keeping a Nama ERP installation healthy.
- [Tempo Language Manual](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/tempo.html) (ar: دليل لغة Tempo): This guide introduces the Tempo language, developed by the NAMA team, to help implementers create dynamic messages for customers, employees, and suppliers.
- [System Settings, Configuration Group and Edit File](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/system-settings-and-configuration-group.html) (ar: إعدادات النظام وقائمة الإعدادات وتعديل ملف): Every settings screen in Nama — the Global Configuration, the supply chain settings, the HR settings, the POS settings — is stored as a record. - entities: ConfigEntry, ConfigGroup - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Performance Optimizer](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/performance-optimizer.html) (ar: إعدادات لتحسين الأداء (Performance Optimizer)): Every time a user opens a list, types into a search box or picks a record in a reference field, Nama quietly adds the user's security to the query: "only the legal entities this user may see", "only the branches"... - entities: PerformanceOptimizer - menu: Basic → Settings → Performance Optimizer
- [Users Counter and Capability Types](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/users-counter-and-security-capabilities.html) (ar: عداد المستخدمين وأنواع الصلاحيات): Two small screens under Administration → Security do jobs that the security profile cannot do on its own. - entities: UsersCounter, SecurityCapability
- [Shortcuts Definition and User Favourites](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/shortcuts-and-user-favourites.html) (ar: تعريف الاختصارات ومفضلة المستخدم): Two screens under Administration → Display Customization shape what a user's fingers and eyes reach first, and neither of them changes a single record. - entities: ShortCutsDefinition, UserFavourites
- [OAuth Files (Google Sign-In for Gmail and Google Drive)](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/oauth-files.html) (ar: ملفات OAuth (تسجيل الدخول بحساب Google لـ Gmail وGoogle Drive)): Google no longer lets a program sign in to Gmail or Google Drive with a plain username and password. - entities: OAuthFile - menu: Administration → Other → OAuth File
- [Hijri Table (the Hijri Calendar Nama Uses)](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/hijri-table.html) (ar: الجدول الهجري (Hijri Table) — التقويم الهجري الذي يعتمده نما): The Hijri calendar cannot be calculated with a formula the way the Gregorian one can. - entities: HijriTable - menu: Basic → Settings → Hijri Table
- [Wizard File (the Setup Wizard's Record)](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/wizard-file.html) (ar: ملف المعالج (Wizard File) — سجل معالج الإعداد): A new installation is usually set up through the setup wizard: a step-by-step questionnaire that asks how the company works — its currency, branches, which documents it uses, whether fixed assets are created from purchases, and so on... - entities: WizardFile - menu: Basic → Documents → Wizard File
- [Guidelines for Submitting Development Requests by Support and Setup Teams](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/dev-request-guidelines.html) (ar: ضوابط إنشاء طلبات تطوير من قبل أقسام الدعم الفني والتجهيز بالشركة)

### Troubleshooting

- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/troubleshooting/) (ar: استكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها): A support ticket rarely names the screen it is about.
- [Critical Errors at Login](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/troubleshooting/critical-errors.html) (ar: الأخطاء الحرجة عند الدخول): A user signs in and, before anything else, a stack of red messages appears: There are 3 failed requests…, Backup folder … does not exist…, Database transaction isolation level is not correct….
- [When the System Is Slow](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/troubleshooting/system-is-slow.html) (ar: حين يصبح النظام بطيئًا): "The system is slow" is the most common ticket support receives, and it is rarely one problem.
- [Troubleshooting System Hanging or Unresponsiveness](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/troubleshooting/troubleshooting-system-hanging.html) (ar: استكشاف أخطاء توقف النظام أو عدم استجابته (Troubleshooting System Hanging or Unresponsiveness)): When your Nama ERP system becomes unresponsive, slow, or appears to hang, the most effective diagnostic tool is a thread dump (also called a stack dump).
- [General FAQ](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/troubleshooting/general-faq.html) (ar: أسئلة عامة): Answers to recurring support questions that do not belong to one screen: a blank error when searching with the lens, granting permissions on all record types at once, installing SQL Server on new SSDs, adding the discussion panel to a screen...

### Reprocessing Transactions

- [Reprocessing Transactions](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/) (ar: إعادة معالجة الحركات): This folder holds the recovery tools: the scripts and utilities that rebuild quantities, costs, ledger balances and debt ages for a database whose numbers are already wrong.
- [Reprocessing Quantity, Cost, and Stock Ages](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/reprocess-qty-and-cost.html) (ar: إعادة معالجة الكميات والتكاليف وأعمار المخزون (Reprocessing Quantity, Cost, and Stock Ages)): Scripts and utility links that rebuild quantity transactions, average cost and stock ages from the documents, either for the whole database with Tomcat stopped or partially, starting from a date.
- [Accounting Utilities - Ledger and Debt Ages Reprocessing](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/reprocess-ledger-and-debt-ages.html) (ar: أدوات المحاسبة - إعادة معالجة دفتر الأستاذ وأعمار الديون (Accounting Utilities - Ledger and Debt Ages Reprocessing)): SQL that rebuilds ledger transactions and debt ages from the committed documents, plus queries that find and fix zombie or unbalanced ledger transactions, missing dimension balances, financial paper entries and account deletion problems.
- [Queries to Check for (and Fix) Cost And Qty Problems](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/cost-and-qty-problems.html) (ar: استعلامات للكشف عن مشاكل التكلفة والكميات (وإصلاحها)): SQL queries that check whether inventory cost agrees with the ledger, and repair the usual causes when it does not: stale accounting configuration on inventory requests, zombie inventory requests, quantities that reached zero but still carry cost...
- [Inventory Related Utility Queries](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/inventory-utilities.html) (ar: استعلامات الأدوات المساعدة للمخزون): SQL queries for diagnosing and repairing inventory data: reopening a stock taking, allowing overdraft for all items and closing it again, changed base units, the dates an overdraft happened, item dimension quantities, expiry dates and lots...
- [Manufacturing Utilities](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/manufacturing-utilities.html) (ar: أدوات التصنيع (Manufacturing Utilities)): Two SQL repairs for manufacturing: a production delivery whose cost does not match the cost of the materials issued for it (the cost callback problem), and leftover production movement system entries.
- [Fixed Assets Module Utilities](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/fixed-asset-utilities.html) (ar: أدوات وحدة الأصول الثابتة (Fixed Assets Module Utilities)): Two SQL repairs for the fixed assets module: resetting an asset's last depreciation date after its depreciation was deleted, and fixing addition/deduction entries that always show zero.
- [Real Estate Utilities](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/real-estate-utilities.html) (ar: أدوات العقارات (Real Estate Utilities)): One SQL repair for real estate contracts: recalculating the system paid, collect requested and collected by financial papers values when installment payment entries have lost their reference.
- [Batch Utilities That Work From a List File](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/batch-utilities-from-file.html) (ar: أدوات تعمل على دفعة سجلات من ملف): Some repairs are the same action applied to hundreds of records: recommit these 800 invoices, delete these 40 drafts, send these 300 records to the new server again.
- [Rebuilding Module System Entries](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/module-entries-rebuild-utilities.html) (ar: إعادة بناء قيود النظام في الوحدات): Several modules keep a running history beside their documents: who owns each property unit, whether a unit is rented or free, which state each employee is in, how much vacation balance each employee has, which status each customer car has reached...
- [Approval Repair Utilities](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/approval-repair-utilities.html) (ar: أدوات إصلاح الموافقات): Every record that waits for approval has an approval case behind it.
- [Database Related Operations](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/db-operations.html) (ar: عمليات قاعدة البيانات (Database Related Operations)): SQL Server operations an administrator runs directly against a Nama database: snapshot isolation, finding running queries and table sizes, repairing a suspect database, dropping the foreign keys that stop users, attachments...
- [Suggest Indexes for Large Detail Tables](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/suggest-index-creation.html) (ar: اقتراح إنشاء Indexes لجداول التفاصيل الكبيرة): This article provides guidance on identifying large detail tables in your database that are missing essential indexes on their foreign key columns, which may lead to performance issues when selecting records.
- [General Purpose Utility Queries](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/general-purpose-utility-queries.html) (ar: استعلامات عامة متعددة الأغراض (General Purpose Utility Queries)): General SQL helpers that are not tied to one module: generating date ranges, finding missing document numbers, unlinking documents from their source documents, cancelling a document's current approval case...
- [Replication Utilities](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/replication.html) (ar: أدوات النسخ المتطابق (Replication Utilities)): SQL that clears sent messages, and messages for inactive sites, out of the replication message tables, and the steps for taking a backup of the head office and restoring it at a branch.

## Entity Flows Reference

- [Entity Flows Reference](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/)

### Core

- [Core](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/)
- [Field Maps in Nama ERP - Complete Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/ai-generated-field-maps-documentation.html): Field maps are a powerful feature in Nama ERP that allow automatic copying and transformation of data between different entities (records).
- [DeleteRelatedEntityAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/DeleteRelatedEntityAction.html): Deletes related entities that were previously generated by EAGenerateEntityFromEntityAction. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAllowUseAsFromDocOfAField](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAllowUseAsFromDocOfAField.html): Allows a specific field to be used as a source document reference ("from doc") in document creation workflows. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAltCodeValidator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAltCodeValidator.html): Validates the alternative code (altCode) field of entities to ensure they follow specific formatting requirements. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAttachReportResultToRecord](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAttachReportResultToRecord.html): Generates reports automatically and attaches the resulting files as attachments to the current entity record. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAutoCollectSignAndSentEInvoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutoCollectSignAndSentEInvoice.html): Automates the complete Saudi ZATCA e-Invoice submission process by collecting eligible invoices, creating submission documents, digitally signing them, and sending them to the tax authority. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAutoEscalateApprovalToFallBackEmployee](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutoEscalateApprovalToFallBackEmployee.html): Automatically escalates overdue approval cases to the fallback employee defined in the approval definition. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAutoEscalateApprovalToSupervisor](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutoEscalateApprovalToSupervisor.html): Automatically escalates overdue approval cases to the supervisor of the assigned employee when timeout periods are exceeded. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAutoSendEInvoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutoSendEInvoice.html): Automatically submits individual invoices to tax authorities (ZATCA/Egyptian Tax Authority) immediately after invoice creation or modification. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAutomaticGenerateEntityFromEntityAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutomaticGenerateEntityFromEntityAction.html): Automatically generates related entities from source entities and handles their deletion when the source entity is deleted. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAutomaticGenerateEntityFromEntityActionWithApproval](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutomaticGenerateEntityFromEntityActionWithApproval.html): Automatically generates related entities from source entities while respecting approval workflows. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACacheEvicter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACacheEvicter.html): Clears Hibernate second-level cache for a specific entity type, ensuring cached data is refreshed and subsequent queries retrieve current information from the database. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACalcCurrencyRate](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACalcCurrencyRate.html): Automatically calculates and sets exchange rates for foreign currency transactions on document entities. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACalcCurrencyRateInDetails](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACalcCurrencyRateInDetails.html): Calculates and sets exchange rates for foreign currencies in document detail lines (collections). - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACheckAndUpdateLinkAtOnlinePaymentTransactionSysEntry](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACheckAndUpdateLinkAtOnlinePaymentTransactionSysEntry.html): Performs maintenance on online payment transaction entries by checking for expired payment links and updating their status. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACheckDailyBackupOnGoogleDrive](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACheckDailyBackupOnGoogleDrive.html): Monitors Google Drive folders for backup files, verifying daily backups were created successfully. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACheckTaxAuthorityRejectedByReceiverDocuments](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACheckTaxAuthorityRejectedByReceiverDocuments.html): Automatically checks tax authority status for documents within their 3-day review window (from document date) and updates their status in the system. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAClearGoogleDriveTrash](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAClearGoogleDriveTrash.html): Empties the Google Drive trash folder, permanently deleting all trashed files. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACloseFiscalPeriodsInRange](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACloseFiscalPeriodsInRange.html): Automatically closes fiscal periods that have passed their end dates. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACodeValidator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACodeValidator.html): Validates entity code fields against formatting rules including length limits, prefixes/suffixes, and regex patterns. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACopyEmptyAccountsFromBag](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACopyEmptyAccountsFromBag.html): Copies subsidiary account assignments from account bag to fill empty subsidiary account fields. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EADeleteFromAnotherServer](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADeleteFromAnotherServer.html): Deletes entities from remote Nama ERP servers through web services to maintain data synchronization across multi-server environments. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EADeleteFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADeleteFromQuery.html): Executes SQL query to find entities, then deletes all returned entities. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EADeleteNotificationsByDuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADeleteNotificationsByDuration.html): Deletes user notifications older than a given number of days. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EADeleteOldFiles](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADeleteOldFiles.html): Manages file system cleanup by keeping only a specified number of recent files in folders, deleting older files to maintain storage efficiency. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EADetailsRemover](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADetailsRemover.html): Removes specific lines from document detail collections based on query conditions or predefined criteria for selective cleanup of detail records. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EADownloadURLsIntoAttachments](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADownloadURLsIntoAttachments.html): Downloads the file at each URL field value into the matching attachment field, setting the file name on the stored file. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAEmptifyTomcatTemp](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAEmptifyTomcatTemp.html): Cleans Tomcat temp directory by removing old files and folders while preserving recent items to manage server storage and improve performance. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAErrorIfQueryNotMatched](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAErrorIfQueryNotMatched.html): Validates entity data using SQL query and displays custom error message if validation fails. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAExecuteUpdateQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAExecuteUpdateQuery.html): Executes custom SQL UPDATE, INSERT, or DELETE statements directly against the database for bulk operations and data modifications with optional cache eviction. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAExecuteUpdateQueryOnDifferentDatasource](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAExecuteUpdateQueryOnDifferentDatasource.html): Executes SQL UPDATE, INSERT, or DELETE statements on external databases using configured data sources for cross-database operations and system integration. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAExportAttachments](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAExportAttachments.html): Exports file attachments from entity attachment fields to server file system with flexible naming and organization options. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAFieldsValuesCalculator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAFieldsValuesCalculator.html): Please review the page at Field Values Calculator - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAForceApplyInstallmentEffects](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAForceApplyInstallmentEffects.html): Recalculates and updates installment payment tracking for documents with installment-based payments, synchronizing paid amounts and remaining balances. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAForceUsersToChangePassword](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAForceUsersToChangePassword.html): Flags users to be required to change their password on their next login when their last password change is older than a configurable number of days (default: 45). - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateDraftEntityFromEntityAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateDraftEntityFromEntityAction.html): Please review the page at Field Values Calculator - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateDraftEntityFromEntityActionNoFlush](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateDraftEntityFromEntityActionNoFlush.html): Visit Field Values Calculator to know more about fields map and the available features - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateEntityFromEntityAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateEntityFromEntityAction.html): Please review the page at Field Values Calculator - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateEntityFromEntityActionNoFlush](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateEntityFromEntityActionNoFlush.html): Creates new entities from existing entities with full commitment but without immediate database flush. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateEntityFromEntityActionNoFlushWithApproval](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateEntityFromEntityActionNoFlushWithApproval.html): Please review the page at Field Values Calculator - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateEntityFromEntityActionWithApproval](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateEntityFromEntityActionWithApproval.html): Please review the page at Field Values Calculator - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateKNetPaymentURLs](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateKNetPaymentURLs.html): Generates KNet payment URLs for documents supporting online payment processing, creating both direct and redirect URLs for Kuwait's KNet payment gateway integration. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateMyFatoorahPaymentURLs](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateMyFatoorahPaymentURLs.html): Generates MyFatoorah payment URLs for documents supporting online payment processing, creating payment links through MyFatoorah's gateway for Middle East region payment methods. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGroovyAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGroovyAction.html): Runs a custom Groovy script as an entity flow action. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGuessEntityFromNames](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGuessEntityFromNames.html): Intelligently guesses and assigns entity references based on name similarity matching using advanced string distance algorithms for data import, migration, and automated entity linking. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAIgnoringNotFoundTargetFieldsValuesCalculator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAIgnoringNotFoundTargetFieldsValuesCalculator.html): Performs field value calculations with error tolerance, extending the standard field calculator but ignoring errors to ensure processing continues despite individual field assignment failures. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAJsonRecordExporter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAJsonRecordExporter.html): Exports entity data as JSON to external systems via HTTP requests with field filtering, renaming, and dynamic URL generation. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EALoyalityEarnReward](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EALoyalityEarnReward.html): Processes customer loyalty reward points earning for invoice transactions, calculating and awarding points based on purchase amounts while handling returns and external system integration. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAMakeCreationDateAlwaysAfter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAMakeCreationDateAlwaysAfter.html): Adjusts entity creation dates to ensure they always occur after a specified hour by adding random milliseconds while keeping the date within the same day. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAMakeCreationDateAlwaysBefore](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAMakeCreationDateAlwaysBefore.html): Adjusts document creation dates to ensure they always occur before a specified hour by synchronizing with value date and subtracting random milliseconds. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAMakeCreationDateAlwaysBetween](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAMakeCreationDateAlwaysBetween.html): Adjusts document creation dates to ensure they fall within a specified time window by synchronizing with value date and adding/subtracting random milliseconds until time is between start and end hours. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAMakeCreationDateInValueDate](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAMakeCreationDateInValueDate.html): Synchronizes document creation dates with their value dates while preserving the original creation time, ensuring date consistency without losing timing information. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EANamaCloudBackupPrepare](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EANamaCloudBackupPrepare.html): Prepares Google Drive backup configuration by scanning folder structures, authenticating via OAuth, and generating configuration for backup validation processes. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAOpenFiscalPeriodsInRange](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAOpenFiscalPeriodsInRange.html): Opens fiscal periods that overlap with a specified target date. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPostGoPayOfflinePayment](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPostGoPayOfflinePayment.html): Processes offline payments for GoPay digital wallet transactions, either posting payment directly or crediting customer balance based on configuration for receipt vouchers linked to GoPay-enabled invoices. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPreventChangingFields](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPreventChangingFields.html): Enforces field-level data integrity by preventing unauthorized changes to specified header and detail fields, with optional line addition/deletion protection and conditional SQL logic support. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPreventFromDocOfUsageAgain](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPreventFromDocOfUsageAgain.html): Automatically prevents source documents from being reused as "from documents" in multiple target documents by managing the preventUseAsFromDoc flag to maintain document chain integrity. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPreventUpdateDetailedRemarkLines](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPreventUpdateDetailedRemarkLines.html): Prevents updates to existing detailed remark lines while preserving the ability to add new lines. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPreventUseAsFromDocOfAField](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPreventUseAsFromDocOfAField.html): Prevents documents from being used as "from documents" by setting the preventUseAsFromDoc flag to true. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPrintFormToPrinter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPrintFormToPrinter.html): Prints entity forms directly to a specified printer using Jasper Reports. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPrintReportToPrinter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPrintReportToPrinter.html): Prints predefined reports directly to a specified printer using Jasper Reports. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARecommitFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARecommitFromQuery.html): Bulk recommits entities identified by a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARefreshCriticalErrors](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARefreshCriticalErrors.html): Refreshes the system's critical errors cache to update error notifications and status indicators. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARefreshGoogleDriveOrMailToken](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARefreshGoogleDriveOrMailToken.html): Refreshes Google OAuth tokens for Google Drive or Gmail integration by re-authenticating and testing the connection. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARegenAccEffects](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARegenAccEffects.html): Regenerates accounting effects for entities implementing IGeneratesAccountingRequest. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARegenAccFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARegenAccFromQuery.html): Bulk regenerates accounting effects for entities identified by a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAReviseUnReviseFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAReviseUnReviseFromQuery.html): Bulk marks entities as revised or unrevised based on a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARevokeApproval](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARevokeApproval.html): Revokes approval for entities currently in approval workflows. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARunBulkMassagesFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARunBulkMassagesFromQuery.html): Description: Send bulk message notifications for all records returned by a SQL query - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARunEntityFlow](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARunEntityFlow.html): Executes another entity flow by its business code. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARunEntityFlowFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARunEntityFlowFromQuery.html): Bulk executes an entity flow on multiple entities identified by a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARunManualNotification](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARunManualNotification.html): Triggers a manual notification for the current entity using a predefined notification definition. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARunManualNotificationFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARunManualNotificationFromQuery.html): Bulk sends manual notifications to multiple entities identified by a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARunTaskSchedule](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARunTaskSchedule.html): Manually executes a predefined task schedule by its business code. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASQLToCSVAttachmentField](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASQLToCSVAttachmentField.html): Runs a SQL query and stores the result as a delimited text (CSV) file inside an attachment field of the record being saved. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASQLToCSVEmail](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASQLToCSVEmail.html): Executes a SQL query, exports results to CSV format, and emails the CSV file as an attachment. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASQLToCSVFile](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASQLToCSVFile.html): Executes a SQL query and exports results to CSV file format. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASaveDraftsFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASaveDraftsFromQuery.html): Bulk saves draft entities identified by a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASaveRecordsFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASaveRecordsFromQuery.html): Bulk saves entities identified by a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASaveToAnotherServer](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASaveToAnotherServer.html): Synchronizes data between different Nama ERP servers by sending entity records to remote servers. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASaveToAnotherServerUsingJSON](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASaveToAnotherServerUsingJSON.html): Synchronizes data between Nama ERP servers using JSON format for data transmission. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAScaleImage](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAScaleImage.html): Resizes image attachments in entity fields to specified dimensions while maintaining aspect ratio. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAScaleMasterFileImage](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAScaleMasterFileImage.html): Specialized image scaling action that processes the main file attachment of MasterFile entities. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASendHttpRequestByTempo](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASendHttpRequestByTempo.html): Generates HTTP requests using Tempo templates and queues them for asynchronous execution. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASendNotSentTaxAuthorityDocuments](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASendNotSentTaxAuthorityDocuments.html): A catch-up sweep for e-invoicing. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASetCreationDateToEndOfDay](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASetCreationDateToEndOfDay.html): This entity action is currently unsupported and will throw an error when executed. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASetCreationDateToStartOfDay](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASetCreationDateToStartOfDay.html): Adjusts the entity's creation date to the start of the day (00:00:00). - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASetFieldByTemplate](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASetFieldByTemplate.html): Sets an entity field value using a Tempo template that can include dynamic content based on the current entity's data. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASortFields](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASortFields.html): Sorts detail collections within an entity based on specified field values. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAWathqAddressFetcher](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAWathqAddressFetcher.html): Fetches address information from Saudi government's Wathq platform using Commercial Registration National Number. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAWathqBasicInfoFetcher](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAWathqBasicInfoFetcher.html): Fetches basic commercial registration information from Saudi government's Wathq platform. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAWathqCommercialInfoFetcher](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAWathqCommercialInfoFetcher.html): Fetches commercial registration information from Saudi government's Wathq platform using Commercial Registration National Number. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAWordTemplate](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAWordTemplate.html): Processes Microsoft Word document templates by replacing placeholders with entity data. - entities: EntityFlow
- [SQLDraftImporter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/SQLDraftImporter.html): Imports entities from SQL query results and saves them as draft records. - entities: EntityFlow

### Groovy Script Examples

- [Groovy Script Examples](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/): These pages are ready-made Groovy scripts for entity flows and task schedules, each one checked on a demo database before it was published.
- [Add Free Lines From the References on Each Sales Line](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAAddFreeLinesFromLineReferences.html): This Groovy script lets the user type a line's free goods on the line itself. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesOrder, SalesInvoice
- [Number Lot-Tracked Lines by Item Section and Year](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAAutoLotIdFromItemSectionAndYear.html): This Groovy script writes a running number into Text 1 of every document line whose item is lot tracked. - entities: EntityFlow, ItemSection
- [Recalculate an Invoice's Totals After a Field Map](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACalculateMoneyFields.html): This Groovy script recalculates the money fields of an invoice from its current lines: each line's values, discounts and taxes, and the invoice totals. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesInvoice
- [Clear Attendance Punches Recorded at Midnight](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAClearFromDateIfFromTimeIsMidnight.html): These two Groovy scripts clean up Time Attendance lines where the attendance machine wrote 00:00 for a punch that never happened. - entities: EntityFlow, TimeAttendance
- [Clear the Locator When the Warehouse Does Not Use Locators](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAClearLocatorWhenWarehouseDoesNotAllowLocators.html): This Groovy script removes a locator from every document line whose warehouse does not use locators. - entities: EntityFlow, Warehouse
- [Clear Lots That Were Never Received, and Unused Dimensions](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAClearLotIdsWithNoItemDimensionsQty.html): This Groovy script tidies the dimensions on a document's lines before the document is saved. - entities: EntityFlow
- [Link Sales Return Lines to the Invoices They Came From](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACollectInvoicesInReturn.html): This Groovy script links every line of a sales return to the sales invoice lines it is returning, using an SQL query you write. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesReturn
- [Collect a Purchase Invoice's Stock Receipts From Its Car Receipts](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACollectStockReceiptsByFromDoc.html): This Groovy script fills the Stock Documents grid of a purchase invoice. - entities: EntityFlow, PurchaseInvoice
- [Keep the Prices of the Document a Sales Document Was Made From](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACopyLinePriceAndHeaderDiscountFromFromDoc.html): These two Groovy scripts make the lines of a sales document take the price of the line they were made from, and make the document take the source document's header discount percentage. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesInvoice, SalesOrder
- [Move a Serial Number Typed by Mistake Into the Lot](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACopySerialToLot.html): This Groovy script fixes a common data-entry slip on document lines: a batch number typed in the Serial Number column of an item that is tracked by lot, not by serial. - entities: EntityFlow
- [Hide Entries and Vouchers Behind Their Account's View Capability](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACopyViewCapabilityFromAccountToJournalEntry.html): These two Groovy scripts give a document the View Capability of the account it posts to. - entities: EntityFlow, JournalEntry, ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher
- [Reserve a Draft's Code When It Is Saved](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACreateAliasesForDrafts.html): This Groovy script runs when a record is saved as a draft. - entities: EntityFlow
- [Number Voucher Lines per Subsidiary and Fiscal Year](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACreateSerialForLineSubsidiary.html): This Groovy script gives each line of a receipt or payment voucher a running number that counts that line's subsidiary — the customer, supplier or employee on the line — within the fiscal year. - entities: EntityFlow, ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher
- [Add a Service Fees Line to the Electronic Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAEInvoiceCreationWithCustomServiceFees.html): This Groovy script changes what is sent to the tax authority, not the document. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesInvoice
- [Fill the Item's Default Revision on Document Lines](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAFillDefaultRevision.html): This Groovy script fills the revision on document lines that were left without one. - entities: EntityFlow, InvItem
- [Fill the Default Size and Color When a Committed Document Is Edited](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAFillDefaultSizeAndColor.html): This Groovy script repairs the size and color on the lines of a document that has already been committed once. - entities: EntityFlow, InvItem
- [Rebuild a Cancel Contract's Expense Lines From the Lease](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAFillExpensesWithRecommitRECancelContract.html): This Groovy script refills the Expense grid of a real-estate Cancel Contract from the lease it ends. - entities: EntityFlow, RECancelContract
- [Show What the System Thinks Each Day Is for an Employee](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAFindDaysInfoForEmployee.html): This Groovy script is a support diagnostic. - entities: EntityFlow, AttendancePlan, AttendanceShift, Employee
- [Rewrite an Item's Unit Conversions to the Base Unit](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAFixUOMConversionsToBaseUnit.html): This Groovy script lets users enter an Item's unit conversions the way they think about them, unit by unit, and rewrites them on save into the form the system needs: every unit converted directly to the base unit. - entities: EntityFlow, InvItem
- [Create One Purchase Order per Supplier From a Purchase Quotation](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAGenMultiplePurchaseOrdersFromQuotation.html): These two Groovy scripts split a purchase quotation by supplier. - entities: EntityFlow, PurchaseQuotation, PurchaseOrder, PurchaseInvoice

- [EAUpdateLotIdDates](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAUpdateLotIdDates.html): Updates lot date information (expiry, production, retest dates) across all system tables based on the dates specified in document lines. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAWebEngageSendInvoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAWebEngageSendInvoice.html): Sends a sales invoice (or sales return) to the WebEngage marketing platform. - entities: EntityFlow
- [SetQuantityToOneAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/SetQuantityToOneAction.html): Sets default quantity values to 1 for document lines that have zero or empty quantities. - entities: EntityFlow
- [SetSecondUOMToDefaultIfEmpty](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/SetSecondUOMToDefaultIfEmpty.html): Automatically assigns the default secondary unit of measure to document lines when the secondary UOM field is empty. - entities: EntityFlow
- [UniqueBOXInsideStockReceipt](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/UniqueBOXInsideStockReceipt.html): Validates that each box number is used only once per item within a stock receipt document. - entities: EntityFlow
- [ValidateSorceLinesOfFromDocAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/ValidateSorceLinesOfFromDocAction.html): Validates that all lines in the current document have corresponding source lines in the parent document when the document is based on another document (fromDoc relationship). - entities: EntityFlow

### Supply Chain Videos

- [Supply Chain Videos](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/supply-chain-videos/) (ar: فيديوهات سلسلة التوريد)
- [Inventory Costing Explained - Video 1](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/supply-chain-videos/cost-video-1.html) (ar: فيديو طريقة عمل التكاليف - 1): Learn how to manage and accurately determine inventory cost using the FIFO system, with a detailed explanation of cost-tracking dimensions and their impact on inventory reports and profitability.
- [Inventory Costing Methods - Video 2](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/supply-chain-videos/cost-video-2.html) (ar: فيديو طريقة عمل التكاليف - 2): A comprehensive and detailed explanation of inventory cost calculation systems and the impact of supply operations, purchase returns, and taxes on them in business and warehouse environments.
- [Costing Tutorial Video - 3](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/supply-chain-videos/cost-video-3.html) (ar: فيديو طريقة عمل التكاليف - 3): Learn the fundamentals of supply costing, letters of credit, and the distribution of transportation and manufacturing costs in a business environment, with a detailed explanation of modern accounting tools and systems.
- [Documentation: Explaining Actual and Indirect Costs in the Manufacturing System](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/manufacturing-actual-overhead.html) (ar: توثيق شرح التكاليف غير المباشرة والفعلي في نظام تصنيع): Watch from 0:00 In this session, Engineer Mohammed Saber explains the topic of indirect and actual costs and how they are handled inside the manufacturing system.
